postings.title: AI Application Developer
postings.description:
Job Overview

The FortiOS Release QA team is a group of over 90 staff dedicated to ensuring Fortinet products meet elite market standards before release. We are seeking an AI Application Developer to architect an end-to-end, closed-loop release cycle. You will design an AI-governed control plane that autonomously manages the software lifecycle: reasoning over feature specifications to create test plans, executing and verifying tests, managing the bug lifecycle, and ultimately generating customer-facing documentation and videos once a feature is verified. Your goal is to minimize manual toil while ensuring elite quality and providing immediate value to the end-user upon release.

Future Duties and Responsibilities

- Autonomous Spec-to-Plan Reasoning: Design systems using LLMs to ingest feature specifications and technical documentation to autonomously generate comprehensive test plans and high-coverage test scripts
- AI-Powered Test Case Generation: Utilize AI to author test cases derived from design requirements rather than existing code, ensuring that tests verify the intended functionality and avoid implementation-based confirmation bias.
- AIOps for Root Cause Analysis: Develop and deploy AIOps solutions to process massive log records and metrics from automation jobs, identifying the "few that matter" to automate root cause analysis and reduce manual triage toil.
- Intelligent Execution & Prioritization: Implement machine learning models for test case prioritization to maximize fault detection and optimize execution throughput within the CI/CD pipeline.
- Autonomous Bug Lifecycle Management: Build agents for automatic bug filing, tracking, and verification, including performing autonomous re-testing to verify fixes before they reach human review.
- Post-Verification Content Generation: Develop AI systems to autonomously generate technical documentation and instructional video content for customers following successful feature verification. Use LLMs to synthesize technical specs and verification results into structured, human-readable explanations and multimedia artifacts to accelerate customer onboarding.
- Governance & Human-in-the-Loop: Embed risk-weighted decision models to ensure that final release acknowledgements are backed by auditable AI-driven insights while preserving human oversight for high-impact decisions

Required Qualifications to be Successful in this Role

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
- AI/ML Experience: 2–3 years of experience building machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), or generative AI-driven applications.
- Programming Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with common machine learning libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
- LLM Application Development: Proven experience building applications with Large Language Models (LLMs) using strategies like prompt engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
- DevOps Knowledge: Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and the integration of AI into automated testing toolchains.
- Analytical Problem Solving: Ability to reason over complex "brownfield" tasks where AI must interact with large, existing codebases and distributed systems.
- Communication: Effective communication skills to explain AI-driven insights, behaviors, and constraints to both technical QA staff and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Skills & Knowledge

- Knowledge of Specification-Driven Testing paradigms and formal verification.
- Experience with Self-Correction and Reinforcement Learning from execution feedback to improve agent proficiency over time.
- Understanding of Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) and secure software development frameworks

The Canada base salary range for this full-time position is expected to be between $107,000 - $179,000 annually. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.

Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. postings.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
postings.description:
We are seeking an AI Infrastructure Engineer to build, operate, and continuously enhance the Linux and GPU-based infrastructure that powers our AI platforms and performance testing environments. This is a highly hands-on infrastructure, automation, and performance engineering role. You will design and maintain benchmarking frameworks, ensure the reliability and security of lab and compute environments, and develop internal AI platform services that support customer demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, competitive evaluations, and technical sales efforts. Your work will play a key role in helping secure new customer opportunities by enabling rapid validation of customer requirements and showcasing the performance and capabilities of our AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

AI Infrastructure & Performance Engineering

- Operate, maintain, and enhance automated performance testing services that benchmark throughput, latency, scalability, and resource utilization.
- Develop new testing frameworks, automation, and validation methodologies as requirements evolve.
- Analyze performance data and recommend improvements to reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Server, Hardware & Platform Operations

- Deploy, monitor, and optimize Linux servers, GPU clusters, virtualization platforms, and lab hardware.
- Support availability and utilization of compute resources for engineering, testing, and AI workloads.
- Evaluate and integrate new hardware technologies to improve performance and efficiency.

Reliability Engineering & AI Platform Development

- Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, failover, and incident response for critical infrastructure.
- Develop, deploy, and maintain internal AI server applications and shared compute platforms.
- Improve operational efficiency through automation and proactive issue identification; troubleshoot complex system/network/application issues.

Laboratory Administration

- Support day-to-day lab operations: access control, network administration, resource allocation, and capacity planning.
- Contribute to operational standards and best practices for lab governance.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

- Create and maintain technical documentation: benchmarking reports, design notes, and internal runbooks.
- Share technical insights and best practices with the broader engineering organization.

Required Qualifications (Must-Have).

- Hands-on Linux systems administration and infrastructure experience (servers, networking fundamentals, virtualization).
- Experience with KVM or containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
- Familiarity with DevOps toolchains (CI/CD, IaC, monitoring/observability stacks).
- Strong scripting/automation ability in Python and/or Bash, applied to infrastructure or testing workflows.
- Practical experience with GPU-based compute environments or AI/ML infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (equivalent experience welcome).
- Experience with performance testing, benchmarking, or traffic-generation methodologies.
- Exposure to network security concepts and enterprise security technologies.
- Experience with Fortinet products (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) or similar enterprise security/networking solutions — a plus, not required.
- Experience in customer-facing technical work: proof-of-concept support, demos, or technical presentations.
- Experience creating technical documentation, white papers, or delivering internal training.

Core Competencies

- Infrastructure Engineering
- AI Platform Development
- DevOps & Automation
- Performance Testing & Benchmarking
- Technical Documentation

postings.title: Associate HR Business Partner
postings.description:
Fortinet's Canada Human Resources team is looking for an Associate HR Business Partner to help us build the next generation of HR business partnering. This role combines core HR partnership with data, AI, process improvement and automation to help leaders make better people decisions and help HR operate more effectively.

This role is designed for an HR professional who has developed strong HR fundamentals and wants to become a modern, data-driven business partner. You will support leaders and employees across an assigned client group while also using AI, analytics, automation and process improvement to help HR operate more effectively and make better decisions.

We are looking for someone who is curious about how work can be done differently. You should be comfortable coaching a manager on a people issue, analyzing workforce data to identify a trend, and looking at a manual HR process and asking: Can we simplify, automate or eliminate this?

In this role, success isn't measured by how many HR processes you administer. It is measured by whether you become a trusted partner to the business, generate useful insights from people data, improve how HR work gets done, and continuously find ways to make HR simpler, faster, smarter and more scalable.

This is an opportunity to develop broad HRBP capabilities while helping shape how Fortinet's HR function works in the future.

Responsibilities

Partner with the Business

· Serve as a day-to-day HR partner for an assigned client group, supporting managers and employees across the employee lifecycle.

· Coach managers on performance management, employee relations, talent decisions and team effectiveness, escalating complex matters when appropriate.

· Develop an understanding of the business, its talent needs and organizational priorities, and use that context to provide practical HR recommendations.

· Support talent reviews, compensation cycles, organizational changes, workforce planning and other key people processes.

· Partner across Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, HR Operations, HRIS and other HR teams to deliver integrated solutions.

Turn Data into Decisions

· Analyze workforce data such as hiring, attrition, performance, compensation, mobility and organizational trends to identify insights and opportunities.

· Go beyond reporting what happened by helping determine why it happened, what it means, and what action the business should consider.

· Use both quantitative data and employee/manager feedback to identify patterns and emerging issues.

Use AI to Improve HR

· Partner with engineering and the HRIS team to use generative AI and other AI-enabled tools to accelerate research, analysis, communications, employee support and HR decision-making.

· Experiment with AI-enabled approaches to common HR activities while applying appropriate judgment, confidentiality and human oversight.

· Help identify practical AI use cases within HR and test new approaches that improve quality, speed or employee experience.

· Share effective AI practices with HR colleagues and help increase AI fluency across the team.

Simplify and Automate

· Identify repetitive, manual or inefficient HR processes and challenge whether there is a better way to accomplish the same outcome.

· Map existing processes, identify unnecessary steps and recommend opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate or eliminate work.

· Partner with HR Operations, HRIS and internal AI/technology resources to translate HR problems into automation or technology opportunities.

· Help measure whether new processes and tools actually improve efficiency, quality and employee or manager experience.

Requirements

· 2–4 years of experience in HR, ideally including HR generalist, employee relations, HR operations or business-partnering experience.

· Strong HR fundamentals and working knowledge of British Columbia employment practices.

· Curiosity about the business and an interest in understanding how people decisions affect organizational performance.

· Strong analytical skills and comfort working with workforce data; advanced Excel skills are highly valued.

· Demonstrated use of generative AI or other AI-enabled tools to improve how you work.

· A builder mindset: you naturally question inefficient processes and look for simpler, more scalable ways of working.

· Ability to take a business or HR problem, break it down, analyze available information and recommend a practical solution.

· Comfort learning new technology and experimenting with unfamiliar tools.

· Experience with an HRIS such as Oracle HCM preferred.

· Experience with data visualization, workflow automation or low-code/no-code tools is an advantage but not required.

· Experience in technology or another fast-moving environment preferred.

· Strong judgment, communication skills and discretion when handling sensitive employee matters.

· High level of personal integrity.

postings.description:
The Bid & Commercial Manager is responsible for managing complex bids and commercial proposals from opportunity qualification through contract signature. The role combines bid orchestration & pricing shaping while ensuring that offers are competitive, compliant, commercially sound, and aligned with company strategy & corporate policies. - Manage the end-to-end bid process for Enterprise and public tenders

• Analyze RFPs, RFQs, and contract requirements (commercial, financial, and legal)

• Support bid/no-bid decisions through risk and opportunity assessment

• Contribute to the commercial strategy and win themes in collaboration with sales

• Coordinate inputs from internal/external stakeholders to deliver high-quality proposals

• Ensure bids are submitted on time and fully compliant with customer requirements

• Prepare and lead internal bid review meetings

• Build business cases ensuring financial compelling offer while protecting company margin

- Develop pricing models, cost structures, and margin analyses

• Build and validate commercial assumptions and financial scenarios

• Ensure compliance with internal commercial governance and approval processes

• Identify contractual, financial, and operational risks and propose mitigation actions

• Support commercial and contractual negotiations with customers along with sales

• Contribute to contract finalization and handover to relevant post-sales teams

• Maintain bid documentation, templates, and commercial standards

• Capture lessons learned from won and lost bids to improve future performance

Profile Requirements

• Master’s degree (Business, Engineering, Finance, or equivalent)

• Proven experience (typically 8+ years) in bid management, commercial/contract management

• Experience in project-based or contract-driven industries is an advantage

• Strong understanding of bid and tender processes

• Solid financial and commercial acumen (pricing, margins, cost modelling)

• Good knowledge of contract terms and commercial risk management

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

• Fluent Spanish/Portuguese is a plus

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to influence without authority

• Results-driven mindset with strong commercial awareness

postings.title: Ceph Cluster Development  Engineer (C++ Focus)
postings.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Ceph Cluster Development & Operations Engineer with strong expertise in C++ systems programming to design, extend, and maintain enterprise-scale Ceph distributed storage clusters. The role involves deep development in Ceph core subsystems (RADOS, OSD, RGW, MDS), performance optimization, and operational excellence across multi-site, multi-zone architectures.

You will work closely with system architects, SREs, and cloud infrastructure teams to ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of mission-critical storage systems deployed across multiple data centers and Kubernetes environments.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and operate large-scale Ceph clusters including RADOS, RGW, RBD
- Contribute to or extend Ceph core components written in C++ (e.g., OSD, RGW, librados, BlueStore, MGR modules).
- Profile and optimize performance across network, disk I/O, and replication layers (PG placement, CRUSH rules, BlueStore tuning).
- Develop automation and tooling for cluster lifecycle management (deployment, upgrades, scaling, failover, and recovery).
- Integrate Ceph with Kubernetes (via Rook-Ceph, CSI drivers) and CI/CD pipelines for continuous delivery.
- Implement and validate multi-site replication and disaster recovery architectures for high availability.
- Develop and maintain secure storage solutions using dm-crypt, KMS integration, and CephX authentication.
- Build observability pipelines using Prometheus, Grafana, and custom exporters for metrics and health analytics.
- Write and maintain SOPs, automation scripts, and system documentation to support production-grade operations.
- Collaborate with upstream Ceph community or maintain in-house forks for feature development and bug fixes.

Qualifications

Required Skills

- Strong proficiency in C++ (C++11 or later), with experience in large-scale distributed systems or kernel-adjacent development.
- Deep understanding of Ceph architecture and its core components: MON, OSD, MGR, RGW, MDS, and CRUSH maps.
- Proficient in Linux systems programming, debugging (gdb, perf, valgrind), and performance profiling.
- Experience with Python or Go for tooling and automation.
- Strong foundation in data replication, erasure coding, and consistency models in distributed storage.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Rook-Ceph, Helm, Ansible, and related DevOps tools.
- Familiarity with TCP/IP, HTTP/S3 APIs, block storage (RBD/iSCSI), and object storage semantics.
- Ability to conduct root-cause analysis and lead performance investigations under production environments.

Preferred Skills

- Contributions to the Ceph open-source project or prior experience modifying Ceph source code.
- Experience with multi-site replication, object versioning, compliance retention, or legal hold features.
- Background in distributed storage systems, file systems, or cloud storage platforms.
- Familiarity with containerized environments, network virtualization, and cloud-native observability stacks.
- Excellent technical documentation and communication skills in English.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $179,000-$219,000. Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time, as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors, including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at the time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

postings.description:
The Fortinet Channel team are experienced and driven professionals, who enjoy building relationships, connections and nurturing partnerships to solve the world’s most complex cybersecurity concerns.

Your goals:

This Marketing Specialist position has a key role in developing pipelines working with our channel partners. Leveraging our key go to market messaging, work closely with our regional partners to develop strategies to develop opportunities for our partners and our solutions.

There will also be support and administrative tasks assigned from the Field Marketing Manager to help drive the overall regional pipeline and align to the field marketing calendar.

Pipeline Generation:

- Execute partner led marketing activities focused on driving pipeline and supporting regional Channel Account Managers meet their revenue targets.
- Understand marketing data to drive channel & field lead generation and regional pipeline acceleration.
- Translate strategy to growth throughout the marketing funnel and track partner opportunities to conversion, and achieve quarterly Marketing originated opportunities.

- Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within each partner and align enablement and activities to accelerate pipeline through each partner
- Provide logistical and executional support for partner-hosted marketing events, such as webinars, lunch & learns, and trade shows.
- Support channel partner enablement through education on marketing tools, campaigns, and execution best practices.

- Support partner communications such as newsletters, toolkits, and promotional updates.
- Work with the corporate team and other channel marketing contributors to share best practices and improve efficiencies across Canada and Americas International.

- Create and deliver regular reports/presentations to marketing executives on campaign plans and results.

postings.description:

Job Responsibilities:

- Manage the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle - triage findings from security evaluations and scans, prioritize by risk and exploitability, and coordinate remediation with R&D product, service and engineering teams.

- Participate in daily SOC operation, monitor and triage security alerts. Collaborate with Cloud operation teams in resolving security events.

- Lead security incident response for Fortinet cloud services - detect, investigate, and contain incidents, coordinate cross-team remediation and recovery, and conduct post-incident reviews to capture root cause and strengthen preventive controls.

- Integrate security practices into R&D’s CI/CD process - embed SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, container image scanning, secret detection and infrastructure-as-code security checks into build and release pipelines, define security gates and release criteria, and work with development teams to triage and tune results so security scales with engineering velocity.

- Support security compliance requirements - provide evidence for internal and external audits and certification efforts (e.g. ISO 27001), perform CIS Benchmark assessments of cloud products and infrastructure, map results to the relevant controls, document findings, and assist R&D teams in tracking identified gaps to closure.

- Participating in design and implementation of an AI based cloud security posture management system, primarily focusing on public IP scan and security exposure analysis.

- Collect, analyze threat intelligence and evaluate the risks.

Skills and Qualifications:

- 5+ years of dedicated experience in security engineering role, e.g. Security Engineer, Penetration Tester or DevSecOps/SRE.

- Hands-on experience with FortiSIEM, FortiAnalyzer, and FortiSOAR (or equivalent enterprise SIEM and SOAR tools) are required.

- System administration experience with security infrastructure - hands-on deployment, configuration and day-to-day administration of firewalls (FortiGate or equivalent), VPN and SIEM, including policy and rule management, log source onboarding and health monitoring.

- Experience with system backup and maintenance – Linux server administration, backup and restore procedures, patching and upgrade cycles, and high availability / disaster recovery operations.

- Familiar with vulnerability scanning tools such as Nessus, Nuclei or Wiz/Lacework.

- Experience of applying Agentic AI to security operations - designing and deploying AI agents that automate SOC workflows such as alert triage, threat hunting, and response orchestration, accelerating mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-respond.

- Understanding of the security risks unique to AI systems - prompt injection, insecure agent tool/function calling, model and data poisoning and with the ability to evaluate and test LLM-backed applications.

- Strong knowledge of the fundamentals of web applications including authentication, authorization, session management, HTTP protocol, web language, web server and browser architecture and implementation principle.

- Proficient programming ability with programming languages in order to conduct security code review and develop scripts and programs to help enrich security scan efficiency and penetration testing automation and dive in-depth ability.

Educational & Certification Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Electrical Engineering or related field

postings.title: Consulting Systems Engineer
postings.description:
Fortinet is expanding its Consulting Systems Engineering organization with a senior specialist dedicated to LAN Edge / NetSEC – the layer where campus networks meet access enforcement. This is a senior, individual-contributor consulting role: you will act as the go-to technical authority on switching and access-control architecture, working alongside regional sales and field systems engineering teams to scope, design, and defend complex network solutions in front of both technical and executive audiences.

The ideal candidate has spent a career at the intersection of two disciplines that are increasingly inseparable in modern campus design: enterprise switching – the physical and logical fabric that carries traffic from the edge to the core – and Network Access Control, the policy layer that decides who and what is allowed onto that fabric, and under what conditions. You do not just configure switches; you can explain why a distribution layer needs multi-chassis redundancy rather than stacking, and why a poorly designed onboarding flow quietly creates a segmentation gap. As a senior consultant, you collaborate closely with field engineering and account teams to drive impactful engagements across industries, while feeding real-world insight back into Fortinet’s product roadmap.

As a Consulting Systems Engineer – LAN Edge (NetSEC), you will:

- - Act as the senior technical authority for LAN edge and NAC opportunities, supporting field systems engineers and account teams through discovery, design, and proof-of-concept.

- - Lead architecture reviews for campus switching designs – access/distribution/core hierarchy, high-availability topologies, and VLAN/routing segmentation – as well as NAC rollouts covering 802.1X, guest access, and device onboarding.

- - Translate customer requirements into validated designs and respond to RFPs/RFIs with accurate, defensible technical content.

- - Partner with Product Management and Engineering, feeding field insight on switching and access-control requirements back into the roadmap.

- - Validate new features and platforms against real customer environments and provide structured feedback ahead of general availability.

The ideal candidate exemplifies qualities common to senior consultants, in addition to deep, current domain-specific technical knowledge:

- - 10+ years of hands-on enterprise networking experience, with a clear specialization in switching at the LAN edge, distribution, and core layers.

- - Deep, vendor-agnostic command of switch fundamentals: Layer 3 routing (OSPF/BGP) at the distribution and core, the Spanning Tree family (STP/RSTP/MSTP) and loop-prevention design, multi-chassis link aggregation (MC-LAG/MLAG) and chassis-redundancy architectures, switch stacking/virtual chassis, and 802.1Q VLAN design and trunking.

- - Desirable: an expert-level networking industry certification

- - Strong, hands-on Network Access Control (NAC) expertise: 802.1X wired and wireless authentication (EAP-TLS, PEAP), MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB) for non-supplicant and IoT devices, RADIUS-based AAA with Change of Authorization (CoA) for dynamic policy enforcement, dynamic VLAN assignment and downloadable ACLs, device profiling/fingerprinting, posture and compliance assessment, guest and BYOD onboarding, and TACACS+ for network device administration.

- - A plus: familiarity with EVPN-VXLAN campus fabric design – the direction the market is moving for large, segmented campuses beyond classic MC-LAG and stacking architectures.

- - Proven ability to design, defend, and articulate complex networking and access-control solutions to both technical and executive audiences.

- - Track record collaborating with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product management, and sales.

- - Highly proactive and self-driven, with the ability to act as a technical mentor to peers.

- - Bilingual in Portuguese and English (required); Spanish is a strong plus.

- - Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent experience.

postings.description:
This role is based 4 days/week in our offices in Kelsterbach/Prague.

Who we are.

Fortinet is a global leader in the cyber security industry recognized for our innovative solutions and commitment to customer satisfaction. Our products are designed to help organizations of all sizes protect their networks and data from cyber threats. We have a global presence, with offices and partners in over 100 countries around the world and employ more than 12,000 people worldwide.

Why we need you.

We are currently seeking an experienced Technical Support Engineer to join our team supporting Fortinet’s flagship product – FortiGate. You will provide support to our customers and partners and provide a consistently excellent standard of customer assistance and service.

Through strong technical skills and product knowledge, the Support team works to resolve cases raised by effective troubleshooting, research, and testing or for more complex issues work directly with back-line and development teams.

What you will be doing.

- Work as part of a team to provide technical assistance to Fortinet-certified partners and customers for Fortinet Firewalls (FortiGate) and other devices.
- Run real-time troubleshooting sessions with partners/customers.
- Test and reproduce partner/customer issues in the Laboratory.
- Recommend corrective actions based on gathered data and analysis.
- Run real-time phone or remote access sessions.
- Report software/hardware related issues to R&D department.
- Acquire knowledge by participating in round tables, training, and self-learning.

To be successful in the role, you will have:

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering or related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
- 3 - 6 years’ experience in an IT or technical support role.
- Experience in the telecommunications/networking/security industry.
- Good knowledge of the OSI model.
- Strong understanding of networking protocols, specifically TCP/IP, routing and switching.
- Proficient spoken and written English and Spanish.
- Positive, communicative, and customer-oriented attitude.
- Excellent time management, multi-tasking and organizational skills.
- Self-motivated to develop technically.
- Ability to cope and work under pressure.

What is not essential but nice to have:

- Industry certificates (NSE4, CCNA, Security+ etc.).
- Knowledge of dynamic routing protocols (OSPF, BGP).
- Knowledge of authentication protocols (LDAP, SSO, 2-factor authentication, etc.).
- Knowledge of cloud environments like AWS, google cloud, Azzure, etc.
- Experience with security devices (Firewalls, IPSs, Mail Security Gateways, etc.).

What we offer:

- Career growth opportunities: Working for a reputable and fast-growing company like Fortinet can provide you with ample opportunities for professional development and growth. Fortinet is committed to the professional development of its employees. You'll have access to a wealth of knowledge and experience from colleagues, as well as training, certification and mentorship programs that will help you grow in your role and advance your career.
- Competitive compensation and benefits: We offer competitive salaries, employee stock program, annual merit reviews, and benefits such as health insurance, multisport card and more.
- Work-life balance: Fortinet values its employees' work-life balance and provides a flexible working environment. You will receive 30 days paid time off with additional public holidays in the Czech Republic.
- Great location: Prague is one of the most beautiful cities in Europe and a great place to live and work. The Fortinet office is conveniently located in the city center, close to public transportation and other amenities.
- Global exposure: Fortinet has a global presence, and working in its Prague office provides you with exposure to an international working environment. You will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different regions and cultures, which can broaden your perspectives and enrich your professional experience.
- Impactful work: At Fortinet, you'll be working on cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions that help protect organizations from cyber threats. You'll be making a meaningful contribution to the safety and security of businesses worldwide.
- Exciting work culture: Fortinet has a dynamic and fast-paced work culture that encourages innovation, teamwork, and creativity. We are a high performing, driven, results oriented culture. The type of environment where you can get things done, explore your own innovation, creativity and feel proud about the difference you are able to achieve. We encourage ideas and provide patent incentives to do so. Also, through our own Innovator Awards Program, employees have an opportunity to get involved in the development of their own ideas and even share in the commercial success of newly developed products!

postings.title: Deputy CISO
postings.description:
The Deputy CISO serves as an operational leader and strategic execution partner to the CISO, responsible for advancing the company’s cybersecurity priorities while enabling business growth, product innovation, and operational agility.

This role partners closely with engineering, product, AI, cloud, IT, and executive teams to ensure security is integrated into the business in a practical, risk-based, and scalable way. The role balances strong security governance with business realities, helping the organization move quickly to achieve business objectives and enable innovation while appropriately managing enterprise risk.

The Deputy CISO also serves as a credible executive representative of the security organization with customers, prospects, regulators, and strategic partners when needed.

Responsibilities

Security Strategy Execution

- Partner closely with the CISO and other Deputy CISOs to operationalize the enterprise cybersecurity strategy and drive execution across the organization.
- Translate strategic security priorities into measurable operational plans, governance models, and execution roadmaps.
- Establish accountability, execution rigor, and operational cadence across security initiatives.

Business Enablement & Risk Partnership

- Partner with engineering, product, AI, cloud, and infrastructure teams to enable innovation while appropriately managing enterprise risk.
- Develop pragmatic, scalable security frameworks that support rapid product development and emerging technology adoption.
- Drive a culture of “secure enablement” focused on helping teams move quickly and safely rather than creating unnecessary friction.
- Help business and technology leaders make informed, risk-based decisions aligned with company priorities and customer expectations.
- Ensure security controls are proportional, practical, and aligned to business impact.

Security Program Leadership

- Oversee execution of enterprise security programs across areas which may include:
- Cloud security
- Identity and access management
- Security operations and incident response
- Vulnerability management
- AI security governance
- Third-party risk
- Security architecture
- Governance, risk, and compliance

- Continuously improve operational maturity, scalability, and effectiveness of the security organization.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Build strong partnerships across engineering, product, IT, legal, HR, compliance, and executive leadership teams.
- Serve as a trusted advisor on operational resilience, cybersecurity risk, and emerging technologies.
- Act as incident coordinator during major security incidents, operational escalations, or enterprise risk events.

Customer & Executive Engagement

- Support strategic customer and prospect engagements requiring executive-level security credibility.
- Participate in executive briefings, customer trust discussions, security reviews, and high-priority escalations.
- Help articulate the company’s security strategy, operational maturity, and approach to emerging technologies such as AI.
- Partner with Field CISOs and sales leadership on strategic accounts where internal operational expertise is valuable.

Organizational Leadership

- Help scale and mature the security organization, operating model, and leadership team.
- Drive operational excellence, prioritization, and organizational effectiveness across security functions.
- Mentor and develop future security leaders across the organization.

Ideal Leadership Characteristics

- Business-minded and commercially aware
- Pragmatic and solutions-oriented
- Strong executive judgment and risk assessment capabilities
- Comfortable making informed tradeoffs in fast-moving environments
- Collaborative partner to engineering and product organizations
- High bias for action and operational execution
- Able to balance governance with innovation and speed
- Believes security should enable the business, not constrain it

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

- Monitoring and auditing the company’s compliance with established internal controls

- Reporting findings to senior management and the company’s audit committee
- Conducting internal audits and support investigations as needed.
- Coordinating activities with external auditors and advisors to support their audit and review procedures.

Qualifications

- 10+ years of relevant internal audit experience, ideally a mix of Big 4 public accounting firm and multinational corporate internal audit departments. Experience in the technology sector is preferred.

- Familiarity with technology platforms, data-driven processes, and emerging AI-enabled solutions.

- Strong problem-solving and communication skills as well as a collaborative style to find solutions is required.

postings.title: Early Talent Recruiter EMEA
postings.description:
Are you based in Frankfurt and passionate about connecting exceptional early-career talent with meaningful opportunities? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, international environment where communication, marketing, and a keen instinct for spotting high-potential profiles come together?

Then join us as an Early Talent Recruiter and help build a diverse, future-ready talent pipeline across EMEA at Fortinet, a global leader in cybersecurity protecting the digital world, including the AI systems and infrastructure that increasingly power it.

What You Will Do

Reporting directly to the EMEA Talent Acquisition Manager and collaborating closely with the EMEA HR Program Manager, you will play a central role in identifying, engaging, and hiring the next generation of Fortinet talent. This is a highly diverse role, giving you exposure to a wide range of activities, countries, and stakeholders across the EMEA region.

You will work in a truly international environment, partnering with hiring managers, university relations teams, and HR colleagues across multiple countries, while bringing a strong passion for communication and marketing to how Fortinet's employer brand shows up to candidates. You will also be expected to leverage AI-powered recruiting tools, from AI-assisted sourcing and candidate matching to data-driven analytics, to identify high-potential profiles faster.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage the end-to-end early talent recruitment cycle across multiple EMEA countries, from sourcing to offer
- Identify and assess high-potential profiles, using structured evaluation criteria and AI-powered sourcing and screening tools to surface the strongest candidates efficiently
- Partner closely with the EMEA Talent Acquisition Manager and EMEA HR Program Manager to align early talent recruitment with broader workforce planning and HR programs
- Collaborate with hiring managers across EMEA to define role requirements and build a diverse, qualified candidate pipeline
- Design and deliver engaging, marketing-driven communication and content to promote Fortinet's employer brand to students and early-career candidates
- Use applicant tracking systems (ATS) to track pipeline health, time-to-hire, and sourcing effectiveness
- Support and coordinate a wide range of early talent activities, including campus events, career fairs, and virtual engagements across EMEA
- Ensure a consistent, inclusive, and high-quality candidate experience at every stage of the recruitment journey
- Stay current on AI-driven trends in talent acquisition and recommend new tools or approaches to keep Fortinet's recruitment practices ahead of the curve

What We Are Looking For

- A strong interest in early talent recruitment and campus recruiting
- A natural ability to identify high-potential profiles and evaluate candidate fit beyond the resume
- Genuine passion for communication and marketing, with the creativity to bring Fortinet's employer brand to life
- Comfort working across cultures in an international, matrixed environment covering multiple EMEA countries
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English; additional European languages are a plus
- Highly organised and adaptable, comfortable managing a wide and diverse range of activities simultaneously
- A genuine commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in hiring

What We Offer

- A dynamic, high-visibility role within a fast-growing, international cybersecurity leader
- Exposure to a wide range of activities and countries across EMEA, with real ownership from day one
- The opportunity to work hands-on with modern, AI-enabled recruitment technology and analytics
- A diverse, multicultural, and inclusive team culture

postings.title: Electrician
postings.description:
Fortinet is seeking an electrician to join our facility team in a fast-growing cybersecurity company at the headquarters facility in Sunnyvale. This is a computer lab and data center environment with medium voltage power distribution. We are continuously building labs, adding equipment as well as maintaining, repairing and upgrading the campus.

Ideal Candidate

Completion of a four-year apprenticeship program which has included: AC & DC electrical systems; electrical drafting; electrical circuit construction; 12KV, 480/277V, 208/120V, and low voltage circuits; transformer theory; 3 phase induction 3 motors, VFD’s; conduit bending and installation; installing and pulling wire; power distribution panels; motor control and electrical switch devices; relay & pneumatic control; National Electrical Building Code.

Qualifications & Experience

- 4+ years of experience performing electrical distribution installations.
- Strong knowledge of the NEC & OSHA requirements
- Hold a Valid CA Driver’s License.
- Is legally authorized to in the United States.
- Must be able to bend, stoop, squat, crawl, climb, kneel, balance, push, pull, and reach overhead.
- Ability to lift 50 pounds and constantly moving on your feet.
- Ability to climb and stand on all types of ladders.
- Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving abilities.
- Team player with good cross-functional skills, willing to help adjacent departments.

Required Certification

- Active Electrician Trainee Card or Certified Journey Worker Certification.

Preferred Certifications

- Completion of a four-year apprenticeship program described below working directly under the supervision of a qualified Journey Electrician.
- Controls, PLC, BMS, BAS, SCADA a plus.

postings.title: Embedded Software Developer
postings.description:
Fortinet is offering an exciting opportunity and hiring an Embedded Software Developer to help with our FortiAuthenticator product development. The FortiAuthenticator builds on the foundations of Fortinet's Single Sign-On, adding a greater range of user identification methods and scalability.

The FortiAuthenticator is the gatekeeper of authorization into the Fortinet-secured enterprise network identifying users, querying access permissions from third-party systems and communicating this information to FortiGates and other devices on the network in order to enforce user policies.

Job Responsibilities

At Fortinet, you will be involved in the full development lifecycle of a product that has a real impact in reducing security threats. You will use your skills to design, develop, maintain and improve new and existing firmware components that are the backbone of the product, such as:

- Authentication daemons
- High-availability and load-balancing components
- Single Sign-On services
- Cryptographic operations
- System services

Desired Skills and Experience

- 5+ years of software development in a Unix/Linux environment
- Excellent C/C++ programming
- Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills
- Experience with network programming (TCP/IP)
- Experience with cryptography and/or authentication protocols (RADIUS, LDAP, SAML, Kerberos) is a plus
- Experience using source control software (SVN, Git)
- Experience with Python and/or Rust programming
- Experience with SQL databases

Desired Personal Attributes:

- Positive attitude

- Good communicator

postings.title: Embedded Software Engineer
postings.description:
Description

As an Embedded Software Engineer on our team, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of embedded software and core platform modules that power Fortinet’s networking and security appliances.

This is a high-visibility role within the engineering organization and will be instrumental in collaborating with hardware, platform, QA, and cross-functional teams across Fortinet to understand requirements and deliver scalable, reliable, and high-quality embedded solutions that can grow with the business. The successful candidate must be a strong hands-on engineer with expertise in embedded systems, embedded networking, and low-level software development, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Principal Responsibilities

- Participate in the development and maintenance of existing and next-generation firewall product suites.
- Design, implement, and maintain core platform modules for embedded networking and security appliances.
- Develop and enhance low-level software components, including device drivers, kernel modules, and board support packages (BSPs).
- Take ownership of significant areas of the codebase for both new feature development and maintenance or redesign of existing product areas.
- Support all phases of the software development life cycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, validation, and deployment.
- Collaborate closely with hardware teams on board bring-up, platform integration, debugging, and validation of new systems.
- Optimize software for performance, scalability, memory efficiency, reliability, and maintainability.
- Debug and resolve complex issues across hardware and software layers using a structured and systematic approach.
- Contribute to embedded platform architecture, software design decisions, and long-term technical improvements.
- Participate in code reviews, CI/testing, and development best practices to ensure high-quality deliverables.
- Follow secure coding practices and support the development of security-focused product features.
- Continuously contribute to product improvements in performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

Qualifications / Skills Required

- Bachelor’s degree or advanced degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- Strong proficiency in C and/or C++ programming.
- Experience with embedded Linux systems and low-level software development.

postings.title: EMEA Payroll Analyst (Location: Kelsterbach, Germany)
postings.description:
EMEA Payroll Specialist

Location: Kelsterbach, Germany

This role is office-based 4 days per week.

Fortinet EMEA payroll team forms part of the Finance department. The payroll team has overall responsibility for the gathering and collating of information from other departments including the process complex payroll items including RSUs and Stocks. Once reconciled, communicate accurate, compliant instructions to third party payroll providers to ensure timely processing of multiple payrolls (circa 27 Countries and 3500+ people) for the EMEA region.

The EMEA Payroll Specialist must be professional and confident in working with individuals at all levels of the organization and external vendors and customers.

Working at part of a high functioning close knit team (currently of 8) you will be required to perform against tight deadlines, must be highly confidential with sensitive information and demonstrate an ability to build and maintain relationships along with demonstrating solid written and oral communication skills.

Responsibilities:

- Management of assigned regional payrolls, ensuring consistent processes followed, any issues resolved, and all employees paid correctly and on time.

- Establish and maintain relationships with external payroll bureaus, including monitoring service levels.

- Prepare monthly payroll journals.

- Ensure payroll associated payments ie tax, pension etc. are approved and paid within the correct timeframes.

- RSU/Stock option processing.

- Work with the team managers to create, update and maintain effective SOPs

- Ensure effective SOX compliance, including SAS 70/SSAE16 compliance where appropriate.

- Efficient handling of all payroll related queries.

- Assist with the preparation and submission statutory reporting including year end activities, working closely with partners both internal and external.

- Work with external and internal auditors, providing information as and when required.

- Provide support and cover for the other team members within the payroll department.

- Work with project management to successfully deliver Fortinets’ payroll roadmap, including moving to a new payroll partner (ADP) and transformation of the EMEA payroll function including automation and standardisation

Qualifications:

- Significant and demonstrable knowledge of successful payroll processing.

- Experienced in managing multiple EMEA payroll processing.

- Experience of payroll journal booking and reconciliations.

- Demonstrated experience of identifying and implementing payroll process improvements.

- Solid organizational skills & ability to multi-task, time management skills.

- Successful management of vendors to achieve company goals.

- Knowledge of and experience working with SOX compliance.

- Previous related accounting support experience.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

- Ability to deliver under pressure

- Intermediate Excel

- Confidential discrete & professional.

- Possess strong research skills.

- Customer service orientation.

postings.description:

The SecOps Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the technical leader and trusted advisor for Fortinet's Security Operations portfolio. The role combines deep technical expertise, customer-facing presales engagement, business alignment, and internal enablement to drive the successful adoption of Fortinet's SecOps solutions.

The SME supports account teams, partners, customers, and fellow Systems Engineers by providing advanced architecture guidance, solution positioning, competitive differentiation, and subject matter leadership across the Security Operations domain.

As a Systems Engineer, you will:

A successful SecOps SME is recognized as the "go-to" expert for Security Operations within the organization, demonstrates exceptional technical depth, influences strategic customer decisions, enables peers and partners, and helps establish Fortinet as a credible leader in modern SOC and SecOps transformation initiatives - more details below

Technical Leadership

- Act as the primary technical authority for Fortinet SecOps solutions.
- Maintain expert-level knowledge of the products within the SecOps portfolio like FortiSIEM, FortiSOAR, FortiEDR, FortiRecon and others
- Understand integration points within the Fortinet Security Fabric.
- Stay current with industry trends, threat landscapes, SOC modernization, AI-driven security operations and emerging technologies.

Customer Engagement

- Lead advanced technical discovery workshops.
- Support strategic customer opportunities and large enterprise engagements.
- Conduct executive and technical presentations.
- Design solution architectures aligned with customer security and business requirements.
- Drive technical validation activities including:
- Proof of Concepts (PoCs)
- Demonstrations
- Workshops
- Technical assessments
- Act as trusted advisor to CISO, SOC, Security Architecture, and Security Operations teams.

Presales Support

- Support regional Systems Engineers and Account Managers throughout the sales cycle.
- Provide expertise during qualification and opportunity development.
- Develop competitive positioning against key vendors.
- Assist with RFIs, RFPs and technical proposal development.
- Influence account strategies where SecOps solutions can create customer value.

Internal Enablement

- Mentor and coach field Systems Engineers.
- Deliver technical enablement sessions and workshops.
- Develop reusable technical assets including:
- Demo environments
- Solution playbooks
- Architecture guides
- Best practices
- Competitive battlecards
- Support certification and skills development initiatives.

Partner Development

- Enable strategic partners and MSSPs on Fortinet SecOps solutions.
- Participate in partner workshops and technical sessions.
- Assist partners in building managed security and SOC services based on the Fortinet platform.
- Support partner-led opportunities requiring advanced technical expertise.

We Are Looking For:

- Minimum 5 years of experience in network security or application security

- Experience in handling big enterprise account, lab setup and proof-of-concept (POC)

- Expert Knowledge in: SIEM, SOAR, XDR, Threat Intelligence, Security Analytics, Incident Response, SOC Operations, MITRE ATT&CK Framework, Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting

- Strong Understanding in: Network Security, Endpoint Security, Cloud Security, Identity Security, Operational Technology (OT) Security, Security Architecture Framework

- Business Skills: Executive communication, Strategic thinking, Customer-facing presentation skills, Consultative selling, Business outcome alignment, Competitive positioning, Stakeholder management

postings.title: Field CISO
postings.description:
The Fortinet Field CISO is a senior security, technology and policy advisor with a focus on thought leadership and being a trusted advisor to customers and prospects. You will operate at the intersection of executive influence, security strategy, and revenue, translating complex cybersecurity challenges into compelling business outcomes and positioning the Fortinet platform as the essential foundation of a modern security program. We are looking for someone with more than 15 years of experience in the IT and/or OT (operational technology) security industry with a strong technical and commercial acumen, to act as a trusted advisor to the world’s largest organizations and help them improve their security postures and align security strategically with business initiatives. This person will report to the CISO, and support Fortinet’s sales, marketing, and communications teams’ in revenue growth by helping them and partners successfully assess our technologies, solicit business requirements/use cases, understand how different platforms will work and integrate, develop a technical strategy, configure and effectively demonstrate the solution that addresses partner/sales team requirements, and work with the global delivery team to ensure the success of integration with other products (where necessary).

The Field CISO will also work closely with Fortinet prospects and partners, as well as the companies’ product managers, and partner programs professionals to maximize the growth and expansion of Fortinet products by targeting and developing strong relationships with new and existing partners and integrators globally, ensuring the sales goals of our global products.

Responsibilities:

- Executive advisory: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to CISOs, CIOs, and boards of directors at key accounts, helping them navigate evolving threat landscapes, regulatory pressures, and security transformation programs.
- Revenue acceleration: Partner with enterprise sales teams on strategic deals, owning the CISO-to-CISO relationship. Lead executive briefings, security workshops, and board-level presentations that advance pipeline and accelerate close.
- Thought leadership: Represent the company at industry conferences (RSA, Black Hat, Gartner Security Summit), in media, and in analyst briefings. Author white papers, and executive content that drives brand authority.
- Product influence: Act as the voice of the CISO community back into the product and engineering organization, shaping roadmap priorities based on frontline conversations with customer security leaders.
- Community building: Cultivate a network of CISO champions, advisory board members, and reference customers. Lead regional peer forums, roundtables, and executive immersion programs.
- Security program strategy: Help customers develop and mature their security programs, including zero trust adoption, cloud security posture, incident response readiness, and regulatory compliance frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIS2, DORA).

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE/EXPERIENCE:

- 15+ years of relevant work experience in security software, hardware, architecture, strategy, in part as a technology evangelist.
- Demonstrated proficiency with security strategy, products, and ecosystems.
- Highly networked in the CISO executive networks, including CISO coalitions and summits, and regularly leveraging and working the inner circles of those connections to further promote the Fortinet brand and accelerate our business growth.
- Exceptional negotiation, demonstration, presentation and interpersonal communication skills are essential.
- Deep expertise in at least two domains: cloud security, identity, threat detection & response, OT/ICS, or GRC
- Highly influential relationship builder.
- Customer focused and commercially minded.
- Proven track record in a similar role with clear evidence of successful execution.
- Fortinet product knowledge and understanding of its developer ecosystem preferred.
- Public speaking experience with great PowerPoint creation and presentation skills.
- Established industry presence (speaking, writing, or advisory board participation)
- Experience in a customer-facing or commercial role (sales, pre-sales, advisory, consulting, or fractional CISO)
- Familiarity with AI/ML-driven security tools and emerging threat vectors
- Preferably experience in a CISO, Deputy CISO, Field CISO role or alternatively a senior vendor, consultancy, or analyst role alongside practitioner background
- Willing to travel within reason.

EDUCATION:

- B.S./M.S. Computer Science, Software Engineering

postings.description:
Global Client Partner – NATO & Defence (EMEA)

Role Overview

Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of innovation, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to protect people, devices and data everywhere.

We are seeking an experienced Global Client Partner to drive Fortinet’s engagement strategy across NATO and Defence organisations throughout EMEA.

This role will focus on building strategic relationships, increasing Fortinet’s visibility and influence across the Defence ecosystem, and providing market insight to support long-term business growth. The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of NATO and Defence structures, decision-making processes and stakeholder landscapes, with the ability to identify where strategic technology decisions are made and how Fortinet can effectively engage.

The Global Client Partner will act as a trusted advisor, working closely with Sales, Systems Engineering, Government Affairs, Alliances and leadership teams to shape engagement strategies, identify opportunities and strengthen Fortinet’s position across NATO and Defence markets.

As Global Client Partner you will:

- Develop and execute Fortinet’s engagement strategy across NATO and Defence organisations within EMEA.
- Build and maintain strong knowledge of NATO structures, agencies, commands, programmes, procurement processes and decision-making frameworks.
- Map complex organisations to identify key stakeholders, decision makers and technology owners.
- Establish and maintain trusted relationships with Defence stakeholders, NATO representatives, government bodies, industry partners and the wider Defence ecosystem.
- Provide market insight into Defence priorities, procurement trends and competitive positioning.
- Identify emerging programmes, initiatives and opportunities where Fortinet can support Defence cybersecurity objectives.
- Work closely with regional sales teams to develop engagement strategies and accelerate opportunities.
- Partner with Systems Engineering, Government Affairs, Channel, Alliances and leadership teams to coordinate customer engagement.
- Support executive briefings, strategic meetings, industry forums and Defence events to strengthen Fortinet’s market presence.
- Develop stakeholder maps, engagement plans and account intelligence to support long-term growth.
- Build relationships with Defence ecosystem partners, system integrators and technology providers.
- Act as an internal subject matter expert on NATO and Defence engagement, sharing knowledge across the organisation.

An experienced professional with a deep understanding of NATO and Defence environments and the ability to navigate complex, multinational organisations.

- Significant experience working within or alongside NATO, Defence organisations, government security agencies or the wider Defence ecosystem.
- Strong understanding of NATO organisational structures, governance models, procurement processes and decision-making dynamics.
- Established relationships and credibility with Defence stakeholders, decision makers and industry participants.
- Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and understand where strategic decisions are made.
- Experience influencing outcomes through relationship building, engagement and executive alignment.
- Strong understanding of cybersecurity, secure networking and Defence technology requirements.
- Ability to translate customer priorities and strategic initiatives into business opportunities.
- Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience operating across multiple countries and cultures within an EMEA environment.
- Ability to collaborate effectively across global, regional and cross-functional teams.

- Previous experience engaging with NATO agencies, Defence ministries, armed forces, national security organisations or defence-related programmes.
- Ideally served up until senior level / rank in the military in a NATO
- Background in cybersecurity, networking, defence technology or critical infrastructure.
- Experience working with defence primes, system integrators and strategic technology partners.
- Understanding of Defence procurement frameworks, long-cycle programmes and government decision-making processes.
- Existing network and credibility across NATO and Defence communities.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Hardware Developer to join our dynamic engineering team. postings.title: Hardware Developer – Power Supply & Circuit Design
postings.description:
We are seeking a Hardware Developer with a focus on power supply design who will also contribute to other areas of hardware development, including signal conditioning and digital circuit design. This role is directly involved in the hardware development of cybersecurity computers, ensuring robust and reliable platforms through advanced power and circuit design. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in regulator design, simulation, and testing, coupled with the ability to support system-level hardware integration and design reviews.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop single- and multi-phase switching regulators (primarily buck converters) with emphasis on current sharing.

- Design and implement linear voltage regulators for precision and low-noise applications.

- Design and implement inrush current controllers and efuses.

- Develop and optimize filters (using ferrites and inductors) to attenuate switching regulator voltage ripple and evaluate their frequency response.

- Evaluate output impedance and ensure regulator stability across load and operating conditions.

- Perform SPICE simulations to verify regulator stability, frequency response, and transient performance.

- Perform primitive thermal analysis of voltage regulators to ensure safe operating conditions and reliable system performance.

- Perform PCB design reviews (Allegro) with a focus on power integrity, grounding, and layout best practices.

- Create and maintain schematic designs using OrCAD Capture.

- Conduct lab measurements including:

- Voltage ripple characterization

- Bode plot generation

- Output impedance testing

- Step response analysis

- Work with IC vendors to:

- Identify and select the best power solutions for given requirements.

- Review schematic and PCB designs for compliance with vendor guidelines.

- Engage in troubleshooting efforts when issues arise.

- Contribute to signal conditioning circuit design and review for analog front-end applications.

- Participate in digital circuit design and review, ensuring reliable integration with mixed-signal systems.

- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver robust, production-ready hardware designs for cybersecurity computing platforms.

Soft Skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Self-starter with the ability to work independently as well as in a team.

- Clear communication skills (verbal and written).

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications

- MSc degree in Electrical Engineering, preferably with a specialization in Power Electronics.

- Minimum 1 year of work experience in hardware and power supply design.

- Excellent hands-on experience in lab testing, regulator design, and frequency/stability analysis.

- Proficiency in SPICE simulation tools, PCB design tools (Allegro), and schematic capture (OrCAD).

- Strong understanding of signal conditioning circuits, digital hardware, and system-level design considerations.

Preferred Skills

- Experience designing multi-phase converters with current balancing.

- Strong analytical skills in both circuit simulation and real-world measurements.

- Familiarity with mixed-signal design challenges and PCB-level noise mitigation.

- Ability to work independently and in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.

We're looking for a Vertical Marketing Manager to drive and elevate our industry-specific messaging, content, and creative strategy across key sectors, including Manufacturing, Energy, and Utilities.

As a critical member of the EMEA ABM & Vertical Marketing team, reporting directly to the EMEA ABM Senior Director, you will be responsible for developing and executing content and messaging strategies that drive brand awareness, thought leadership, demand generation, and sales engagement across strategic accounts and the wider EMEA region.

Working closely with Sales, Field Marketing, Communications, PR, and external partners, you will leverage customer insights, market intelligence, and industry trends to create compelling content that influences buying decisions and strengthens Fortinet's positioning trough out the customer journey.

If you're customer-obsessed, innovative, and passionate about turning complex industry challenges into impactful stories, we'd love to hear from you.

Create, adapt, and optimize content across multiple channels, including email, social media, blogs, executive briefs, eBooks, solution briefs, customer stories, and industry insight reports.

postings.title: Information Security Analyst - Singapore
postings.description:
Location: Singapore

Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic Information Security Analyst to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

This is a highly technical role, monitoring security events, identifying threats, assessing risks, and working with customers globally to improve their security posture. The role sits at the intersection of alert triage, detection engineering, and AI-augmented operations — the analyst will work within a Fortinet-native stack (FortiSIEM, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSOAR) and actively collaborate with AI agents to drive more accurate and efficient security operations.

FortiCloud SOC-as-a-Service team operates based on a follow the sun approach. Working hours for this position includes 5 days/40 hours per week, consisting of 1 weekend and 4 weekdays (e.g. Sunday – Thursday or Tuesday – Saturday), 8am – 4pm.

As a Information Security Analyst, you will:

- Monitor SOC alerts to detect potential threats
- Use threat intelligence feeds, triage alerts and filter out false-positives
- Create custom reports, dashboards, and execute log searches to support investigations and customer’s requirements
- Work with customers and Forensic analysis team to contain and eradicate incidents if need be
- Follow Incident Response playbooks, processes and procedures and help to improve them
- Create/Update use case detections to detect new threats from raw logs
- Create/Update playbooks to automate repetitive triage steps
- Operationalise detection use cases from FortiSIEM and FortiAnalyzer into FortiSOAR, contributing to the team’s detection engineering pipeline
- Interact with AI agents during alert triage to review and validate AI-generated alert summaries, enrichment, and contextual analysis
- Provide structured feedback to AI agents to continuously refine alert summarisation accuracy and triage decision logic based on real-world alert patterns.

We Are Looking For:

An insightful and influential collaborator to join our team. We encourage you to apply for this position if you have the following qualities:

- Strong understanding of SOC operations, the Incident Response lifecycle, Cyber Kill Chain, threat vectors, threat intelligence, and cybersecurity frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK, NIST)
- Hands-on experience with security log analysis (AV, IPS, Anti-Spam), Linux and Windows administration, PostgreSQL, regular expressions, and security visualisation and reporting tools
- Practical experience with network security technologies including Firewalls, SIEM, EDR, and Sandbox; hands-on experience with Fortinet products (FortiSIEM, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSOAR) is a strong advantage
- Aptitude for detection engineering — able to translate threat scenarios into structured use case logic and operationalise detections across FortiSIEM, FortiAnalyzer, and FortiSOAR
- Comfortable working alongside AI agents; able to critically evaluate AI-generated alert summaries, enrichment, and triage recommendations, and provide structured feedback to improve them over time
- Team player, self-directed, and disciplined communicator; cybersecurity certifications (GCIA, GCIH, GMON, GSOC, CEH, Security+) are a bonus

The Infrastructure QA team performs tests designed to validate Fortinet Cloud services for end-to-end scalability and resiliency.

The position requires candidates with strong experience in network security (preferably in a technical support or QA role) and the ability to gather and analyze complex network and system architectures, to set up testing platforms, to define and execute test cases, and to detail the test results in service reports for both internal and external audience.

- Analysis and technical investigation of problems involving all Fortinet products
- Follow-up with solution owners (R&D, Network, Systems, DC Hosting) departments to resolve product issues

- Develop core competency on Fortinet’s product line and technologies
- Work closely with other departments in the organization

- Strong understanding of data networking protocols, specifically TCP/IP, routing and switching is required
- Very good presentation and technical documentation skills
- Good troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to problem solving
- Administrator level working knowledge of Linux, Docker, VMware systems, KVM
- Experience with security products firewalls, IPsec, IDS/IPS, Anti-Spam, AV
- Good understanding of Web application concepts, security and vulnerabilities
- Work experience with Fortinet products an advantage
- Positive, communicative and customer-oriented attitude
- Ability to work in multicultural team environment
- General knowledge of software testing an advantage
- Scripting knowledge an advantage

- Four years or more experience in network security (technical support or QA)
- Graduate of network and security engineering school

postings.title: Inside Channel Account Manager
postings.description:
Inside Channel Account Manager – Scale Partner Germany
Office based in either Munich, Frankfurt or Hamburg

We are currently seeking a dynamic Inside Channel Account Manager to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing Channel Partner Business in Germany.
You would act as a key team member supporting new and entry level partners, enabling strong partner engagement, and contributing to regional sales growth.

Your Responsibilities in this role:

· Act as the primary channel contact for a large set of entry level and net new partners.

· Responsible for qualifying and onboarding new partners

· Enable targeted accounts through product training, sales best practices, and partner resources.

· Help Channel Partners obtain necessary information and materials, such as quotes and product information

· Expand Fortinet’s product portfolio within key accounts.

· Accountable for evaluating account success through deal registrations, revenue growth, and other key performance indicators.Responsible for promoting and driving Marketing success within Channel community.

· Responsible for understanding our partners’ business models/structures.

· Manage and drive partner pipelines to successful close rate.

· Establish key relationships and build mindshare within partner accounts.

· Close collaboration with our Distribution partners and their teams.

· Connect Fortinet Account Managers with their counterparts at channel partners.

· Contribute to basic marketing campaigns, including Channel mailing activities and other partner-focused initiatives

· Maintain accurate records of Channel Partners and their sales activities using CRM tools such as Salesforce

· Participate in ongoing learning and development activities to expand knowledge of Fortinet’s products and services

We Are Looking For:

An insightful and highly motivated collaborator to join our team. We encourage you to apply for this position if you possess the following qualities:

· 3+ years of channel sales experience in the networking or cybersecurity sectors.

· Competitive, self-starting, hunter-type mentality.

· Proven track record of exceeding sales quotas.

· Exceptional listening and communication skills.

· Experience in channel sales within the networking or cybersecurity sector.

· Experience working in a fast-paced environment with revenue responsibilities.

· This role requires occasional work outside the office, including maintaining an on-site presence at partner locations and Fortinet events.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both German and English.

· Comfortable working with people and building relationships in a hybrid (in-office and remote) environment.

· Well-organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple tasks efficiently.

· A positive, curious mindset and a strong desire to learn.

· Strong attention to detail and the ability to work effectively across different processes, systems, and tools.

· Advanced skills in Excel (e.g., PivotTables), Salesforce (e.g., dashboards and reports), and Tableau are beneficial.

· Experience in building scalable processes or adapting existing processes to support partner activities is an advantage.

· An interest in technology and cybersecurity is a plus.

What you can expect from us:

· Excellent training and development opportunities, providing you with all the tools you need to be successful.

· An open working environment, sharing knowledge and information collaboratively and transparently, with respect to everyone’s thoughts and opinions.

· The opportunity to be part of an innovative, collaborative and winning team.

· A market competitive salary package, including stock awards, and opportunity to over-achieve.

Why Join Us?

At Fortinet, we embrace diversity and inclusivity. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and identities. Explore our welcoming work environment designed for a rewarding career journey with an attractive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 900,000+ customers around the globe.

#LI-Onsite
