postings.description:
Fortinet continues to be a driving force in the evolution of cybersecurity and the convergence of networking and security. Securing people, devices, and data everywhere is our mission. To that end, our portfolio of over 50 enterprise-grade products is the largest integrated offering available, delivering proven cybersecurity everywhere you need it. More than 800,000 customers trust Fortinet solutions, which are among the most deployed, most patented, and most validated in the industry. Fortinet is headquartered in Sunnyvale, Calif., with offices around the world. If you're looking for a fast-paced, challenging and rewarding environment, then Fortinet is the place for you. We are an equal opportunity employer offering exciting work, competitive compensation and benefits. Fortinet is looking for the best and the brightest to join our highly motivated team.

Job Description:

The Inside Distribution Account Manager will engage in both proactive and reactive activities based on the needs of our distributors and sales teams. They will be responsible for managing the day-to-day execution of the Distribution team’s selling and operational activity, while helping achieve Fortinet’s overall objectives at their assigned distribution partner(s).

Primary Responsibilities:

- Assist Distribution Account Managers in monitoring progress towards and achieving strategic goals and objectives.

- Engage and support our distributors and their Fortinet partners in activities facilitating partner enablement and revenue growth.

- Establish and grow relationships at assigned distributor accounts.

- Participate in weekly Distribution Team calls and provide insights regarding market intelligence, competition, as well as updates to product availability, lead times, delivery scheduling, etc.

- Act as a point of contact to increase assigned distributor and partner account knowledge relative to Fortinet programs, product, support, services, resources and competitive differentiators.

- Perform detailed, clear and accurate data analysis and reporting as required.

- Ensure distributor inventory levels, pricing, and SKU catalog are managed effectively and reported accurately.

- Act as liaison between our sales teams and the distributors to help build strong working relationships.

- Ability to travel up to 25%.

Required Skills

- BS/BA degree in Business Administration or related field (or relevant professional experience).

- Strong Excel skills; ability to manipulate data using pivot tables and complex formulas.

- Strong Power Point skills; ability to develop content and present complex information to large audiences in a clear and effective manner.

- Experience working with large distributors, preferably in the cybersecurity or networking field.

- Ability to proactively assess customer needs and work autonomously.

- Knowledge of Salesforce.com and Tableau a plus.

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $80,000 - $130,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

postings.description:
Inside Sales Representative - Enterprise

Location – Turkey (Istanbul)

Fortinet secures the largest enterprises, service providers and government organizations around the world. Fortinet empowers its customers with intelligent, seamless protection across the expanding attack surface and the power to take on ever-increasing performance requirements of the borderless network - today and into the future. Only the Fortinet Security Fabric architecture can deliver security without compromise to address the most critical security challenges, whether in networked, application, cloud or mobile environments.

The Role

We are seeking upbeat, focused and well-organized individuals, to expand our successful Inside Sales Team. Achieving our future goals and remaining a leader in our field, requires exceptional individuals who can share and understand our passion for success.

By working with a team of External Account Managers, on either a defined Territory or a defined account list, you will work as part of the “account team” to effectively engage the market to increase revenues and margin within your region/accounts. This will be achieved by identifying incremental revenues within new customer opportunities, maintaining and increasing revenues within existing accounts and renewals.

The role of the Inside Sales Representative is 100% office based. This is a revenue generating and revenue closing role.

In return the right candidates will benefit from an exceptional sales package and fantastic career progression within Fortinet.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop end user relationship in order to drive the renewals process within assigned accounts.
- Develop and qualify new lead opportunities to drive increased revenue opportunity in specific target vertical markets
- Generating prospective customers through “warm and cold calling” and lead qualification from marketing leads, telemarketing services, and web
- Build relationships with specific channel partners who are relevant to your accounts and opportunities.
- Accurate management of all leads, opportunities and associated data via the CRM tool – Salesforce.com (SFDC), and update all activity within SFDC.
- Develop, learn and communicate specific sales propositions to end user customers.
- Attainment of all set targets and achievement of KPI’s.
- Keeps up-to-date knowledge of the industry, as well as the competitive posture of the company
- Joint strategic and tactical planning with your Account Manager.
- Provide all other tasks associated with account management – arrangement of evaluations, licenses, renewals and quotations to name a few.
- Provide accurate forecasting along with your Account Manager, and be able to provide a forecast of your business while your Account Manager is absent
- Manage the end to end sales cycle on all smaller opportunities, including the management of “renewals”.
- Take ownership of specific marketing campaigns which are being run for your region/accounts, utilizing the Telemarketing Team for initial calling. Be able to feedback the success to the broader sales and marketing team.
- “Stand-in” cover for when your account manager is out of the business. This will include, but not limited to forecast reviews, QBR’s and being available as the first point of contact for your accounts and channel partners.

Required Skills and Experience

- A proven sales track record within an inside sales role ideally within the IT Industry – security, networking or hardware
- SFDC/Salesforce.com knowledge advantageous
- Experience in B2B sales
- Must be motivated, a self-starter, and be able to deal with ambiguity.
- Hunter type mentality
- Excellent communications capabilities
- Goal orientated with the ability to exceed targets and KPI’s
- Self-confident with the ability to work in a fast pace environment
- Able to work independently as well as part of a team

postings.title: Inside Sales Representative
postings.description:
Inside Sales Representative

Role Overview

Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic Inside Sales Representative to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

You will play a key role in supporting our regional sales organization partnering closely with Account Managers and sales leadership to drive revenue growth, operational excellence, and high-quality execution across your assigned region and accounts.

As an Inside Sales Representative, you will:

- Develop and qualify new lead opportunities to drive incremental revenue across target verticals.

- Generate prospective customers through warm and cold calling, marketing-generated leads, telemarketing, and web inquiries.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with channel partners and end-users.

- Manage the full sales cycle for smaller opportunities, including renewals and transactional business.

- Support Account Managers through joint strategic planning, opportunity management, and customer engagement.

- Provide coverage for Account Managers during absences, including forecast reviews, QBR participation, and acting as the first point of contact for accounts and partners.

- Work closely with senior sales leadership to monitor KPIs, dashboards, and Salesforce (SFDC) data quality.

- Lead operational tasks such as POS collection from distributors, deal remapping, and deal recognition activities.

- Ensure accurate forecasting and support quarterly consolidation activities at the beginning and end of each fiscal quarter.

- Maintain high-quality pipeline hygiene and activity tracking within Salesforce (SFDC).

- Take ownership of regional marketing campaigns, coordinating with Telemarketing and reporting outcomes to sales and marketing teams.

- Stay current on industry trends, competitive positioning, and Fortinet’s evolving product portfolio.

We Are Looking For

An insightful and influential collaborator to join our team. We encourage you to apply for this position if you have the following qualities:

- Capacity and ambition to grow into a Team Lead role within the next two years.

- 4–7 years of experience in Inside Sales, Sales Administration, or Sales Operations.

- Strong organizational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Mandatory Salesforce (SFDC) proficiency and strong understanding of sales processes.

- Strong Excel skills, including data analysis and reporting.

- Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving abilities and a focus on operational excellence.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders.

- Team-oriented, collaborative, and positive, with high integrity and honesty.

- Hunter mentality with the drive to exceed targets and KPIs.

- Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to team goals.

Why Join Us

At Fortinet, we embrace diversity and inclusivity. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and identities. Explore our welcoming work environment designed for a rewarding career journey with an attractive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000+ customers around the globe.

We will only notify shortlisted candidates. Fortinet will not entertain any unsolicited resumes; please refrain from sending them to any Fortinet employees or Fortinet email aliases. Should any agency submit resumes to Fortinet, these resumes, if considered, will be assumed to have been provided free of any related fees or charges

The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a key member of Fortinet’s sales organization, responsible for driving growth within an assigned territory. In this role, you will partner closely with Field and Inside Sales Account Managers to build and execute strategies that expand new customer acquisition while strengthening existing relationships.

At Fortinet, we foster a results driven, high performance culture that rewards hard work, innovation, and excellence. Our team thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where initiative is encouraged and success is celebrated. Fortinet invests heavily in its people providing comprehensive onboarding, continuous technical and sales training, and ongoing enablement to ensure your long-term success.

As an ISR, you will collaborate with Fortinet’s reseller partners, marketing teams, and channel organizations to drive opportunities, generate pipeline, and increase revenue. You will play a pivotal role at the forefront of identifying new business opportunities and contributing to the overall success of the sales organization.

This role offers clear career advancement opportunities, empowering team members to grow within the sales organization, and recognizing top performers with career development, rewards, and increased responsibility.

OFFICE LOCATION: Any office location

Job Responsibilities

• Generate new sales opportunities through outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach

• Qualify leads and set appointments for the sales team, ensuring a steady flow of high-quality meetings and opportunities

• Create and track sales opportunities (leads, renewals, and deal registrations in Salesforce.com)

• Manage small-scale deals and renewal opportunities throughout the full sales cycle, from pre‑sale to post‑sale.

• Collaborate with sales team to strategize outreach and lead qualifications.

• Address customer satisfaction issues and requests in a timely manner and assist with customer presentations and demos

• Meet and exceed sales activity metrics designed to drive productivity and success

• Align with sales, channel, and partner teams to support overall company revenue targets

• Execute the role with professionalism and in alignment with Fortinet’s core values

• Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

Required Qualifications

• Prior experience as an Inside Sales Representative (ISR), Business Development Representative (BDR), or in a similar sales role

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• Strong communicator with proven relationship-building skills

• Self-starter: coachable, adaptable, and growth-driven

• Proficient with Salesforce and modern prospecting tools

• Highly organized, resilient, and results-focused

• Entrepreneurial mindset with forward-thinking problem-solving

Preferred Qualifications

• Technical degree in Computer Science, Information Technology/Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field

• Background in networking, security, and/or public/private cloud (preferred)

• 1–3 years of sales or related individual contributor experience

• Experience with multi-tier distribution (Channel Sales)

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $70,000 - $85,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

postings.title: Inside Sales Representative
postings.description:
Die Rolle
Als Channel Inside Sales Representative verantworten Sie die professionelle Bearbeitung und Qualifizierung von eingehenden Partner- und Channel-Leads aus Marketingkampagnen, Events, Distributoren und der Channel Hot Lead Queue. Ihr Ziel ist es, sicherzustellen, dass sämtliche Leads schnell bewertet, qualifiziert und innerhalb definierter Service Levels an die zuständigen Partner oder Vertriebsteams übergeben werden.
Dabei stellen Sie sicher, dass alle eingehenden Leads innerhalb eines festgelegten 24-Stunden-SLAs bearbeitet und kontaktiert werden, um eine optimale Partner Experience zu gewährleisten und keine Geschäftschancen ungenutzt zu lassen.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Schnelle und professionelle Bearbeitung sowie Qualifizierung von Partner- und Channel-Leads aus Marketingkampagnen, Events, Distributoren und weiteren Lead-Quellen.
- Sicherstellung der Bearbeitung sämtlicher eingehender Leads innerhalb eines definierten 24-Stunden-Service-Levels inklusive Erstkontakt, Bewertung und Dokumentation.
- Aktive Betreuung und Priorisierung der Channel Hot Lead Queue. Sie stellen sicher, dass vielversprechende Opportunities zeitnah identifiziert und an die richtigen Ansprechpartner weitergeleitet werden.
- Enge Abstimmung mit Distributoren, Partnern und internen Stakeholdern, um eine reibungslose Bearbeitung und Übergabe qualifizierter Leads sicherzustellen.
- Identifikation von Geschäftspotenzialen, Kundenanforderungen, Projektzeitplänen und relevanten Ansprechpartnern zur Erhöhung der Lead-Qualität und Conversion Rate.
- Präzise Dokumentation aller Aktivitäten, Lead-Status und Qualifizierungsergebnisse in Salesforce zur transparenten Erfolgsmessung und Nachverfolgung.
- Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, Lead-Flows und Best Practices innerhalb des neu aufgebauten Teams.

Ihr Profil
- 1–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Inside Sales, Business Development, Lead Development, Telemarketing oder Channel Operations – idealerweise im IT-, Netzwerk- oder Cybersecurity-Umfeld.
- Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, professionell mit Partnern, Distributoren und Kunden zu kommunizieren sowie relevante Informationen zielgerichtet zu erfassen.
- Hohe Eigenorganisation, ausgeprägte Detailorientierung und konsequentes Arbeiten nach definierten Prozessen und SLAs.
- Interesse an Cybersecurity-Technologien sowie die Fähigkeit, neue Themen schnell zu erfassen und in Kundengesprächen zu adressieren.
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit Salesforce (Lead-, Contact-, Opportunity-Management) oder vergleichbaren CRM-Systemen ist von Vorteil.
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachenniveau (C1/C2) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die interne Kommunikation.

Was wir bieten
- Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Fixgehalt je nach Erfahrung gepaart mit einer leistungsorientierten Provisionsstruktur.
- Umfassendes technisches und vertriebliches Onboarding inklusive der Möglichkeit, renommierte Fortinet-Zertifizierungen zu absolvieren.
- Durch den Neuaufbau und das geplante Wachstum dieses Teams profitieren Sie von exzellenten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Es stehen Ihnen später vielfältige Karrierewege offen – beispielsweise als Senior Channel Inside Representative, Team Lead, im strategischen Channel-Management oder in weiteren Vertriebsfunktionen innerhalb des Unternehmens.
- Möglichkeit, Prozesse und Standards eines neu aufgebauten Teams aktiv mitzugestalten und dessen zukünftige Ausrichtung maßgeblich zu beeinflussen.
- Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Frankfurt am Main, flexible Hybrid-Work-Modelle sowie regelmäßige Team- und Company-Events.

Erfolgskriterien der Rolle
- Einhaltung des 24-Stunden-SLAs für eingehende Channel Leads
- Anzahl qualifizierter Leads
- Lead-to-SAL (Sales Accepted Lead) Conversion Rate
- Lead-to-Opportunity Conversion Rate
- Bearbeitungsquote der Channel Hot Lead Queue
- Generierte Channel-Pipeline
- Partnerzufriedenheit
- Salesforce-Datenqualität und Prozesskonformität

postings.title: Inside Territory Account Manager
postings.description:
The Inside Territory Account Manager (ITAM) will manage an assigned territory in support of the SMB team. The ideal candidate will have experience in the networking and/or security sectors of technology. The ITAM will create and execute the account plan from prospecting to building and maintaining a constant revenue pipeline. Drive sales cycles to close while establishing relationships and credibility. Provide necessary presales support for prospects/customers. Work closely with Channel Teams and our reseller partner network to drive deals and increase revenue. Fortinet will provide detailed and ongoing training programs. Once completed you will be assigned a territory, quota and given ongoing support to begin your career at Fortinet.

Responsibilities:

- Meet or exceed all assigned quotas and targets
- Forecast weekly, monthly and quarterly revenues for territory
- Follow up on inbound, web and corporate event generated opportunities
- Accept inbound and perform outbound telephone calls to identify sales opportunities.
- Meet and exceed daily call & activity metrics.
- Manage customer presentation and demos via online tools (GO TO MEETING)
- Track sales opportunities (MGOs, deal registration, quotes etc. in Salesforce)
- Align with channel and partner teams to support overall company revenue targets
- Perform ongoing research and report on opportunities that are supported
- Act as a liaison between partner, customers, and appropriate Fortinet team members
- Perform other duties and projects, as assigned to support the growth or our business

Required Qualifications:

- A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas and targets
- Understanding of the sales cycle in conjunction with business processes internally and externally
- Ability to manager and drive sales cycle from start to finish
- Ability to manage a diverse, high volume workload; self-motivated and adaptable
- Ability to quickly build productive relationships in a fast-paced, high-performance environment
- Must have proficiency with various software applications programs
- Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
- Experience with managing and forecasting individual quota
- Well organized with effective time and activity management skills
- Ability to apply entrepreneurial strengths in a forward-thinking manner
- Proven work-ethic and time-management skills
- Ability to close business while achieving a high level of customer and partner satisfaction
- Public/private cloud experience is a plus
- Experience with multi-tier distribution a plus.
- The Inside Territory Account Manager is required to customarily and regularly work outside of their office or home office engaged in selling, including travel as needed to make a sale.
- Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

postings.title: IT Helpdesk Engineer
postings.description:
Job Title: IT Helpdesk Engineer.

Job Summary

We are seeking a dedicated team player to join our IT department as an IT Helpdesk / Support Engineer. The ideal candidate will have over 2 - 3 years of experience in the IT industry, specializing in IT service support, remote support, and system administration. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of our IT infrastructure, providing top-tier end-user support, managing network configurations, and handling IT department requirements.

Key Responsibilities

End-User & Remote Support: Provide onsite, telephonic, and remote support (using MS Teams or any collaboration tools) to resolve functional and technical errors, hardware issues, network issues and OS breakdowns.

System & Software Deployment: Install and configure operating systems (Windows 11, Ubuntu, Mac OS), push images to new laptops, and deploy specialized software.   Active Directory & User Management: Manage users, groups, and computers in Active Directory, including creating accounts, resetting passwords, enabling/disabling access, and configuring user profiles based on requirements.

Network & Infrastructure Setup: Configure and troubleshoot LAN networking, shared drives, and network devices utilizing a strong understanding of the OSI Model, TCP/IP suite, DHCP, DNS, NAT, and IPv4/IPv6.

Email & Communication Configuration: Configure and troubleshoot MS Outlook, MS Teams etc.  Security & Patch Management: Maintain application updates, update critical patches and enforcing client-based policies to secure all computers available in the production.

Asset Management: Maintain the IT asset database from deployment to scrap workflow. Coordinate with vendors for warranty support and replacement parts.

Ticketing & Reporting: View error logs, raise tickets via ticketing tools or reporting wide user impacts to respective teams.

Data Recovery & Printer Setup: Perform basic data recovery for corrupted drives or documents, and handle the installation and maintenance of network, local, and shared scanners/printers.

Qualifications & Requirements

• In-depth knowledge of Operating Systems (Windows 10, 11), MacOS and Linux.

• Strong understanding of LAN networking, TCP/IP, and basic routing/switching concepts.

• Follow company IT policy and tools to carry on day-to-day job. Experience with ticketing systems, patch management (SCCM), and remote desktop tools.

• Excellent troubleshooting skills with an end user-focused approach to resolving technical and hardware issues.

• Ability to communicate effectively and build relationships. A self-motivated attitude.

• Ready to assist and guide other members of the team.

• 2 - 3 years of hands-on experience as an IT Helpdesk / Support Engineer. (Corporate exposure preferred)

• Preferred IT course - CompTIA A+

• Minimum qualification required – BCA/BSC (computer science).

- Provide first-line technical support to internal and external customers via phone, email, and remote access tools.
- Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and network-related issues promptly and efficiently.
- Document and update knowledge base articles to ensure a comprehensive resource for common issues.
- Escalate complex issues to senior engineers or relevant teams, ensuring a smooth handoff and timely resolution.
- Maintain accurate records of all support interactions and ensure proper follow-up with customers.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement process improvements for enhanced support.
- Conduct regular system health checks and provide proactive maintenance to prevent potential issues.
- Stay updated with the latest technology trends and advancements to enhance support capabilities.
- Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support coverage as required.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- 2+ years of experience in a technical support or help desk role, preferably in an enterprise environment.
- Strong working knowledge of Windows operating systems, networking concepts, and basic server administration.
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
- Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, to interact with customers and colleagues.
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple support cases simultaneously.
- Familiarity with ticketing systems and knowledge base management tools.
- Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and processes.
- Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or similar are preferred.
- Experience with cloud-based technologies and virtualization is an advantage.

postings.title: Lead Consultant - FortiGuard Incident Response
postings.description:
We are looking for a Lead Consultant – FortiGuard Incident Response to work in a dynamic and exciting new position reporting to the Director of Operations for FortiGuard Security Consulting Services. The analyst will work directly with members of a world class incident response and forensics team. Our team is comprised of individuals with strong knowledge in malware hunting and analysis, reverse engineering, multiple scripting languages, forensics and threat actors’ TTPs. In this very hands-on customer facing role the consultant’s main objective is to lead and manage the incident response engagements and train/mentor other security consultants. Leveraging your in-depth understanding of the threat actors’ tactics, techniques, procedures and tools as well as our flagship FortiEDR tooling you will need to quickly glean situational awareness to provide guidance to the team members as well as to the client. In addition, from time to time the candidate will help to create threat research work products such as blogs and presentations. To be successful in this role the candidate must be possess strong consulting skills, deep technical skills and able to work under tight timelines.

Responsibilities:

- Lead IR engagements and mentoring/training junior analysts
- Serve as the primary contact for clients during investigations, delivering clear technical and executive-level updates.
- Continue to focus on process improvement for the customer facing incident response services

- Conduct host-based analysis and forensic functions on Windows, Linux, and Mac OS X systems

- Review firewall, web, database, and other log sources to identify evidence and artifacts of malicious and compromised activity

- Leverage our FortiEDR Platform to conduct investigations to rapidly detect and analyze security threats

- Perform memory forensics and file analysis as needed
- Contribute to threat intelligence consumption and generation within the FortiGuard threat intelligence ecosystem.

- Perform basic reverse engineering of threat actors’ malicious tools

- Develop complete and informative reports and presentations for both executive and technical audience

- Availability during nights/weekends as needed for IR engagements

Required Skills:

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Experience interfacing with customers

- Experience with of at least one scripting language: Shell, Ruby, Perl, Python, etc
- Ability to data mine using YARA, RegEx or other techniques to identify new threats
- Experienced with EnCase, FTK, X-Ways, SIFT, Splunk, Redline, Volatility, WireShark, TCPDump, and open source forensic tools a plus

- Experience with malware analysis tools such as IDA Pro, OllyDbg, Immunity Debugger
- Hands-on experience dealing with APT campaigns, attack Tactics, Techniques and Procedures (TTPs), memory injection techniques, static and dynamic malware analysis and malware persistence mechanism
- Strong knowledge of operating system internals and endpoint security experience.
- Able to communicate with both technical and executive personnel
- Static and dynamics malware and log analysis
- Analysis of Linux and MAC binary files and the understanding of MAC internals is a plus but not required.
- Highly motivated, self-driven and able to work both independently and within a team
- Able to work under pressure in time critical situations and occasional nights and weekends work
- A solid understanding of Active Directory and how to secure is a plus

Education:

- Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field
- Or 10+ years’ experience with incident response and or Forensics

postings.title: Litigation Counsel
postings.description:
Fortinet (NASDAQ: FTNT) is an S&P 500 company and the global leader in cybersecurity technology, protecting the largest enterprise, service provider, and government organizations around the world. Fortinet seeks an experienced, high-energy patent litigator to join our litigation team at our Sunnyvale headquarters.

Fortinet is a market leader in the dynamic cybersecurity industry, securing the world’s largest enterprises and critical infrastructure. With over $6 billion in annual revenue and more than 15,000 employees globally, Fortinet offers the stability of a Fortune 500 company with the innovation and energy of a Silicon Valley technology leader.

We are looking for a motivated self-starter who brings a positive attitude, takes ownership of their responsibilities, and is eager to contribute to Fortinet’s mission of making possible a digital world that we can always trust. If you thrive handling strategic work and day-to-day tasks with equal enthusiasm, this is an exciting opportunity for you.

This is an excellent opportunity for an individual who has impeccable judgment and strong initiative, is strategic and self-motivated and wants to join a dynamic team in a successful Silicon Valley technology company that is determined to maintain its entrepreneurial, fast-paced roots, and yet is large enough to be international and stable.

Only candidates who are confident that they have the following attributes should apply:

- A positive, can-do attitude and the ability to execute and effectively prioritize the highest impact tasks.
- Excellent written and verbal skills.
- Attention to detail.
- Client service orientation and ability to respond quickly and pragmatically to urgent matters.
- Experience in the technology and networking spaces is a plus, but not necessary if there is a willingness to learn.
- Initiative and intelligence to drive and create tangible business value and minimize risk quickly and effectively.
- Passion for the job, an iron gut, and good common sense and business judgment to be able to drive value in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.
- Capacity to add value thinking strategically and to handle a wide range of responsibilities and day-to-day activities.
- Ability to develop creative and sensible solutions to a broad range of complex issues as they arise.
- No-job-too-big, no-job-too-small mentality.
- Ability to responsibly use AI tools to drive positive outcomes efficiently.

The ideal candidate has significant patent litigation experience, including district court litigation and familiarity with PTAB and ITC proceedings. Experience with technology companies or the computer networking industry is a plus. Candidates with backgrounds at premier law firms or in-house patent litigation teams are especially encouraged to apply.

Job duties:

- In concert with Fortinet's Vice President of Litigation and Compliance and executive team, oversee the company’s global litigation portfolio. That portfolio consists mostly of US-based patent litigation, along with employment, securities, general business, and other kinds of litigation around the world.
- Provide strategic guidance to outside counsel.
- Support outside counsel in coordinating discovery, including implementing litigation holds, working with witnesses, and gathering evidence.
- Manage internal responses to subpoenas, statutory records requests, etc.
- Directly negotiate resolution of pre-litigation and early stage litigation disputes independently or with minimal oversight.
- Develop processes and playbooks for a maturing litigation department.
- Control outside legal spend.
- Handle small matters independently, and work on larger matters collaboratively.
- Assist with occasional internal investigations, including but not limited to pre-dispute matters and corporate compliance matters.
- Additional job duties based on experience and ability.
- A Juris Doctor from a nationally recognized law school.
- Admission to applicable state bar.
- Extensive patent litigation experience preferred; a willingness to learn is a minimum.
- A technical background or demonstrated ability to quickly grasp complex technologies is highly valued.
- Flexible for the right fit.

Education and experience required:

- A Juris Doctor from a nationally recognized law school.
- Admission to applicable state bar.
- Extensive patent litigation experience preferred; a willingness to learn is a minimum.

As a Major Accounts Manager, you will play an integral role in new business pitches, hold responsibility for the effective on-boarding of new clients and focus on growing and developing existing customers. Target Accounts

This role is focused specifically on the Big 4 accounting and professional services firms (Deloitte, EY, KPMG and PwC). At Fortinet You Will

- Learn and demonstrate a fundamental understanding of Fortinet’s technology in order to articulate our value proposition to decision-makers within Big 4 firms.

postings.title: Major Account Manager- Communications Service Providers
postings.description:
Position: Major Account Manager (MAM) – Canadian Communications Service Providers (Telco)
Location: Toronto, ON (Hybrid)
Department: Communications Service Providers, Canada
Reports to: VP, Communications Service Providers, Canada

About the Role

Fortinet Canada is seeking a Major Account Manager (MAM) to drive strategic growth and executive engagement with large Canadian Communications Service Providers (CSPs), including Tier-1 telcos. This role requires a strategic, consultative sales leader who thrives in complex enterprise environments, combining business acumen, technical understanding, and executive relationship management to shape the cybersecurity strategy of Canada’s largest network operators. The ideal candidate can operate effectively at the C-level to drive strategic alignment while also executing tactically to deliver measurable results across large, matrixed organizations. As part of Fortinet’s growth-focused team, you will expand our presence within existing CSP accounts while driving new opportunities across Secure Networking, Unified SASE, and AI-driven Security Operations. You will represent one of the industry’s broadest portfolios, our competitive differentiation lies in our core technologies, which provides unprecedented performance, unrivaled security, maximum flexibility, and seamless integration across diverse environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Account Ownership: Develop and execute multi-year account plans that accelerate growth within existing customers and capture new opportunities aligned with partner transformation goals.
• Executive Relationship Management: Build and nurture relationships across business, network, and security leadership levels to position Fortinet as a trusted innovation partner.
• Business Growth: Lead new business pitches, manage renewals, and negotiate complex agreements that drive enterprise-wide adoption of Fortinet solutions and double digit growth.
• Solution Development: Collaborate with internal engineering, product, and marketing teams to design and deliver tailored cybersecurity and managed service proposals.
• Sales Execution: Consistently achieve quarterly and annual sales goals through disciplined pipeline generation, accurate forecasting, and proactive territory planning.
• Market Engagement: Represent Fortinet in key industry forums, customer workshops, and executive reviews to influence market perception and customer direction.
• Leadership and Collaboration: Embody Fortinet’s values of teamwork, openness, and innovation by mentoring peers, contributing to team strategy, and working with a high degree of collaboration across sales, channel, and technical teams.

Required Skills and Experience

• Experience: 10+ years in sales and pre-sales roles within the networking, cybersecurity, or telecommunications industry.
• Proven Success: Demonstrated record of exceeding sales targets and driving growth in enterprise and managed services solutions.
• Account Management: 5–8 years managing Fortune 1000 or large enterprise accounts, preferably within the Canadian telco or service provider segment. Existing executive relationships within Canadian telcos (Bell, Rogers, TELUS, or equivalent) are preferred.
• Technical Acumen: Minimum 3 years selling network security products or managed security services, with exposure to AI-driven security operations considered an asset.
• Communication Skills: Exceptional presentation and storytelling abilities for both executive and technical audiences; strong written and verbal communication.
• Leadership: Goal-oriented, self-motivated professional with strong business acumen, interpersonal influence, and proven success working independently and within a matrix organization.
• Strategic Mindset: Skilled in building business plans and go-to-market strategies that expand market share and accelerate growth.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field required.
• Graduate degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.

Fortinet strives to provide you and your family with a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. We offer competitive Paid Time Off and flexible leave policies, including paid health days, to help you take care of yourself and your family members.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

Fortinet (NASDAQ: FTNT) secures the largest enterprise, service provider, and government organizations around the world. postings.title: Major Account Manager/SASE & SecOps - Public Sector (Central Gov)
postings.description:
Major Account Manager – SASE & SecOps | Central Government

Location: Rome, Italy

Fortinet is seeking a Major Account Manager to drive growth across the Central Government market in Italy, with a specialist focus on SASE and Security Operations (SecOps).

This is a direct, quota-carrying sales role responsible for developing and managing strategic government accounts, creating new business opportunities, and expanding Fortinet’s presence within organisations where cybersecurity, secure access, threat detection, and operational resilience are critical priorities.

The successful candidate will own a portfolio of strategic Central Government accounts and will be responsible for developing account strategies, identifying new opportunities, engaging senior stakeholders, and positioning Fortinet’s SASE, SecOps, and broader cybersecurity solutions to address complex government security requirements.

This role requires an experienced enterprise sales professional with a strong understanding of SASE, Secure Access Service Edge, Zero Trust, Security Operations and related cybersecurity technologies, combined with a proven track record of selling directly to large government organisations.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and execute strategic account plans for assigned Central Government customers, with responsibility for revenue growth, pipeline development, and achievement of sales targets

• Own and deliver a direct sales quota through new business development, account expansion, and strategic opportunity management

• Identify, develop, and close complex sales opportunities across SASE, Secure Access Service Edge, Zero Trust, SecOps, network security, cloud security, and related Fortinet solutions

• Build and maintain strong relationships with senior government stakeholders, including C-level executives, CISOs, CIOs, security leaders, IT decision makers, and procurement stakeholders

• Develop a strong understanding of government security priorities, digital transformation programmes, regulatory requirements, procurement processes, and technology strategies

• Position Fortinet’s SASE and SecOps capabilities against customer requirements, demonstrating clear business and security outcomes

• Manage the complete sales lifecycle, from opportunity creation and qualification through solution development, procurement, negotiation, and contract closure

• Identify opportunities to expand Fortinet’s footprint within existing government accounts through cross-sell and up-sell activities

• Work closely with System Engineers, Solution Specialists, Product teams, Channel teams, and partners to develop compelling technical and commercial propositions

• Lead customer meetings, executive briefings, solution discussions, business reviews, and commercial negotiations

• Develop and maintain accurate account plans, opportunity strategies, pipeline visibility, and sales forecasts

• Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder government sales cycles, including formal procurement processes, tenders, RFPs, and framework agreements

• Collaborate with system integrators, technology partners, and channel organisations to maximise account penetration and support strategic opportunities

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for an experienced enterprise sales professional with a proven track record of selling cybersecurity or related technology solutions directly into Central Government or large public sector organisations.

The ideal candidate will have:

• Proven experience in a direct, quota-carrying enterprise sales role within a technology or cybersecurity vendor

• Strong experience selling into Central Government or large government organisations in Italy

• Demonstrable experience selling or positioning SASE, SSE, Zero Trust, SecOps, SOC, SIEM, SOAR, XDR, network security, cloud security, or related cybersecurity solutions

• Experience managing strategic accounts and complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles

• A strong track record of developing new business, expanding existing accounts, and achieving sales targets

• Experience engaging with senior government, security, IT, and procurement stakeholders

• Good understanding of the evolving security requirements of government organisations, including secure access, network modernisation, cloud adoption, threat detection, and security operations

• Experience managing complex procurement processes, including RFPs, tenders, framework agreements, and public sector purchasing processes

• Experience working collaboratively with System Engineers, solution specialists, system integrators, and channel partners

• Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to understand customer challenges and translate them into compelling cybersecurity and business outcomes

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills

• A consultative sales approach combined with the drive and ability to identify, develop, and close new business

Why Join Us

Fortinet values diversity, inclusivity, and the strength of different perspectives. You will join a collaborative environment where knowledge is shared openly, ambition is supported, and innovation is at the centre of everything we do.

We offer:

• Comprehensive onboarding and continuous development through the Fortinet Training Institute

• The opportunity to work with some of Italy’s largest and most security-conscious government organisations

• Competitive compensation, including stock awards

• A culture that rewards initiative, ownership, and commercial success

• The opportunity to build your career with a global leader in cybersecurity

This role is governed by the applicable CCNL, including its classification, minimum salary levels and pay progression rules, and benefit. In line with EU pay transparency requirements, remuneration is determined based on objective factors, including the relevant National Collective Labor Agreement (CCNL), the specific job profile, and seniority level. The target gross annual salary (RAL - Retribuzione Annua Lorda) for this position is expected to range between €70,000 and €95,000. The exact salary offer will be determined based on the successful candidate’s skills, qualifications, experience, and specific geographic location/work arrangements. We do not request or consider salary history at any stage of the recruitment process.

About Fortinet

Fortinet (NASDAQ: FTNT) secures the largest enterprise, service provider, and government organisations worldwide. Our Security Fabric platform delivers broad, integrated, and high-performance cybersecurity protection across network, application, cloud, and endpoint environments.

With more than 619 registered global patents and over 500,000 customers worldwide, Fortinet continues to drive innovation in cybersecurity and help organisations build secure, resilient digital infrastructures.

If you are a backend expert who wants to solve complex system architecture challenges and dive into the world of ML platforms & Agentic LLM pipelines, this is the role for you - An exciting role collaborating with ML science team, data/infra team and DevOps to drive real customer impact.

As a ML Engineer, you will:

- Lead ML delivery: transforming research output (code, models, ideas) into robust, scalable, low-latency microservices in production

- Design, build, and maintain automated workflows for ML models, including auto-trains, benchmarking, testing, performance gating, and production deployment.

- Tackle complex backend challenges: optimizing API response times, managing database connectivity and concurrency at scale, balancing accuracy’s drive for complex questions with the business needs of fast responsiveness by making hard technical trade-offs between customer gains and business costs.

- Design and optimize data pipelines and ETL processes, connecting our Snowflake data warehouse to our training environments.

- Work within our existing ML infrastructure (Kubeflow, MLflow, KServe) to ensure smooth model lifecycles and performance monitoring.

- Collaborate closely with ML Scientists, guiding them on software engineering best practices without slowing down their research.

- Monitor and optimize production models for performance, cost efficiency, availability, and observability.

- 6+ years of backend software engineering experience designing, building, and maintaining large-scale, high-throughput production systems

- Strong coding skills, Ability to write clean, maintainable code, OOP familiarity, package design, microservices etc.
Note: Work is in python, but strong engineers with deep Java/C# backgrounds who have some Python experience and are willing to transition fully are highly encouraged to apply.

- Solid Database design & SQL skills, Deep understanding of SQL, experience working with relational and/or bigdata (columnar) databases, ORMs, and efficient query design.

- API & Performant Design Proven experience - building robust systems, you understand how to handle concurrency, ETL tradeoffs, building fault-tolerant best effort data flows

Nice-to-Haves (Strong Advantages):

- Previous experience in productionizing Machine Learning models or working closely with Data Science teams.

Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic Named Account Manager-Public Sector to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

As a Named Account Manager Public Sector, you will:

- Play an integral role in new business pitches, foster long-term relationships, act as a catalyst in negotiating business terms to achieve enterprise-wide deployments of Fortinet solutions and deliver meaningful results for all parties involved.

- Effectively on-board new clients and proactively focus on growing and developing existing accounts.

- Generate a robust sales pipeline, qualify opportunities, and provide accurate forecasts.

- Collaborate with internal teams to deliver contract bids, proposals, RFI/RFP responses, and Statements of Work that reflect our commitment to excellence.

- Travel throughout the territory to support the needs of the business.

We Are Looking For:

An insightful and influential collaborator to join our team. We encourage you to apply for this position if you have the following qualities:

- Fully qualified, experienced sales professional that is forward thinking and has a professional understanding of the technology business sector.
- Minimum of 5+ years prior sales experience in Public Sector
- Existing strong relationships at the Sr. Director and CIO/CTO level in the major GTAA hospitals
- Strong understanding of the Ontario Healthcare industry, structure and procurement processes
- Previous experience designing business plans and market strategies to increase sales
- Proven ability to sell Cyber Security / Network solutions
- A proven track record of quota achievement and demonstrated career stability
- Excellent presentation skills to executives & individual contributors
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- A self-motivated, independent thinker that can move deals through the selling cycle
- Results-orientated, Self-starter, Hunter-type mentality.
- Candidate must thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.
- Previous experience in network security. Knowledgeable in the following technologies VPN, Firewall, Anti-Virus, Anti-Spam, Intrusion Prevention, and Content Filtering.

Why Join Us:

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being.

Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 890,000+ customers around the globe.

Fortinet (NASDAQ: FTNT) secures the largest enterprise, service provider, and government organizations around the world. Fortinet empowers its customers with intelligent, seamless protection across the expanding attack surface and the power to take on ever-increasing performance requirements of the borderless network - today and into the future. Only the Fortinet Security Fabric architecture can deliver security without compromise to address the most critical security challenges, whether in networked, application, cloud or mobile environments. Fortinet ranks number one in the most security appliances shipped worldwide and more than 500,000 customers trust Fortinet to protect their businesses.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@fortinet.com.

Fortinet is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity in our company, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, military/veteran status or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

postings.title: Named Accounts Manager - Commercial
postings.description:
Named Account Manager
Location: Israel

As a Named Accounts Manager, you will play an integral role in new business pitches, hold responsibility for the effective on-boarding of new clients and focus on growing and developing existing customers. This exciting role will allow you to use your extensive network to run and grow opportunities, write business and account plans for all current and new business tender opportunities and act as the key interface between the customer and all relevant divisions.

At Fortinet you will

- Learn and demonstrate a fundamental understanding of Fortinet’s technology in order to articulate our value proposition to decision-makers.

- Develop strong relationships with customer contacts up to Executive C-level to gain insight into their business imperatives and IT drivers, enabling development of a strategy to sell Fortinet solutions.

- Sell Fortinet products and services through a consultative selling approach and maintain good relationships with key individuals within the accounts.

- Research customers, identify decision makers, educate prospects and qualify buying interest and sense of urgency.

- Create and implement strategic account plans through a consultative selling approach focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments of Fortinet products and services

- Develop strategies and orchestrate company resources to maximize sales volume within assigned accounts.

- Effectively engage and build cooperative relationships with System Engineers, Channel Managers, and specialist sales team and executives as required.

- Drive quarterly business reviews with customer to ensure value from Fortinet investment.

- Ensures the customer is kept up to date with Fortinet product roadmaps enabling the customer to plan and mitigate risks to their business.

Apply if you

- Have a proven track record of enterprise sales experience in hi-tech industry (preferably Cybersecurity and Networking) developing strategic customer relationships.

- Possess a consistent track record of quota (over) achievement and demonstrated both career stability and growth.

- Are a highly motivated self-starter with a competitive personality, strong attention to detail, and a hunger to win.

- Have exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with excellent listening skills.

- Fluency in English is a must.

- Develop strategies and orchestrate company resources to maximize sales volume within assigned accounts.

postings.title: Named Acct Manager - Hungary
postings.description:
Named Account Manager

As a Public Sector Named Accounts Manager, you will play an integral role on growing and developing existing customers and hold responsibility for the effective on-boarding of new clients. This exciting role will allow you to use your extensive network to run and grow opportunities, write business and account plans for all current and new business tender opportunities and act as the key interface between the customer and all relevant divisions.

At Fortinet you will

- Learn and demonstrate a fundamental understanding of Fortinet’s technology in order to articulate our value proposition to decision-makers.
- Develop strong relationships with customer contacts up to Executive C-level to gain insight into their business imperatives and IT drivers, enabling development of a strategy to sell Fortinet solutions.
- Sell Fortinet products and services through a consultative selling approach and maintain good relationships with key individuals within the accounts.
- Research customers, identify decision makers, educate prospects and qualify buying interest and sense of urgency.
- Create and implement strategic account plans through a consultative selling approach focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments of Fortinet products and services
- Develop strategies and orchestrate company resources to maximize sales volume within assigned accounts.
- Effectively engage and build cooperative relationships with System Engineers, Channel Managers, and specialist sales team and executives as required.
- Drive quarterly business reviews with customer to ensure value from Fortinet investment.
- Ensures the customer is kept up to date with Fortinet product roadmaps enabling the customer to plan and mitigate risks to their business.

Apply if you

- Have a proven track record of public sector sales experience in hi-tech industry (preferably Cybersecurity and Networking) developing strategic customer relationships.
- Possess a consistent track record of quota (over) achievement and demonstrated both career stability and growth.
- Are a highly motivated self-starter with a competitive personality, strong attention to detail, and a hunger to win.
- Have exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with excellent listening skills.

From the start, the Fortinet vision has been to deliver broad, truly integrated, high-performance security across the IT infrastructure. Today, we secure the largest enterprises, service providers and government organizations around the world.

Fortinet empowers its customers with intelligent, seamless protection across the expanding attack surface and the power to take on ever-increasing performance requirements of the borderless network – today and into the future. We have proven to be a truly innovative technology driven network security company with over 619 registered Global Patents. This is over 3 times more than our closest most innovative competitor!

Why Join Us:

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being.

Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000+ customers around the globe.

postings.title: Named Regional Account Manager
postings.description:
Fortinet is at the center of one of the most important shifts in enterprise technology: the convergence of cybersecurity, networking, cloud, and AI. As organizations race to adopt AI responsibly, they need a partner that can deliver both AI for Security and Security for AI. Fortinet is uniquely positioned to lead in this moment through our broad platform, deep innovation, and proven customer outcomes.

We are seeking a Named Regional Account Manager (NRAM) to lead the marquee Silicon Valley Mid-Enterprise territory with a strong customer base and significant growth potential. This is a true field sales role for a strategic seller who can deepen relationships, expand platform adoption, lead complex customer conversations, and drive larger, multi-product opportunities.

The ideal candidate has field sales experience in B2B technology, knows how to command a room, and can run customer engagements from first meeting to close. This seller should be equally comfortable prospecting into new accounts/divisions, expanding existing accounts, coordinating internal resources, and managing sophisticated negotiations with senior decision-makers (i.e., VP+ & C suite).

What You’ll Do

- Own, grow, and establish relationships in a set of Mid-Enterprise accounts within the Silicon Valley territory.
- Develop and execute strategic account plans that increase wallet share, multi-product adoption, and long-term customer value.
- Lead customer engagements from beginning to end, including executive outreach, discovery, solution alignment, evaluation strategy, commercial negotiation, and close.
- Conduct in-person meetings in the field, with the expectation that most customer meetings occur onsite in customer offices and in the field.
- Drive both expansion within existing accounts and new logo development across the territory.
- Build strong relationships across technical teams, IT leadership, security leadership, procurement, and executive buyers.
- Identify and advance complex sales opportunities, including larger platform deals and multi-year agreements.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with SEs, Channel Account Managers, partners, distributors, and leadership to drive coordinated account execution.
- Forecast with accuracy and consistency, maintaining strong pipeline hygiene and clear visibility into deal progression.
- Navigate customer priorities tied to cloud transformation, hybrid work, secure networking, cyber resilience, and AI adoption.
- Generate, manage, and accurately forecast pipeline on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis.
- Identify and advance opportunities across Fortinet’s broader platform, including network security, secure networking, cloud, SASE, SecOps, and other strategic initiatives.
- Position Fortinet’s value in business terms, helping customers consolidate vendors, reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and secure innovation.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to customers while executing with urgency, professionalism, and strong commercial discipline.

What We’re Looking For

- 2–3+ years of field sales experience in B2B technology sales.
- Proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a field-based sales role.
- Ability to run polished, productive customer meetings and full discovery conversations independently.
- Experience managing opportunities from prospecting through close, including forecasting, deal strategy, and contract negotiation.
- Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate with both technical and business stakeholders.
- Experience expanding existing accounts, managing strategic territories, and growing deal size over time.
- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously.
- Familiarity with channel-led sales motions and partner collaboration.
- Bachelor’s degree preferred.
- Experience in cybersecurity, networking, and/or public/private cloud is strongly preferred.

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $200,000 - $220,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

postings.title: Named Regional Account Manager
postings.additional_locations: San Jose, CA, United States; Sunnyvale, CA, United States
postings.description:
Fortinet is at the center of one of the most important shifts in enterprise technology: the convergence of cybersecurity, networking, cloud, and AI. As organizations race to adopt AI responsibly, they need a partner that can deliver both AI for Security and Security for AI. Fortinet is uniquely positioned to lead in this moment through our broad platform, deep innovation, and proven customer outcomes.

We are seeking a Named Regional Account Manager (NRAM) to lead the marquee Silicon Valley Mid-Enterprise territory with a strong customer base and significant growth potential. This is a true field sales role for a strategic seller who can deepen relationships, expand platform adoption, lead complex customer conversations, and drive larger, multi-product opportunities.

The ideal candidate has field sales experience in B2B technology, knows how to command a room, and can run customer engagements from first meeting to close. This seller should be equally comfortable prospecting into new accounts/divisions, expanding existing accounts, coordinating internal resources, and managing sophisticated negotiations with senior decision-makers (i.e., VP+ & C suite).

What You’ll Do

- Own, grow, and establish relationships in a set of Mid-Enterprise accounts within the Silicon Valley territory.
- Develop and execute strategic account plans that increase wallet share, multi-product adoption, and long-term customer value.
- Lead customer engagements from beginning to end, including executive outreach, discovery, solution alignment, evaluation strategy, commercial negotiation, and close.
- Conduct in-person meetings in the field, with the expectation that most customer meetings occur onsite in customer offices and in the field.
- Drive both expansion within existing accounts and new logo development across the territory.
- Build strong relationships across technical teams, IT leadership, security leadership, procurement, and executive buyers.
- Identify and advance complex sales opportunities, including larger platform deals and multi-year agreements.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with SEs, Channel Account Managers, partners, distributors, and leadership to drive coordinated account execution.
- Forecast with accuracy and consistency, maintaining strong pipeline hygiene and clear visibility into deal progression.
- Navigate customer priorities tied to cloud transformation, hybrid work, secure networking, cyber resilience, and AI adoption.
- Generate, manage, and accurately forecast pipeline on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis.
- Identify and advance opportunities across Fortinet’s broader platform, including network security, secure networking, cloud, SASE, SecOps, and other strategic initiatives.
- Position Fortinet’s value in business terms, helping customers consolidate vendors, reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and secure innovation.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to customers while executing with urgency, professionalism, and strong commercial discipline.

What We’re Looking For

- 2–3+ years of field sales experience in B2B technology sales.
- Proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a field-based sales role.
- Ability to run polished, productive customer meetings and full discovery conversations independently.
- Experience managing opportunities from prospecting through close, including forecasting, deal strategy, and contract negotiation.
- Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate with both technical and business stakeholders.
- Experience expanding existing accounts, managing strategic territories, and growing deal size over time.
- Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously.
- Familiarity with channel-led sales motions and partner collaboration.
- Bachelor’s degree preferred.
- Experience in cybersecurity, networking, and/or public/private cloud is strongly preferred.

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $200,000 - $220,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic Regional Named Account Manager to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

As a Regional Named Accounts Manager, you will:

Drive direct sales engagements into a set of Regional Accounts within your assigned territory.

- Create and implement territory plans to achieve deployments of Fortinet solutions to a set of assigned, existing accounts and new logo prospects, within your assigned territory.

- Generate a robust sales pipeline, qualify opportunities, and provide accurate forecasts.

- Develop executive relationships with key buyers and influencers and leverage these relationships to achieve quarterly sales goals.

- The Regional Named Account Manager is required to regularly work outside of their office or home office engaged in selling, including travel as needed to make a sale and support the needs of the business.

- Build and promote the Company’s position as the worldwide leader in Unified Threat Management.

We Are Looking For:

An insightful and influential collaborator to join our team. We encourage you to apply for this position if you have the following qualities:

- Experience in selling network security solutions and services to commercial and complex organizations

- Ability to move deals through the sales cycle, with a proven record of accomplishment of closing large deals and exceeding targets/quotas.

- Strong presentation, influencing, and cultural fluency skills effective for executive audiences.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- 3+ years of experience selling to Named Accounts within the B2B technology space.

Education:

BS or equivalent experience

Fortinet makes possible a digital world that we can always trust through its mission to protect people, devices, and data everywhere. This is why the world’s largest enterprises, service providers, and government organizations choose Fortinet to securely accelerate their digital journey. The Fortinet Security Fabric platform delivers broad, integrated, and automated protections across the entire digital attack surface, securing critical devices, data, applications, and connections from the data center to the cloud to the home office. Ranking #1 in the most security appliances shipped worldwide, more than 615,000 customers trust Fortinet to protect their businesses. And the Fortinet NSE Training Institute, an initiative of Fortinet’s Training Advancement Agenda (TAA), provides one of the largest and broadest training programs in the industry to make cyber training and new career opportunities available to everyone.

postings.title: Network Engineer
postings.description:
This is a newly created position to help meet the IT needs of Fortinet’s rapidly growing workforce. With over 15,000 people worldwide (and growing) and the implementation of new IT systems, we are looking for a beginner-to-intermediate-level Network Engineer to help us ensure 24x7 network support. In this critical role you will be based at Fortinet Headquarters at Sunnyvale, California and support our global distribution of network and server systems. This is an excellent opportunity to join a network security company and utilize the latest systems and equipment to support our network availability.

Responsibilities:

- Work under the guidance of senior network engineers to deploy new communication network for Fortinet current/new offices within the USA.
- Execute initial configurations of Fortigates, FortiSwitches, console servers, network PDUs, monitoring devices, etc.
- Install and upgrade network hardware; configure firewall policies.
- Gathering information, documenting, and updating network topologies.
- Ordering network devices, rack-mounting, and cabling.
- Respond, troubleshoot and resolve first-level support requests
- Coordinates and communicates with users
- Participate in an on-call rotation for support of systems outside of normal business hours
- Travels about 7 times per year within the US to assist with deployment and maintenance of Fortinet offices networks.

Skills and requirements:

- Understanding of networking hardware and infrastructure
- Experience with network devices installation and network physical connections
- Very good understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 network protocols
- Fortinet NSE 4 certification is a requirement for this position
- Other certifications in network engineering are a plus
- Strong multi-tasking abilities
- Excellent teamwork, can-do attitude, and communication skills with end-users are essential.
- Excellent English oral and written.

Education:

AA/BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering (or equivalent education and experience)

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. Earnings for this position are expected to be $89,000 - $140,000. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.
