postings.title: Network Performance Security and Preproduction Tester -6 month Internship
postings.description:
Project 1 6 Month internship (office based in our Sophia Antipolis office, Valbonne)

**Ideally, applicants will already hold a Fortinet certification (such as NSE4), or be willing to obtain this certification before the internship commences as part of the interview process, or hold an equivalent vendor certification.**

Role Overview:
-We conduct rigorous performance testing of our hardware and software using industry-leading traffic generators, including Keysight BreakingPoint, VIAVI Avalanche, and CyberFlood. We utilize a custom automation framework to execute these tests and publish results for our Systems Engineering (SE) community.

-Our standard methodology begins with a goal-seeking phase to identify the peak performance threshold (the "best value"). Once established, we validate this result by running additional tests at -10% and +10% load increments to ensure stability and accuracy.

The Challenge:
-Upgrading testing tools often introduces regressions in our automation scripts or inconsistencies in performance metrics. To address this, we need to develop a pre-production environment on Virtual Machines (VMs). This environment will act as a regression suite to validate tool upgrades by comparing new results against baseline data at identical load levels.

Technical Requirements:
-Virtualization : experience deploying and managing pre-production environments using KVM, ESXi, or Proxmox.
-Networking Expertise: Deep understanding of L2 switching, routing protocols, and L4-L7 protocols (IPv4/v6, TCP, UDP) to interpret test results accurately.
-System Monitoring: Mastery of Linux system diagnostic tools like mpstat, top, and htop to analyze hardware behavior under load.
-Development & language/scripting: Strong scripting and Python skills for environment deployment are required.
-Performance Standards: Experience with RFC 2544 or RFC 9411 (benchmarking methodology) using Spirent, Keysight, or VIAVI tools is a significant plus.

Education:
Current student in Computer Science or a related technical field.
Professional proficiency in English.

#LI-NC1

postings.title: Network Security Engineer
postings.description:
Office based in our Sophia Antipolis (Valbonne, France) office 4 days per week or Kelsterbach (Frankfurt- Germany)

Senior Network Security Engineer

About the Role

We're seeking an experienced network security engineer to build, operate, and scale our SASE architecture, encompassing both logical and physical infrastructure managed through Infrastructure as Code leveraging both Fortinet products and Linux (OpenStack) systems. You'll work across network architecture, security operations, and automation-designing solutions, driving incident resolution, and implementing systemic improvements to prevent recurrence.

This role includes participation in a 24x7 NOC on-call rotation and requires some staffed weekend coverage.

What You'll Do

- Maintain network architectures across datacenter environments (logical & physical)
- Build and optimize network monitoring and observability systems
- Develop automation to detect, mitigate, and remediate network events and solve problems
- Perform root cause analysis and drive issues to resolution
- Maintain documentation and operational consistency across the infrastructure
- Contribute to technical discussions and long-range capacity planning
- Provide support to internal teams as a top-tier escalation point for all production issues

What You Bring

Networking (8+ years)

- Expert-level hands-on experience with L2 switching, IP routing, and protocols (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VRRP, STP, GRE, IPsec, SNMP)
- Large-scale BGP experience: public ASNs, peering, route arbitration, IRRs

Network Security (8+ years)

- Access control, threat management (vulnerabilities, malware, APTs, botnets)
- SSL inspection, content categorization, security/risk frameworks
- Fortinet product experience strongly preferred

Linux & Infrastructure (5+ years)

- Administration of RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu
- Web servers, SQL databases, LDAP, etc.
- OpenStack experience a plus (RHOSP/RHOSO preferred)

General

- Strong troubleshooting instincts and documentation habits
- Comfortable working independently in a ticket queue environment
- Clear communicator who can context-switch between deep technical work and stakeholder updates

Nice to Have

- Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, Azure)
- Infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible)
- Load balancing and DDoS mitigation at scale
- Certifications: NSE7/8, CCIE R&S, RHCSA/RHCE

Fluency in English essential + business level of local language highly desirable

Must be prepared to work 1 weekend day and oncall infrequently

#LI-NC1

postings.title: Network Security QA Engineer
postings.description:
Fortinet is looking for Network Security QA Engineer to join the EMEA Customer Readiness Testing team in Sophia Antipolis Technical Assistance Centre, France. This is a technical role, delivering post-sales testing service to key customers.

The Customer Readiness Testing team performs tests designed to specifically replicate the customer environment in which the Fortinet products are used with the end goal to improve the confidence in our released software builds.

The position requires candidates with strong experience in network security (preferably in technical support or QA role) and, based on testing requirements and customer data, the ability to set up testing environments, to define and execute test cases, and to detail the test results in service reports delivered to customers.

The position entails an excellent ability to clearly write all detailed information and to understand and interpret written information.

- Implementation of customer projects - Testing of Fortinet products deployed in production environments - following the CRT processes

- Thorough understanding of the testing requirements and customer information detailed in the project proposal

- Writing project related documents (Topologies, Test Plan, Methods of Procedures) with any required technical architecture diagrams

- Provisioning of the System Under Test to reproduce the customer environment on CRT Data Center equipment

- Configuring the traffic generators (FortiTester / Spirent / Ixia) to simulate traffic alike the traffic monitored in customer production environment

- Define and execute some test cases based on the testable requirements

- Technical investigation of problems involving Fortinet products

- Follow-up with R&D departments to resolve product issues

- Documenting all test results in a test report to deliver and present to customer at the end of CRT campaign

- Administration of Traffic Generators (FortiTester / Spirent / Ixia)

- Improve and maintain CRT application flows catalog

- Provide post-mortem TG usage experience and update TG database

- Vendor relationship with feature requests and product enhancement

- Follow up actuality and propose new solutions emerging in the application simulation world

- Provide support to customer projects by handling JIRA TG incidents/issues until resolution

- Interface with vendor support and follow up external tickets and escalations

- Participating in SDN development

- Creation of technical documentation and bulletins to improve Fortinet CSS and CRT knowledge bases

- Develop core competency on Fortinet’s product line and technologies

- Work closely with Support organizations

- Proficient spoken and written English

- Strong understanding of data networking protocols, specifically TCP/IP, routing and switching is required

- Very good presentation and technical documentation skills

- Good troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to problem solving

- Strong knowledge of application and security testing tools for physical network infrastructure (Spirent and/or Ixia network and security traffic generators)

OT System Engineer – Germany

Location: Germany

Languages: German / Fluent English

We are looking for a Systems Engineer working in a dedicated German OT overlay team, mainly with our sales representatives on OT accounts and as well with the channel representatives to grow the Fortinet OT partner landscape across Germany. The OT Systems Engineer's main mission will be to support the sales, presales and channel organization in all OT technical matters regarding PoC’s, pre-sales, sales calls and post-sales. The Systems Engineer's mission will be to enable industrial organizations to validate cyber security design solutions presented to the Sales and Systems Engineering Organization as a Reference Architecture (RA) to build their business from within these target clients. The Systems Engineer will also support the Global compliance, laws, regulations, etc. of these Operational Technology & Critical Infrastructure systems by mapping these criteria’s back to our Fortinet products.

Your Role

This position is part of the German Sales Organization at Fortinet. As a trusted technical advisor, you will work closely with prospective and existing customers to understand their business and technical requirements and demonstrate how Fortinet’s Security Fabric addresses their security challenges. You will design and deliver persuasive technical presentations, product demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) that clearly articulate Fortinet’s value and differentiation.

You will collaborate closely with sales teams, partners, and fellow systems engineers, as well as with solution architects, consulting systems engineers, and other internal stakeholders, building long-term relationships based on trust, expertise, and shared success.

You will play a key role in winning strategic customers, accelerating deal cycles through technical leadership, and helping organizations build secure, scalable architectures with Fortinet solutions.

What You Will Do

Product Demonstrations: Deliver engaging, informative, and customer-focused demonstrations that showcase Fortinet’s market-leading technology and innovation.

Training & Workshops: Conduct technical enablement sessions—online and on-site—for Fortinet partners, helping them deepen their technical expertise and successfully position Fortinet solutions.

Proof of Concepts (PoCs): Support the planning, setup, and execution of PoCs using Fortinet solutions, ensuring technical success, and strengthening customer confidence in Fortinet as the best security platform on the market.

Technical Sales Enablement: Ensure that sales teams are equipped with the latest technical knowledge, best practices, and competitive insights to succeed in customer engagements.

Enjoying What You Do: Pre-Sales Systems Engineering at Fortinet is a highly respected and rewarding role. You will work with cutting-edge technology, solve meaningful security challenges, and be part of a high-performing, collaborative team.

What We Offer

Flexibility & Hybrid Work: This role is primarily home-office based in Germany, with access to Fortinet offices in Frankfurt, Munich, and Hamburg. You will typically support customers and partners within your region. Fortinet supports flexible working models and trusts employees to manage their time responsibly, enabling a healthy work–life balance.

Structured Onboarding & Continuous Learning: Fortinet invests heavily in your success. You will benefit from a comprehensive onboarding program, structured enablement sessions, mentorship, and continuous access to industry-leading technical training and Fortinet certification programs throughout your career.

Your Profile

Technical Curiosity & Security Mindset: Strong interest in IT security and a desire to continuously grow in a dynamic, fast-evolving industry.

Relevant Experience: Hands-on experience in networking and/or IT security gained at a vendor, system integrator, service provider, consulting firm, or within an enterprise IT environment. Experience in pre-sales is valuable, but technically strong engineers with customer-facing ambition are also encouraged to apply.

Strong Communication Skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and convincingly. Approximately 80% of customer interactions will be conducted in German and 20% in English; fluency in both languages is required.

Consultative Approach: You act as a trusted advisor, combining deep technical expertise with a strong customer focus and the ability to position Fortinet’s differentiation against competing solutions.

Willingness to Travel: You enjoy engaging directly with customers, partners, and the wider security community—whether at customer sites, partner events, or industry conferences.

Innovation & Growth Mindset: You thrive in an innovative environment and want to actively contribute to Fortinet’s continued successs.

Key Skills

- 3-5 years’ hands-on experience, as well as technical operations, of the Operational Technology/Industrial Control Systems/Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition environments (ICS & SCADA systems, PLCs & RTUs, HMI & Historian, Smart sensors & actuators)
- 3-5 years’ experience dealing with industrial clients within one or more of the following sub-industries (Power, O&G, Manufacturing, transportation & logistics, or Smart Buildings)
- 4 - 6 years’ experience in technical/pre-sales support as a sales and/or systems engineer
- 4 - 6 years’ experience in LAN/WAN/Internet services administration
- Knowledge of the key Industrial Security Policies, Standards, and Guidelines (IEC 62443, NIST CSF, CIS Top 20, ISO 27XXX, NERC-CIP)
- Familiarity with the common industrial protocols (EthernetIP, Modbus, DNP3 & IEC 104, OPC, …)Strong understanding of DNS and NFS, SMTP, HTTP, TCP/IP
- Knowledge of the following technologies: Routing, Switching, VPN, LAN, WAN, Network Security, Intrusion Detection, and Anti Virus.
- Strong understanding in the following technologies and protocols: RADIUS, PKI, IKE, Certificates, L2TP, IPSEC, FIREWALL, 802.1Q, MD5, SSH, SSL, SHA1, DES, 3DES
- Experience with encryption and authentication technologies required

postings.title: Presales Security Expert-Communications Service Providers
postings.description:
Fortinet Canada is seeking a PreSales Security Expert to support direct (Sell-to) engagements with Canadian Communications Service Providers, working in close alignment with a Major Account Manager (MAM).

This role supports both the internal enterprise (corporate) security environments of the service provider and the service provider’s network infrastructure and operational environments, requiring the ability to operate effectively across enterprise security architectures and carrier-grade network infrastructures.

The ideal candidate is a hybrid SE who can address traditional enterprise use cases (NGFW, SASE, ZTNA, SSE) while also understanding the scale, performance, availability, and operational requirements unique to service provider networks, and can translate between business, security, and network infrastructure teams.

Scope of Responsibility – Enterprise & Service Provider Networks

This role spans two interconnected domains within CSP accounts:

Enterprise / Corporate Network Scope

- Internal IT and corporate security environments of the service provider
- Enterprise security architectures including NGFW, SASE, ZTNA, and secure access
- User, application, and data protection use cases

Service Provider Network & Infrastructure Scope

- Core, aggregation, and edge network infrastructure operated by the CSP
- Network-scale security services supporting large traffic volumes and high availability
- Operational environments such as NOCs, service platforms, and shared infrastructure

The successful candidate can context-switch seamlessly between these domains and help customers align enterprise security needs with service provider network realities.

Key Responsibilities

- Strategic Technical Ownership: Partner with the aligned MAM to develop and execute multi-year technical strategies and account plans aligned with customer transformation initiatives and Fortinet growth objectives.
- Customer Technical Engagement: Act as the primary technical point of contact for assigned CSP accounts, engaging with network, security, cloud, and operations teams to understand requirements and influence architectural decisions.
- Solution Architecture & Design: Design end-to-end architectures for complex service provider environments, including large-scale networks, hybrid/multi-cloud, managed security services, and enterprise customer offerings.
- Sales Support & Execution: Support all technical aspects of the sales cycle including discovery, solution positioning, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts (PoCs), technical validation, and deal closure.
- Executive & Architectural Influence: Confidently present Fortinet’s technical vision and differentiation to senior technical leaders and executives through workshops, whiteboarding sessions, and executive briefings.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Fortinet teams, specialist overlays, marketing, and services to build compelling, differentiated solutions tailored to CSP requirements.
- Competitive Differentiation: Maintain deep awareness of the competitive landscape and articulate Fortinet’s advantages in performance, integration, scalability, and operational efficiency.
- Pipeline & Forecast Support: Provide technical input to pipeline development, opportunity qualification, and forecasting accuracy in partnership with the MAM.
- Operational Excellence: Maintain accurate technical opportunity data, activities, and account information in Salesforce and other internal systems.

Required Skills and Experience

- Experience: 7–10+ years in a PreSales / Systems Engineering role within networking, cybersecurity, telecommunications, or service provider environments.
- Service Provider Expertise: Strong understanding of CSP architectures, including large-scale routing and switching, WAN, data center, cloud connectivity, and security services.
- Security Knowledge: Solid experience with network security technologies such as NGFW, IPS, VPN, DDoS protection, Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, and security operations platforms.
- Sales Alignment: Proven experience supporting direct enterprise sales teams, working closely with account managers to drive technical wins and long-term account growth.
- Communication Skills: Strong ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences; confident presenter in customer-facing and executive settings.
- Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to analyze customer challenges, design scalable solutions, and adapt approaches in complex, matrixed environments.
- Autonomy & Collaboration: Self-driven professional comfortable working independently while collaborating across sales, engineering, and leadership teams.

Technical Skills (Desired)

- Deep understanding of CSP fundamentals:
- Carrier-grade networking concepts such as high availability, redundancy, traffic scale, and network segmentation
- Routing & Switching, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLANs
- Firewalling, IPsec, SSL VPN, Zero Trust, SASE
- Authentication & encryption concepts (PKI, RADIUS, certificates)

- Experience with one or more of the following is an asset:
- Managed Security Services (MSSP) enablement
- Cloud security (public or private cloud)
- Large-scale PoCs or lab environments
- AI-driven security operations or automation
- Familiarity with multi-tenant environments and service-based architectures

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
- Industry certifications (Fortinet, networking, or security) are an asset.

Fortinet strives to provide you and your family with a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. postings.title: Principal AI Security Engineer
postings.description:
Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere.

Fortinet is seeking an experienced and innovative Principal AI Security Engineer to join our Corporate Information Security team. As an AI Security Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the security, safety, and privacy of our AI-driven applications while collaborating with cross-functional teams and providing technical expertise.

Key Responsibilities:

- Serve as an AI security subject matter expert who provides guidance to internal teams
- Work closely with development teams, conduct code reviews, perform AI Red Teaming assessments, to identify vulnerabilities in existing codes and new features, and participate in architectural reviews to ensure security is considered early in the development lifecycle.
- Perform threat modeling for AI-related products, such as chatbots, MCPs implementations, and autonomous agents.
- Integrate Security and AI-Specific checks into CI/CD workflows to automate security testing and ensure consistent application of best practices.
- Develop, implement, and communicate vulnerability mitigation strategies
- Develop strategies, evaluate solutions, design and implement tools, processes and controls to ensure that security, safety and privacy are designed in Fortinet AI applications.
- Develop and maintain security guardrails, input/output filters, and policy enforcement layers for LLM interactions
- Proactively research new attack vectors on AI applications that may affect Fortinet applications and infrastructure.
- Be part of a global distributed team to share knowledge, workload and assignments. Strong sense of teamwork is required. Coach peers in AI/ML security concepts and best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

- 7+ years of work experience as an Information security, product security, application security, AI/ML or data science related fields.
- Strong understanding on LLM Based Application architectures, technologies, frameworks, and foundational concepts like training, vector databases, memory, tool usage, MCP, Agentic AI, Guardrails etc.
- Solid understanding on current attacks on ML models, including adversarial examples, prompt injection, training data extraction, model extraction, and data poisoning.
- Solid understanding on LLM moderation, prompt engineering and guardrails.
- Strong understanding on OWASP TOP 10 and OWASP LLM Top 10 risks.
- Strong understanding of common API security risks
- Strong understanding on Cloud-Native application architecture, microservices, containerization technologies, secure deployment and implementation issues.
- Proven experience in manual application penetration testing
- Proven experience in security code review
- Strong foundation in computer and network security, authentication & authorization, security protocols and applied cryptography
- Solid understanding on CI/CD pipelines, build systems and DevSecOps principles.
- Experience defining security architecture patterns and standards in a large enterprise organization.
- Experience with cloud-based security solutions and familiarity with cloud service providers, particularly in relation to AI Security
- Experience working with threat modeling methodologies such as STRIDE, MAESTRO etc.
- Solid understanding of OAuth and JWT implementations.
- Ability to organize & communicate effectively, both written and verbal, with technical and non-technical people across functional teams
- A BS degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, other tech-related degree, or equivalent experience.

Ways to Stand Out

- MS or PhD in, Artificial Intelligence or related field
- Experience in AI Red teaming or adversarial testing of AI/ML applications.
- Use of AI in vulnerability research or some other offensive domain
- Experience analyzing AI-generated code for security issues
- Demonstrated experience in MLops or Deep learning related infrastructure
- Understanding of data science, statistical analysis, and visualization
- Background of AI Trust principles and familiarity with application of ethical and safety perspectives to AI implementations.
- Strong understanding on EU AI Act, GDPR, ISO 42001 or NIST AI RMF like frameworks.

This position is fully onsite and requires regular attendance at our Sunnyvale, CA location. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not available for this role.

About Our Team:

Join our team, known for its collaborative ethos, working seamlessly with global customers, internal engineering teams and product development groups. Our team culture emphasizes continuous learning, innovation, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. We embrace Fortinet’s core values of openness, teamwork and innovation, fostering an environment where team members support each other, share knowledge, and leverage AI to solve complex technical challenges. Our inclusive and dynamic team thrives on collaboration and is driven by the shared goal of maintaining Fortinet’s high standards of excellence in cybersecurity solutions.

Why Join Us:

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being. Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000+ customers around the globe.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $170,000-$225,000. Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time, as well as a comprehensive leave program.

You will be working alongside a closely-knit cross-functional team of experienced software, hardware, and ASIC engineers.

· Build and maintain comprehensive test environments, test suites, and verification infrastructure to validate ASIC driver and networking software functionality, performance, and reliability.

· Lead cross-team technical initiatives and align stakeholders across engineering functions on verification strategy, priorities, and roadmap.
· Lead hiring and growth of the verification organization across the program, raising the technical bar through mentorship and code reviews.
· Champion innovation in verification methodology, tooling, and process improvements across the teams you lead.
· Contribute to the overall technical direction of the verification platform, including tooling strategy, technology selection, and long-term roadmap for the product area.

· Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
· 12 to 15 years of professional software development or verification engineering experience.
· Strong proficiency in Ruby and Python, with a proven track record of building and maintaining automation frameworks and tooling.
· Solid understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching, and firewalls.

· Familiarity with advanced networking protocols, security concepts, and DevOps/tooling practices.

· Strong communications skills, and ability to work in a collaborative cross-functional environment.
· Ability to take ownership of complex projects, work with minimal supervision, and research and master new technologies quickly.

· Experience developing and owning verification frameworks and test automation platforms at scale.
· Experience building and maintaining ASIC driver software or kernel-space code in C.
· Experience in using Viavi (Spirent TestCenter, Avalanche) or Keysight (Ixia, Breaking Point) traffic generators.
· Experience contributing to open-source networking or Linux kernel projects.
· Track record of driving technical decisions, setting verification standards, and influencing the direction of multiple teams.

- Protocols & Networking: BGP, OSPF, LACP, STP/RSTP/MSTP, ARP, DNS, IPsec, IPv6, TLS, multicast, VXLAN, GRE, SD-WAN, QoS (Quality of Service)
- Security: Cryptography fundamentals, mTLS, PKI/certificate management, network security protocols
- DevOps: Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipeline design, infrastructure as code, test automation at scale
- Performance & Tools: network packet analyzers (e.g., Wireshark), benchmark testing, building tools to generate traffic

postings.title: Professional Services Consultant - Melbourne
postings.description:
Location: Australia (Melbourne)

Fortinet Professional Services ANZ delivers the design, deployment and operationalisation of the Fortinet Security Fabric for our largest enterprise, government and service provider customers. This role is a senior billable consulting position based in Melbourne, focused on operational technology (OT) and critical infrastructure security delivery.

You will own the technical delivery of your engagements end to end: scope through design, build, cutover, testing, knowledge transfer and formal closure. You will work directly with customer architects and operations teams, and you will be expected to hold the line on design quality and delivery standards when a project is under pressure. Some engagements will be delivered as an embedded Resident Engineer with a single strategic customer for an extended period.

The consultant is expected to function as a peer to the ANZ Sales Engineering organisation. Pre-sales teams define the solution direction and secure customer approval; this role assumes ownership from that point onward, converting architecture into a production-ready design and successfully delivering the outcome to the customer.

As a Professional Services Consultant, you will:

Delivery

- Lead the technical delivery of Fortinet Professional Services engagements onsite and remotely, from requirements capture through to signed work completion.
- Translate customer requirements into a documented low level design that is reviewable, defensible and aligned to Fortinet best practice, rather than assembled at the console.
- Deploy, configure, migrate, cut over, test and troubleshoot Fortinet solutions in complex production environments, including out of hours change windows.
- Run structured knowledge transfer and handover so the customer operates the solution without ongoing dependency on the consultant who built it.
- Identify and escalate scope change, risk and blockers early and in writing. Scope is changed through the agreed variation process, never absorbed silently into the engagement.

Technical Leadership

- Act as the senior OT security reference point for the ANZ Professional Services team, including design review and second opinion on peer engagements.
- Mentor and uplift less experienced consultants through paired delivery, design walkthroughs and structured feedback, not ad hoc assistance.
- Contribute reusable delivery assets: design templates, build guides, test plans, migration runbooks and technical notes that reduce the cost of the next engagement.
- Interface with Sales Engineering, TAC, Product Management and Fortinet technology partners, and distribute that knowledge back into the ANZ team.

Commercial and Governance Discipline

- Maintain accurate, same-week time recording in Changepoint against the correct project and task. Billable utilisation is a measured accountability of this role.
- Produce and secure the artefacts that close an engagement: Statement of Work input, milestone evidence, signed Work Completion form, knowledge transfer record and customer satisfaction survey.
- Provide clear, written project status to the Fortinet project manager and management line. Verbal updates do not constitute reporting.
- Operate to the published Fortinet PS ANZ Operating Standard on conduct, delivery quality and commercial compliance.

Core Technical Baseline (Required)

Deep, hands-on, production-grade capability across the following is the entry requirement for this role. Familiarity is not sufficient.

- OT and industrial control system security: Design and delivery of security controls in operational technology and industrial control environments, including Purdue model zone and conduit segmentation, IT to OT boundary and DMZ design, passive asset discovery and visibility, and secure remote access for vendors, integrators and plant support.
- Industrial protocols and OT enforcement: Working knowledge of Modbus TCP, DNP3, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, PROFINET, EtherNet/IP and OPC UA, and enforcement using FortiGate and FortiSwitch Rugged platforms and the FortiGuard OT Security Service, including industrial IPS and application control signatures.
- OT standards and safe delivery practice: Application of IEC 62443, the Security of Critical Infrastructure Act and the AESCSF to control selection, together with OT-safe change control, outage and maintenance window planning, and the ability to work alongside plant, engineering, process and safety teams.
- FortiGate: Enterprise firewall and next generation firewall design, deployment and migration at scale, including HA design, VDOMs, policy consolidation and vendor-to-Fortinet migrations.
- Routing and switching: Advanced routing (BGP, OSPF, policy based routing), switching, VLANs, VRFs, multicast, NAT, QoS and end-to-end packet flow troubleshooting.
- VPN: IPsec site to site and dial-up, SSL VPN, IKEv2, certificate handling, and interoperability with third party gateways.
- Security profiles: Deep packet inspection and certificate inspection, IPS, application control, web filtering, DNS filtering, anti-malware and inline sandboxing.
- FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer: Centralised policy management, ADOMs, revision control, scripting and templating, and centralised logging, analytics and reporting design including log sizing and retention.
- Authentication and cryptography: TLS, PKI and certificate lifecycle, RADIUS, LDAP, SAML, MFA, and identity based policy enforcement.
- Platform and automation: Administrator level Linux or Windows, REST API integration, and automation scripting (Python, PowerShell, Ansible or equivalent).

Extended Fabric Capability (Highly Advantageous)

Candidates with demonstrable delivery experience in the following will be prioritised. These capabilities directly address current and forecast ANZ demand, and depth here is a differentiator, not a nice to have.

- OT visibility and platform breadth: Experience applying FortiNDR, FortiPAM, FortiDeceptor, FortiAuthenticator or FortiSIEM in an OT context, or with competing OT platforms (Claroty, Nozomi Networks, Dragos, Armis, Cisco Cyber Vision). Prior delivery into utilities, energy, water, rail, ports, mining or manufacturing is highly regarded.
- SD-WAN: Hub and spoke and ADVPN designs, overlay and underlay architecture, SLA based steering, application steering and large scale branch rollouts.
- FortiDDoS and DDoS protection: DDoS mitigation design and deployment, attack profiling and baselining, mitigation policy tuning, scrubbing and upstream provider integration, and post-event forensics. Experience with FortiDDoS, FortiDDoS-CM or competing platforms (Radware, Arbor, F5, Imperva, Cloudflare) is highly regarded.
- FortiNDR and network detection and response: Network detection and response deployment, traffic and metadata collection design, sensor placement, behavioural and machine learning based detection tuning, and integration into customer SOC workflow. FortiNDR, FortiNDR Cloud or equivalent (Darktrace, ExtraHop, Vectra, Corelight) experience is highly regarded.
- SASE and Zero Trust: FortiSASE, ZTNA, FortiClient EMS and secure private access, including remote access modernisation and VPN to ZTNA transition programs.
- Application security and delivery: FortiWeb (WAF), FortiADC (application delivery and server load balancing), FortiProxy, FortiGSLB and FortiIsolator.
- SOC and threat platforms: FortiSIEM, FortiSOAR, FortiEDR, FortiSandbox, FortiDeceptor and FortiRecon, including use case development and playbook build.
- Secure networking and access: FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiExtender, FortiNAC and FortiAuthenticator in campus and branch environments.
- Cloud and virtualised: FortiGate VM, FortiFlex, FortiCNAPP and Fortinet deployment in Azure, AWS and GCP, including infrastructure as code delivery.
- Adjacent platforms: FortiPAM, FortiMail and FortiTester.

We Are Looking For:

An insightful and influential collaborator to join our team. We encourage you to apply for this position if you have the following qualities:

- 8 to 10 years or more of relevant industry experience, preferably with a network security vendor, systems integrator or managed security service provider.
- 5 or more years in LAN, WAN and internet infrastructure engineering, support or administration.
- 3 or more years delivering network security products in customer facing project delivery.
- Demonstrated delivery of security outcomes in OT, industrial control or critical infrastructure environments.
- Demonstrated experience delivering into large enterprise, government, financial services or service provider environments under formal change management.
- Fortinet certification at FCP level as a minimum. FCSS or FCX, and Fortinet specialisations in OT Security, SD-WAN, Secure Access, Public Cloud or Security Operations, are strongly preferred.
- Vendor certifications from Cisco, Palo Alto, F5, Juniper, Check Point, Radware, AWS or Azure are an advantage. ISA/IEC 62443 certification, GICSP, or certification from an OT security vendor is highly regarded.
- Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to author design documentation and present technical positions to customer architects and management.
- Strong working knowledge of the current threat landscape and how it maps to control selection.
- Competence with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Visio and Project for delivery documentation.
- Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
- Project management certification (PRINCE2, PMP or Agile) is an advantage.

Working Conditions

- Based in Melbourne with potential travel across APAC.
- Delivery frequently requires work outside standard hours, including scheduled evening, weekend and public holiday change windows.
- Extended onsite Resident Engineer placement with a strategic customer may be required.
- Must hold unrestricted working rights in Australia. Eligibility to obtain and hold an Australian Government security clearance (Baseline or above) is highly advantageous.
- Delivery into industrial and critical infrastructure sites may require site induction, safety training, medical assessment, and drug and alcohol testing in line with customer requirements.
- Comfortable working autonomously and as part of a distributed regional team.

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

- Consistently meets billable utilisation and delivery quality targets without management intervention.
- Owns and closes complex multi-site engagements end to end, including all commercial closure artefacts.
- Becomes the recognised go-to design authority for OT and critical infrastructure security within the ANZ Professional Services team.
- Materially reduces the region’s dependence on any single individual for a technology domain through mentoring and documented assets.

Why Join Us:

At Fortinet, we embrace diversity and inclusivity. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and identities. Explore our welcoming work environment designed for a rewarding career journey with an attractive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000+ customers around the globe.

We will only notify shortlisted candidates.

Fortinet will not entertain any unsolicited resumes, please refrain from sending them to any Fortinet employees or Fortinet email aliases. Should any Agency submit any resumes to Fortinet, these resumes if considered, will be assumed to have been given by the Agency free of any related fees/charges.

postings.description:
Professional Services within Fortinet, is an integral part of the support and services organization, as a result the Consultant will collaborate effectively with peers to drive customer satisfaction. The Consultant delivers Professional Services as part of their regional team, on site and remotely to customers.

The Consultant delivers technical services including design, implementation, migration, optimization and related documentation. The Consultant also participates in scoping projects in the pre-Sales phase and is aware of best practice methodology to build and construct a Scope of Work.

The Consultant instils confidence to customers through their technical ability, focused communication skills and structured approach to implementing security solutions. This role requires a constant focus on improving technical skills through training or on-job learning opportunities.

The Consultant needs to be collaborative and build effective working relationships within Fortinet to drive success. The Consultant is expected to contribute to team processes and highlight to management any risk to projects.

Responsibilities

The Professional Services Consultant:

- Delivers assigned projects to the satisfaction of the Customer in collaboration with the PMO team including deployment, configuration, knowledge transfer, testing and troubleshooting of products and technologies in the customer environment.
- Assists on site throughout a rollout, migration or go-live phase with a focus on minimizing risk and maximizing customer satisfaction
- Performs project risk analysis, reports escalated issues and implements mitigation plans.
- Develops an understanding of customer engagements (objectives, project scope, business and technical requirements) to ensure expectations are met.
- Produces project related documents including any required technical architecture diagrams. These documents might include High-Level Design, Low-Level Design, Migration Plan, Test Plan, Methods of Procedures, Network Implementation Plan, As-Built guide. Ensures that project documents are accurate, complete, current and stored appropriately.
- Owns and contributes to the resolution of complex technical issues in relation to projects in delivery. Collaborates with the Customer and other teams (PS, Support and Sales Engineering).
- Collaborate with developers to put automation concepts into practice for high-quality and efficient delivery.
- Drives technical scoping meetings and develops statements of work with the relevant work breakdown structures based on accurate analysis of customers' requirements.
- Reviews peer documents for technical accuracy and quality assurance.
- Manages time, and completes and submits administrative tasks in a timely manner.
- Continuously works on developing knowledge and skills to remain proficient with the relevant Fortinet technologies, products and services by using self-study materials or by formal trainings.
- Feeds back customer input with the aim of improving services and process.
- Contributes to collateral such as templates, methodologies, best practice or lessons learned.
- Mentors other consultants on Fortinet Professional Services practices and methodologies.

Job Requirements

- 9+ years’ experience in LAN/WAN/Internet consulting, support and/or administration.
- 8+ years’ experience with network security products.
- Experience working as an IT security consultant or architect.
- Extensive experience in designing, deploying, and managing NGFW solutions is required. Hands on experience working on any of the top NGFW vendors like Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto and Checkpoint
- Extensive experience designing and deploying Web Proxy and Secure Web Gateways solution
- Hands-on experience working with SASE solutions like Zscaler, Netskope, Prisma Access is an added advantage
- Expertise in at least 3 of the following technologies:, Advanced Threat Protection, Endpoint Security, Application Security, Web Application Firewall, Network Security Management, SIEM, SD-WAN and/or other cloud-based technologies.
- Knowledge of python or any scripting language is highly desirable
- Knowledge of virtualization software like VMware, Hyper-V, KVM is an added plus
- Knowledge of API programmability/automation is desired but not mandatory
- Excellent presentation, communication and technical documentation skills.
- Excellent troubleshooting skills with a systematic approach to problem solving.
- Proven ability to work independently as well as in a team in a collaborative environment.
- Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including management, clients, and other departments.
- Ability to adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines.
- Flexible working hours.
- Positive customer service attitude with excellent soft skills.
- Ability to bring projects to successful completion.
- Strong commitment, self-driven with good team leadership skills.
- Travel (up to 30%).

Education

- Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering in Computer Science or Information Technology and equivalent extensive work-related experience.

- 8 to 10 years or more of relevant industry experience, preferably with a network security vendor, systems integrator or managed security service provider.
- 5 or more years in LAN, WAN and internet infrastructure engineering, support or administration.
- 3 or more years delivering network security products in customer facing project delivery.
- Demonstrated experience delivering into large enterprise, government, financial services or service provider environments under formal change management.
- Fortinet certification at FCP level as a minimum. FCSS or FCX, and Fortinet specialisations in SD-WAN, Secure Access, Public Cloud or Security Operations, are strongly preferred.
- Vendor certifications from Cisco, Palo Alto, F5, Juniper, Check Point, Radware, AWS or Azure are an advantage.
- Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to author design documentation and present technical positions to customer architects and management.
- Strong working knowledge of the current threat landscape and how it maps to control selection.
- Competence with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Visio and Project for delivery documentation.
- Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent practical experience.

Project management certification (PRINCE2, PMP or Agile) is an advantage

postings.title: Professional Services Consultant - UK
postings.description:
This role is based in our London (Moorgate) office or REMOTE.

Professional Services within Fortinet, is an integral part of the support and services organization, as a result the Consultant will collaborate with their assigned Customer and effectively with peers to drive customer satisfaction. This role is for an on-site engagement.

The Professional Services Consultant works on Customer site, with the aim of providing timely, quality and cost-effective technical services, including vendor expertise during security infrastructure design, deployment, testing and verification, optimization and operation services.

The Consultant instills confidence through their technical ability, focused communication skills and structured approach. This role requires a constant focus on improving technical skills through training or on-job learning opportunities. The Consultant needs to be collaborative and build effective working relationships within the Customer and Fortinet to drive success.

Responsibilities

- Assists the Customer during the Think and Build phases of a project

- Develops and maintains technical project documentation: high/low level design documentation, method of procedure, test plans, configuration templates and scripts.

- Provisions, customizes and verifies Fortinet configurations based on recommended and approved design.

- Tests Fortinet solutions and verifies system behavior

- Participates to interoperability/integration testing of devices that interact with Fortinet products

- Recommends and Implements Fortinet best practices

- Resolves and/or escalates technical issues in a timely fashion

- Delivers general knowledge transfer to client staff.

- Develops and maintains core competency on Fortinet’s product line and technologies.

Job Requirements:

- 7+ years of experience in LAN/WAN/Network Security Products.

- Experience with designing and implementing FortiGate solutions (design and implementation) or major 3rd party security solutions.

- Experience in complex routing and WAN environments where BGP, OSFP is a requirement.

- Work experience in maintaining, deploying or designing MPLS networks in particular L3 VPN.

- Exposure to MSSP or managed service environments (Multi-tenancy, monitoring, reporting, supportability)

- Experience in scripting and automation (e.g. ZTP, integration into orchestrator, controllers and dashboard).

- Excellent communication and technical documentation skills.

- Proven ability to work independently as well as in a team in a collaborative environment. Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including management, clients, and other departments.

- Positive customer service attitude with excellent soft skills.

Education

- University Degree in technical or management discipline and/or equivalent extensive work-related experience.

postings.title: Professional Services Tech Lead/Architect
postings.description:
Professional Services within Fortinet, is an integral part of the support and services organization, as a result the Consultant will collaborate effectively with peers to drive customer satisfaction. The Consultant delivers Professional Services as part of their regional team, on site and remotely to customers.

The Consultant delivers technical services including design, implementation, migration, optimization and related documentation. The Consultant also participates in scoping projects in the pre-Sales phase and is aware of best practice methodology to build and construct a Scope of Work.

The Consultant instils confidence to customers through their technical ability, focused communication skills and structured approach to implementing security solutions. This role requires a constant focus on improving technical skills through training or on-job learning opportunities.

The Consultant needs to be collaborative and build effective working relationships within Fortinet to drive success. The Consultant is expected to contribute to team processes and highlight to management any risk to projects.

Job Responsibilities

The Professional Services Tech Lead/Architect:

- Acts as the senior technical authority driving complex, large-scale migration/implementation projects— coordinating multiple resources, aligning architecture and delivery teams, managing technical and delivery risks, and ensuring successful execution across planning, design, implementation, validation, and cutover phases.

- Provides thought leadership in developing migration methodologies, frameworks, and best practices—especially for incubation-stage or emerging technology areas—to scale delivery excellence across the organization

- Lead technology transition discussions, influencing design decisions and migration approaches while driving high-quality service delivery outcomes.

- Translate complex customer business requirements into end-to-end solution architectures focused on technology/solution transition

- Lead Professional Services pre-sales, including solution scoping, effort estimation, and creation/review of Statements of Work (SOWs).

- Contributes to Professional Services growth by clearly articulating the capabilities and business value of migration services to diverse audiences—including Sales, and customer stakeholders

- Owns and resolves complex technical challenges related to product interoperability and feature parity, configuration translation, optimization, and multi-vendor integrations.

- Provides technical leadership during escalations by offering deep architectural guidance, collaborating closely with Engineering and Support teams, and driving timely resolution of complex issues that may impact project delivery or customer outcomes.

- Works with internal development teams on automation initiatives—conceptualizing use cases and collaborating with developers to implement scripting and tooling for migration efficiencies.

- Provide actionable insights to product management teams on feature gaps, roadmap enhancements, and real-world migration challenges.

- Continuously enhances technical knowledge across Fortinet Security Fabric and adjacent technologies through structured self-learning and training.

- Develops the reusable assets including templates, scripts, best practices, and methodologies to strengthen the migration practice.

- Provides mentorship and guidance to senior consultants on Fortinet Professional Services frameworks and technical execution

Job Requirements

- 15+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity architecture, network/security design, and complex solution migrations.

- Experience working as a cybersecurity technical leader or an architect.

- Strong hands-on experience with Fortinet Security Fabric, including firewalls, SSE, application security, cloud and web security

- Expertise in at least 3 of the following technologies: SASE, Network Security, Application Security, Web Application Firewalls, Load Balancers and/or other cloud based technologies
- Knowledge of python or any scripting language is highly desirable
- Prior experience leading large-scale migration programs

- Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders and deliver high-quality technical documentation.

- Experience in Professional Services—presales, SOW creation, delivery governance, and customer advisory.

- Ability to adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines

- Flexible working hours.

- Ability to guide and mentor engineers and drive best practices across the regional delivery organization.

postings.title: Regional Account Manager - Emerging
postings.description:
Here’s a wonderful opportunity to join the Leading Cybersecurity & Networking organisation – Fortinet, who truly converge Network & Security. Fortinet’s Mission & Vision is “to secure People, Devices and Data everywhere”. Fortinet’s Integrated, AI-driven Security platform is a Unified, Integrated cybersecurity platform that spans Network, Core, Endpoints, Applications, Cloud, etc.

Fortinet portfolio of over 50+ enterprise-grade products is the largest integrated offering available, delivering proven cybersecurity everywhere you need it. More than 890,000 customers trust Fortinet solutions, which are among the most deployed, most patented, and most validated in the industry.

Fortinet is included in the Fortune 500 list, has made numerous appearances on Fortune Magazine’s listing of 100 Fastest Growing Companies, and has been nominated to Fortune Magazine's Most Admired Companies List.

Position Overview

The “Regional Account Manager (RAM) – Emerging Business” is responsible for driving business thro’ Whitespace customer accounts, driving cybersecurity solution adoption, and working closely with channel partners to grow revenue. The role requires a strong understanding of cybersecurity products, partner ecosystems, and enterprise customer needs. The candidate will serve as the primary point of contact for customers and collaborate with channel partners to develop opportunities, close deals, and expand market presence.

Key Responsibilities

1. Account Management

- Drive business thro’ Whitespace mid-market Accounts & ensure high satisfaction and retention.
- Responsible for bringing new logos
- Cross-sell/ Up-sell multi-solution stack, with both existing & new Accounts
- Leverage Tech-Days/ Fast track training sessions, to ensure customers have a complete solution understanding of various Fortinet solution to meet their use-cases
- Leverage partners extensively to cross-sell to existing Accounts & penetrate into net new Accounts
- Understand customer security needs, pain points, and ongoing threats; position the right cybersecurity solutions.
- Conduct regular account reviews, QBRs, and roadmap discussions with customers.
- Collaborate with pre-sales/SE teams to deliver demos, POCs, and solution designs.

2. Channel Collaboration

- Work closely with resellers, distributors, MSSPs, and system integrators to drive partner-led sales.
- Support partners with deal strategy, pricing, proposals, and competitive positioning.
- Ensure channel partners are aligned with the company’s product roadmap, promotions, and incentive programs.
- Resolve channel conflicts and ensure smooth deal registration.

3. Sales & Revenue Growth

- Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to closure for accounts handled through partners.
- Achieve quarterly and annual sales targets (revenue, pipeline, partner activity).
- Identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities across the cybersecurity & Networking portfolio (endpoint, network, cloud, identity, SOC, etc.).
- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline using CRM tools.

4. Partner & Customer Enablement

- Conduct product trainings, workshops, and joint account planning with partners.
- Support marketing teams with regional partner events, webinars, and campaigns.
- Ensure customers and partners are aware of threat updates, product enhancements, and new features.

5. Market Intelligence & Reporting

- Track competitor activities, pricing trends, and partner ecosystem performance.
- Provide monthly/quarterly sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and business insights.
- Share customer and partner feedback with product and engineering teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, IT, or related field (MBA preferred).
- 10-12 years of sales/account management experience in Cybersecurity, Networking or IT security.
- Hands-on experience working with channel partners (distributors, VARs, MSSPs, integrators).
- Strong understanding of cybersecurity domains: Endpoint protection, firewalls, SASE/ ZTNA, SIEM/SOAR, IAM, cloud security, XDR, etc.
- Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities.
- Knowledge of CRM tools (Salesforce/HubSpot) and sales forecasting.

Preferred Attributes

- Existing relationships with local cybersecurity partners and distributors.
- Experience selling Enterprise security or Networking solutions
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
- Strong analytical and presentation skills.

postings.title: Regional Account Manager, SLED
postings.description:
The Regional Account Manager (RAM) is an exciting new role within the Fortinet sales organization that is focused on an important subset of the SLED segment. The RAM is a field sales position responsible for a specific set of SLED accounts while also having shared responsibility for all SLED business within their territory. The ideal candidate will have previous field sales experience in the B2B technology space. The RAM will create and execute an account plan from prospecting to building and maintaining a constant revenue pipeline. Fortinet will provide initial onboarding education to begin your career. Once completed, you will be assigned an individual territory and quota and given ongoing enablement and coaching to achieve the highest levels of success. Success in the RAM role provides many options in the overall career path at Fortinet.

Responsibilities:

- Meet or exceed all assigned quotas and targets while forecasting weekly, monthly and quarterly revenues for the assigned account set and overall territory
- Meet or exceed the required number of face-to-face meetings each month with customers and partners in territory to identify new opportunities and grow existing opportunities.
- Full participation in all team activities for enablement, forecasting, partner updates, partner sales efforts and recognition.
- Create and track sales opportunities (leads, renewals, deal registrations and quotes in Salesforce.com)
- Address any customer satisfaction issues and/or requests in a timely manner
- Drive sales cycles to close while establishing relationships and credibility, and provide necessary presales support for prospects & customers.
- Work closely with your local Channel Account Manager (CAM) and our reseller partner network to drive deals, increase revenue, and enable channel partners’ success in the SLED segment.
- Follow up on inbound, web and corporate event leads
- Accept inbound and perform outbound prospecting activities to identify new sales opportunities.
- Meet and exceed the sales activity metrics designed to make you productive and successful.
- Lead customer presentation and demos via online tools (GO TO MEETING)
- Perform ongoing analysis and report on opportunities that are supported
- Act as a liaison between partner, customers, and appropriate Fortinet team members
- Perform other duties and projects, as assigned to support the growth or our business
- Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree
- Coachable and flexible
- 1+ years of field sales experience in the B2B technology space
- Working knowledge of the businesses and partners in the local territory
- Ability to run productive customer-facing and partner-facing meetings while providing timely and relevant written follow up
- A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales quotas and targets
- Understanding of the sales cycle in conjunction with business processes internally and externally
- Ability to manage and drive sales cycles from start to finish, which includes experience with managing and forecasting individual quota
- Self-driven and able to manage a diverse, high volume workload
- Ability to quickly build productive relationships in a fast-paced, high-performance environment
- Be computer savvy
- Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills
- Well organized with effective time and activity management skills
- Ability to apply entrepreneurial strengths in a driven, forward-thinking manner
- Ability to close business while achieving a high level of customer and partner satisfaction
- Execute the role with the utmost professionalism and in a way that aligns to Fortinet’s core values
- The Regional Account Manager is required to spend more than 50% of their time outside of their office or home office engaged in selling, including travel as needed to make a sale.

Preferred Qualifications

- Public/private cloud experience is a plus
- Experience with multi-tier distribution a plus.
- Experience in networking, security and/or public/private cloud a plus

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $130,000 - $160,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan.

About Us

Fortinet (NASDAQ: FTNT) secures the largest enterprise, service provider, and government organizations around the world. Fortinet empowers its customers with intelligent, seamless protection across the expanding attack surface and the power to take on ever-increasing performance requirements of the borderless network - today and into the future. Only the Fortinet Security Fabric architecture can deliver security without compromise to address the most critical security challenges, whether in networked, application, cloud or mobile environments. Fortinet ranks number one in the most security appliances shipped worldwide and more than 500,000 customers trust Fortinet to protect their businesses.

As part of a virtual account team, the Channel Account Manager works closely with other Channel Account Managers, the relevant Regional and Major Account Managers, and Fortinet system engineers to support the assigned partners.

As a Channel Account Manager, you play a crucial role in driving revenue growth throughout Germany and contribute to achieving Fortinet’s overall growth goals. You are responsible for supporting a number of regional partners as part of Fortinet’s channel programs.

In this role, you will develop, implement, and monitor joint business and marketing plans, and engage, train, and support partners regarding Fortinet’s technology and value proposition. You will work closely with the partners’ sales and technical teams and coordinate with the relevant colleagues at Fortinet to identify new opportunities and ensure successful project outcomes. In addition, you will maintain close relationships with key decision-makers at both the partner companies and Fortinet.

This includes building strong relationships with key product managers, identifying opportunities to expand Fortinet’s market presence, and supporting partners throughout the entire value chain.

- Manage key Fortinet partners in northern Germany
- Build, execute, track business plans with these partners
- Motivate, educate and train partners in Fortinet products and technologies (together with the account team’s System Engineers)
- Organize and track ongoing alignment between partners’ and Fortinet’s sales and technical teams, including the definition of join target accounts and push for joint customer meetings
- Contribute to the accurate forecasting of Fortinet’s sales teams
- Build marketing plans to drive incremental sales pipeline and revenues with development funds
- Ensure jointly created leads are followed up by partner and/or Fortinet sales teams
- Drive the inclusion of Fortinet products and services within partners’ standardized portfolios. Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders within both partner organizations and Fortinet
- Build and expand executive engagements within partner organizations
- Promote partners within Fortinet’s sales and sales management teams
- Collaborate with Fortinet’s account managers, business development managers, engineering, and marketing in Germany as well as Fortinet’s account teams to drive revenue growth within these partners
- Gain account insights to develop and continuously adapt account strategy
- Become the partners’ go-to person for all matters related to Fortinet
- Carry quarterly and annual revenue targets

Apply if you have the following experience and skills:

Professional:

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in channel/partner management, ideally in cybersecurity and/or networking
- A proven track record of quota achievement and demonstrated career stability
- Experience in successfully working with large, strategic partners in a fast-paced environment
- Expertise in creating and executing successful business and marketing plans with partners
- Experience in delivering sales training

- Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment
- Self-motivated, well-organized, with excellent time management
- Proven team player, nevertheless, competitive, with a hunter-type mentality
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Excellent presentation skills
- Comfortable engaging with C-level stakeholders
- Class B Driver's License (PKW Führerschein)

postings.title: Regional Manager, Facilities Operations – East & Latin America
postings.additional_locations: Chicago, IL, United States; New York, NY, United States
postings.description:
Regional Manager, Facilities Operations – East & Latin America is responsible for leading and overseeing facilities operations across multiple locations throughout the Eastern United States and Latin America.

This role serves as the primary regional facilities leader and is accountable for the performance, reliability, maintenance, improvement, and overall workplace operations of a geographically distributed portfolio.

The successful candidate must be highly experienced in managing facilities through internal project managers, external vendors, landlords, contractors, consultants, and third-party service providers, particularly in locations without dedicated onsite Facilities personnel.

This position requires strong independent judgment, operational leadership, vendor management, project oversight, and the ability to travel frequently across multiple cities.

The role will be based on the East Coast and will report directly to the Facilities/Workplace leadership team at the company’s Silicon Valley headquarters.

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Site Facilities Operations

Lead Facilities operations across multiple offices and sites throughout the Eastern United States and Latin America.

Ensure facilities are safe, reliable, well maintained, professional, and operating according to company standards.

Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance programs, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, building systems, and general facility repairs.

Establish consistent Facilities standards, processes, service levels, and operating procedures across all assigned locations.

Serve as the senior escalation point for significant facility issues and operational emergencies.

Vendor & Service Provider Management

Manage and hold accountable third-party Facilities service providers, contractors, landlords, property managers, and vendors.

Develop and monitor vendor KPIs, SLAs, service quality, response times, costs, and performance.

Lead vendor selection, contract negotiations, renewals, and performance reviews.

Ensure vendors deliver consistent service across locations where no dedicated onsite Facilities staff are available.

Project & PM Oversight

Provide leadership and oversight for office renovations, tenant improvements, expansions, relocations, infrastructure upgrades, and other Facilities projects.

Partner closely with internal and external project managers to ensure projects meet scope, budget, schedule, quality, and business requirements.

Provide executive-level oversight rather than functioning solely as the day-to-day project manager.

Review project risks, budgets, schedules, design decisions, change orders, and contractor performance.

Data Center & Critical Infrastructure Projects

Support or lead Facilities-related Data Center construction, expansion, infrastructure upgrades, and critical-environment projects as required.

Coordinate with engineering, IT, network, security, consultants, contractors, and project management teams.

- Support and assist Customers, Sales, Partners & Distributors with full Renewal Sales cycle including:

postings.title: Sales Administrator - Customer Experience Centre
postings.description:
We are seeking an exceptional Customer Experience Centre Manager (Executive Briefing Centre Manager) to lead the day-to-day operation of our flagship London Customer Experience Centre.

This role is responsible for ensuring a seamless experience for visiting customers, prospects, partners and industry stakeholders. The Customer Experience Centre Manager will partner with internal account teams from initial briefing planning through to onsite delivery and post-engagement follow-up to deliver experiences that deepen customer relationships and drive revenue growth. Acting as both host and programme manager, the Executive Briefing Manager will ensure every visit reflects Fortinet’s commitment to customer obsession, operational excellence, and cybersecurity leadership.

The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Marketing and Executive Leadership teams to create tailored, impactful experiences that accelerate opportunities, deepen customer trust, and support revenue growth.

This is a highly visible role requiring exceptional organisational skills, executive presence, attention to detail, and a passion for delivering memorable customer experiences.

Office Location: London. This is an office-based role – you are required to be on site.

----

Responsibilities

Customer Experience Centre Management

- Serve as the primary owner and ambassador of the London Customer Experience Centre, delivering a premium, white-glove visitor experience for customer executives and senior stakeholders.

- Welcome and host customers, partners, and visitors, acting as the first point of contact upon arrival.

- Ensure all meeting spaces, presentation rooms, demonstrations, hospitality services, and facilities are prepared to the highest standard.

- Work with catering, hospitality, facilities, security, and IT teams to deliver a first-class onsite experience.

- Anticipate customer needs and proactively resolve issues before they arise.

- Maintain an environment that reflects the company's brand, culture, and position as a trusted cybersecurity partner.

- Continuously seek opportunities to improve the customer and employee experience associated with briefing centre engagements.

Customer Experience Coordination and Planning

- Support the internal account teams in creating engaging customer experiences, with customised briefing agendas aligned to customer challenges, industry trends, and cybersecurity priorities.

- Help to produce professional, customer-specific briefing documents, agendas, biographies, and supporting materials.

- Coordinate participation from senior executives, technical leaders, product specialists, and subject matter experts.

- Build strong relationships across the organisation to identify and engage the most relevant speakers and contributors for customer engagements.

- Coordinate logistics to ensure each engagement runs smoothly and professionally.

Customer Experience Programme Management/Operations

- Manage the scheduling and coordination of Customer Experience Centre engagements.

- Maintain efficient booking, planning, and communication processes for internal stakeholders.

- Ensure clear visibility of upcoming visits, resource requirements, speaker participation, and facility utilisation.

- Track activity, customer feedback, and engagement outcomes.

- Support the ongoing development and evolution of the Customer Experience Centre as demand grows.

---

Skills and Qualifications:

Required Skills and Qualifications

- Experience in customer experience, executive briefing programmes, hospitality management, customer marketing, executive engagement, events, or a related function.

- Strong project management and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, working confidently across all levels of the organisation.

- High attention to detail and commitment to excellence.

- Strong written communication skills with experience developing professional customer-facing materials and presentations.

- Self-starter who is comfortable building processes, improving ways of working, and operating with a high degree of autonomy.

Desirable

- Experience within cybersecurity, enterprise technology, SaaS or B2B technology environments.

- Understanding of enterprise cybersecurity priorities and executive-level security discussions.
