postings.title: Sales Engineer , Enterprise Majors
postings.description:
We are seeking a Sales Engineer to partner with a Named Account Manager in a defined territory. This role is designed for a technically strong but strategically minded individual who thrives in customer-facing engagements. The Systems Engineer will act as a trusted advisor, guiding large enterprise organizations through cybersecurity transformation initiatives that span SecOps, Zero Trust, cloud, and network security.

Responsibilities

- Partner with sales to qualify opportunities, define solution strategy, and align technical capabilities with customer business outcomes.
- Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and security assessments that uncover operational and architectural requirements in complex enterprise environments.
- Design and present secure architectures that incorporate networking, cloud, and SecOps components.
- Deliver impactful presentations and demos to both technical stakeholders and executive decision-makers (CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and business leaders).

Customer Engagement & Strategy

- Serve as the primary technical expert in sales cycles, guiding enterprise accounts through evaluation and decision processes.
- Advise on cybersecurity strategies such as Zero Trust, SASE, cloud security, and SecOps modernization.
- Build and maintain long-term trusted relationships with C-level executives and senior leadership, positioning yourself as a strategic advisor.
- Translate technical concepts into business value discussions tailored for executive-level conversations.

Post-Sales Partnership

- Support smooth deployment transitions by working closely with professional services, support, and customer success teams.
- Provide roadmap guidance, operational reviews, and strategic check-ins to reinforce customer value realization.
- Continue as a trusted advisor to enterprise leadership, ensuring ongoing alignment of their evolving needs with solution capabilities.

Required Skills & Experience

- 5–8 years experience in pre-sales or systems engineering roles in enterprise-scale cybersecurity, networking, or cloud environments.
- Strong understanding of networking (LAN/WAN, routing, switching, VPNs, TCP/IP) and core security protocols (IPSec, TLS/SSL, PKI, SAML, OAuth, RADIUS, etc.).
- Ability to articulate and design solutions across:
- SecOps modernization (SIEM, SOAR, XDR)
- Zero Trust and SASE architectures
- Cloud and hybrid security (IaaS, SaaS, containerized workloads)
- Identity and access management (MFA, SSO, PAM)

- Excellent presentation, communication, and storytelling skills—capable of engaging both deeply technical audiences and executive decision-makers.
- Proven track record of leading architectural discussions and aligning technical solutions with business priorities at the enterprise level.

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or vendor-specific credentials (e.g., NSE, CCNP Security, AWS Security Specialty).
- Experience in consulting or advisory roles for large enterprise customers, especially in CISO/CIO-level conversations.
- Familiarity with compliance and security frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2).

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to operate at the intersection of cybersecurity strategy, executive engagement, and customer success, influencing large-scale enterprise organizations as they modernize operations and adopt cutting-edge solutions. If you excel at combining technical depth with executive presence, this role will allow you to shape customer outcomes while growing your career in a dynamic security landscape.

postings.title: Sales Engineer,  Majors Enterprise
postings.description:
We are seeking a Sales Engineer to partner with a Named Account Manager in a defined territory. This role is designed for a technically strong but strategically minded individual who thrives in customer-facing engagements. The Systems Engineer will act as a trusted advisor, guiding large enterprise organizations through cybersecurity transformation initiatives that span SecOps, Zero Trust, cloud, and network security.

Responsibilities

- Partner with sales to qualify opportunities, define solution strategy, and align technical capabilities with customer business outcomes.
- Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and security assessments that uncover operational and architectural requirements in complex enterprise environments.
- Design and present secure architectures that incorporate networking, cloud, and SecOps components.
- Deliver impactful presentations and demos to both technical stakeholders and executive decision-makers (CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and business leaders).

Customer Engagement & Strategy

- Serve as the primary technical expert in sales cycles, guiding enterprise accounts through evaluation and decision processes.
- Advise on cybersecurity strategies such as Zero Trust, SASE, cloud security, and SecOps modernization.
- Build and maintain long-term trusted relationships with C-level executives and senior leadership, positioning yourself as a strategic advisor.
- Translate technical concepts into business value discussions tailored for executive-level conversations.

Post-Sales Partnership

- Support smooth deployment transitions by working closely with professional services, support, and customer success teams.
- Provide roadmap guidance, operational reviews, and strategic check-ins to reinforce customer value realization.
- Continue as a trusted advisor to enterprise leadership, ensuring ongoing alignment of their evolving needs with solution capabilities.

Required Skills & Experience

- 5–8 years experience in pre-sales or systems engineering roles in enterprise-scale cybersecurity, networking, or cloud environments.
- Strong understanding of networking (LAN/WAN, routing, switching, VPNs, TCP/IP) and core security protocols (IPSec, TLS/SSL, PKI, SAML, OAuth, RADIUS, etc.).
- Ability to articulate and design solutions across:
- SecOps modernization (SIEM, SOAR, XDR)
- Zero Trust and SASE architectures
- Cloud and hybrid security (IaaS, SaaS, containerized workloads)
- Identity and access management (MFA, SSO, PAM)

- Excellent presentation, communication, and storytelling skills—capable of engaging both deeply technical audiences and executive decision-makers.
- Proven track record of leading architectural discussions and aligning technical solutions with business priorities at the enterprise level.

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or vendor-specific credentials (e.g., NSE, CCNP Security, AWS Security Specialty).
- Experience in consulting or advisory roles for large enterprise customers, especially in CISO/CIO-level conversations.
- Familiarity with compliance and security frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2).

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to operate at the intersection of cybersecurity strategy, executive engagement, and customer success, influencing large-scale enterprise organizations as they modernize operations and adopt cutting-edge solutions. If you excel at combining technical depth with executive presence, this role will allow you to shape customer outcomes while growing your career in a dynamic security landscape.

Fortinet makes possible a digital world that we can always trust through its mission to protect people, devices, and data everywhere. This is why the world’s largest enterprises, service providers, and government organizations choose Fortinet to securely accelerate their digital journey. The Fortinet Security Fabric platform delivers broad, integrated, and automated protections across the entire digital attack surface, securing critical devices, data, applications, and connections from the data center to the cloud to the home office. Ranking #1 in the most security appliances shipped worldwide, more than 615,000 customers trust Fortinet to protect their businesses. And the Fortinet NSE Training Institute, an initiative of Fortinet’s Training Advancement Agenda (TAA), provides one of the largest and broadest training programs in the industry to make cyber training and new career opportunities available to everyone.

postings.title: Sales Operations Database Administrator
postings.description:
Location: London or Manchester, UK

Objective:

Sales Operations at Fortinet manages systems and databases used by all the employees in Sales plus other departments. Over the past 10 years the data architecture and decisions from Sales Ops meant that our BI tools became first class, we are looking for someone to help us with the continuous search for better technologies. A core part of this role is helping build out our AI capabilities – the data infrastructure you administer will increasingly serve as the foundation of LLM powered tools.

Responsibilities:

- Maintain API Jobs: our data comes from different places at Fortinet, most of these processes are written in Python, the successful applicant will be expected to maintain, improve and add new processes.
- Database work: we currently run most of our data under Microsoft SQL, we also leverage Mongo and Postgres. You will be expected to maintain ETL scripts and other SQL Queries that make our BI Tool (Tableau) operate. We also expect you to manage indexing, cleanups and good performance practices.
- Exploring new solutions: you will be expected to proactively review and help assess new tools that can make our processes better and faster, as technology changes and LLMs become more frequently used, we need to make sure our databases can handle future workload.
- Enable AI capabilities: you will play a key role in building and maintaining the data foundation that powers AI and LLM-based tools across the organization.
- CRM Work: even though we don’t work inside the CRM, you will be expected to understand how a CRM works and how sales uses a CRM, this will be helpful when importing datasets and understanding how to build efficient queries for sales.
- Investigative approach: the applicant must have the instinct of being curious, our team is continuously learning new technologies and building new applications for sales, we expect you to keep up and bring new ideas.

Required Skills:

- Strong Python for building and maintaining data pipelines, API integrations, and automation scripts.
- Advanced SQL, with hands-on experience in RDBMS and data lakes.
- Experience monitoring database systems for capacity and performance.
- Proven experience designing and maintaining ETL processes feeding BI/reporting tools.
- Database performance tuning: indexing strategy, query optimization, data cleanup, and general good-hygiene practices.
- Experience with Tableau as a data source owner, not just a report consumer.
- Working understanding of how CRMs operate and how sales teams use them (Salesforce experience a plus), enough to model and import sales datasets sensibly.
- Comfort integrating and consuming REST APIs from varied internal and third-party sources.

Location:

- Candidate should be in the London Metro area. However, other locations in Europe will be considered if the ideal candidate is identified.

postings.title: Sales Recruiter
postings.description:
Founded in the San Francisco Bay Area in 2000, Fortinet continues to be a driving force in the evolution of cybersecurity and the convergence of networking and security. Securing people, devices, and data everywhere is our mission. To that end, our portfolio of over 50 enterprise-grade products is the largest integrated offering available, delivering proven cybersecurity everywhere you need it. More than 900,000 customers trust Fortinet solutions, which are among the most deployed, most patented, and most validated in the industry.

Position Overview

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Sales Recruiter with experience recruiting Sales and Sales Engineering professionals. The ideal candidate understands the competitive hiring landscape and has the ability to proactively build strong talent pipelines through creative sourcing and relationship-building strategies.

This role requires excellent communication skills, strong organizational abilities, and a passion for delivering an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience throughout the recruitment process.

Key Responsibilities

- Source and attract qualified candidates through networking, referrals, online platforms, events, and other recruiting channels.

- Execute recruitment strategies to support hiring goals and meet management expectations.

- Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including candidate screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, offer presentation, and closing.

- Serve as a positive ambassador for the company by delivering a professional and engaging candidate experience.

- Partner closely with hiring managers to understand staffing needs, provide market insights, and ensure timely hiring decisions.

- Maintain consistent communication and follow-up with both candidates and stakeholders throughout the hiring process.

- Build and maintain strong pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

Qualifications & Skills

- 3-5 years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience recruiting for Sales and/or Sales Engineering roles is preferred.

- Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to prioritize multiple roles and manage competing deadlines effectively.

postings.title: SASE Solution Architect (Systems Engineer, EMEA)
postings.description:
SASE Solution Architect (Systems Engineer, EMEA)

Location: Remote

Region: Open to candidates located in eligible countries within the EMEA region. (Please note: not all EMEA countries are currently supported for this role)
Team: Central Core Team / SASE

Role Overview

The Principal SASE Solution Architect serves as a strategic technical authority within the Core SASE Sales Specialist team, operating at a layer distinct from standard product sales.

This role brings an extra depth of technical knowledge and positioning for the activities of the local SASE Sales Specialists and Specialized SEs, that are delivered locally but driven centrally.
This role does not overlap with SE, SME, SSE or CSE as it focuses on the SASE technical value proposition at large and overall architecture rather than specific technical features. Coordinating activities with the technical sales community is essential in this role though, bringing architectural vision and expertise to win opportunities.

This role is responsible for looking at the Fortinet Unified SASE offering from an architecture standpoint — integrating People, Process, and Technology to solve complex business challenges — rather than solely positioning individual solutions/features. It acts as the bridge between technical product capabilities and high-level CISO strategies.

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Thought Leadership & Strategy

- Deliver on Security-first Unified SASE approach with Fortinet customer:s

- Develop material that allows Fortinet to present the strength of its Unified SASE offering beyond the traditional networking value proposition

- Articulate the Technical value proposition of Fortinet’s Unified SASE solution offering

- Supports Local Sales Specialist teams in building pipelines and closing medium-to-large business opportunities by providing high-level architectural guidance.

- Be the technical SPoT for technical/architectural questions/requests from the local Sales Specialists Teams

- Industry-based Solution Development

- Understand and articulate how Fortinet’s Unified SASE offering uniquely delivers value to customer in various Industries

- Work with local Sales, Technical Sales and Marketing to identify the key challenges that customers/prospects face for major industries with their current cybersecurity infrastructure and work with CSE, Marketing and PM to identify and highlight the value proposition for each major industry segment

- Develop presentations, white papers, demonstrations, reference designs to highlight these key benefits

- Accurate and Timely Competitive Intelligence

- Keep up to date on the latest developments from traditional and non-traditional SASE competitors

- Keep an “honest competitive database” that allows the Sales Specialists to gage the strength (and weaknesses) of our positioning against specific competitors to accurately steer Fortinet Sales efforts to the right customers/industries

- Ensure that our Sales and Technical Sales team remain up to date on our strengths vs. various competitors and able to articulate the unique value proposition of the Fortinet Unified SASE offering. Deliver regular competitive updates to all Sales.

- Adapt the competitive material to the Industries and geographical specificities

- Work with Technical Marketing Team to ensure that our overall competitive battlecards remain up to date and relevant.

- Strategic Events Ownership

- Develop and maintain a unified New Hire training (P4S) messaging and presentation material, and ensure the consistency of the delivery across EMEA North, EMEA South and APAC

- Work with all Stakeholders to develop gamification events around Fortinet Unified SASE to raise awareness and expertise around the solution with customers and channel partners

- Drive local channel teams to leverage the Fast Track material to upskill partners in all regions. Help them adapt the content / material / messages to the local customers/industries

- Channel Technical Community Setup and Management

- Develop and nurture the technical channel community composed of the SASE certified Distributors and Partners

- Ensure that they remain up to date on the latest product features released by organizing monthly update calls and discussion forums

- Provides dedicated architectural support to large partners and MSSPs, assisting in the development of scalable, multi-tenant SASE services

- Support Product Improvement through Business Cases

- Work with local technical Sales to understand the impact of specific customer requests for improvement while expanding the scope of the demand to customers in the whole Internation Geographies.

- Work with CSEs to ensure that a proper business case is attached to the major NFR requests being delivered

- Support the PM team for additional business case requirement when evaluating the impact of new product developments

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Technical Expertise:

- Deep Technical Background: Extensive hands-on and architectural experience with SSE and/or SASE solutions.

- Cyber Security Background: Special focus on the cybersecurity elements of the SASE/SSE offering, rather than the networking piece.

- Architecture: Ability to design complex, multi-vendor, and hybrid-cloud security architectures.

Professional Skills:

- Strategic Vision: Ability to translate technical features into business value for C-level executives (CISO/CIO).

- Presentation Skills: Exceptional public speaking ability for large forums, roundtables, and executive briefings.

- Collaboration: Proven track record of working effectively across matrixed organizations (Sales, Marketing, Product, Support).

Travel:

- Willingness to travel approximately 30–50% of the time is required.

postings.description:
Location: Europe (remote) · Work region: EMEA · Travel: up to 20% · Team: Consulting Systems Engineering EMEA – Telco & MSSP · Level: Senior

About the role

SASE is where Telcos and MSSPs are placing their next big managed-service bet — but turning FortiSASE, SD-WAN, and Universal ZTNA into a productized, multi-tenant offering that partners can actually sell and operate is a different problem than winning a single-tenant enterprise deal. Add to that a European market increasingly demanding data and digital sovereignty, and the bar for "production-ready" keeps rising.

As a Senior CSE for SASE Solutions, you're the technical authority who helps Telco and MSSP partners across EMEA architect, launch, and scale managed SASE services — and who arms Fortinet field SEs to win the competitive fights that get them there. You'll be based in Europe, working across the full EMEA footprint.

What you'll own

- Productize SASE outcomes. Co-design managed SD-WAN, SSE, and Universal ZTNA offerings with partners — mapping capabilities to service tiers, SLAs, and multi-tenant service models that remain viable for the partner's business at scale.
- Win the technical bar. Lead architecture deep-dives, PoVs, and competitive displacements that establish Fortinet as the technical choice.
- Design for scale, not just for the pilot. Guide partners past the single-site PoV into industrialized rollout — repeatable onboarding, automated provisioning, and operational models that hold up across hundreds of tenants and sites.
- Own the integration story. Map how SASE fits into a partner's existing NOC/SOC, ticketing, billing, and orchestration stack — API and telemetry integration is as much a deal-maker as the security architecture itself.
- Speak to sovereignty with substance. Address data residency, in-country processing, and digital sovereignty requirements head-on — increasingly a hard requirement for European Telcos, public-sector-adjacent MSSPs, and regulated verticals, not a nice-to-have.
- Build the playbooks. Create reusable reference architectures and sizing tools that field SEs and partners can run without you in the room.
- Be the field's forward edge. Represent Fortinet at partner technical events, enablement sessions, and executive briefings across EMEA — translating SASE architecture into a commercial story partners can take to their own customers.
- Close the loop. Feed real deployment and competitive learnings back into our solution content, sales plays, and product teams — sharpening what the whole field organization takes to market next.

What you bring

- Multi-year, hands-on depth in pre-sales/sales engineering or solution architecture across networking, network security, or SASE/SSE — ideally with direct exposure to Telco or MSSP partner environments, not just direct enterprise accounts.
- Solid, hands-on grounding in SD-WAN, ZTNA, SWG, CASB, and DLP architectures, plus core networking (BGP, routing, traffic steering) and identity/auth integration (SAML, RADIUS, Entra ID, Okta).
- Working knowledge of European data and digital sovereignty requirements — data residency, in-country hosting, GDPR-adjacent constraints — and how they shape SASE architecture decisions for Telcos and public-sector-facing MSSPs.
- Real understanding of operational reality — how a service is actually monitored and supported day to day, not just how it gets sold and deployed.
- Proven experience with integration — APIs, orchestration, and telemetry pipelines that connect SASE into a partner's broader NOC/SOC and billing ecosystem.
- A track record of taking something from pilot to industrialized scale — standardized onboarding, automation, and repeatable processes across large partner or multi-tenant estates.
- Comfort discussing multi-tenant, service-provider-grade architecture — not just single-customer deployments — and translating that into a partner's own service catalogue and SLAs.
- Strong competitive fluency: able to hold your own, with credibility, against the major SASE/SSE vendors in a technical room.
- A builder-operator mindset — equally comfortable running a PoV, presenting to a partner's leadership, or writing the reference architecture doc afterward.
- Fluent English; a second major European language is a strong plus.
- Based in Europe, with willingness to travel up to 20% across the EMEA region.

How we work

You'll join a collaborative, peer-led overlay team that runs on transparent, consent-based decision-making rather than only top-down mandates your voice shapes the roadmap.

Fortinet is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from every background and lived experience.

postings.title: Senior Information Security Manager
postings.description:
Fortinet looking for a Senior Information Security manager to join the Information Security team in the U.S. This position is responsible for leading the information security team, focusing on information security compliance projects. This role will oversee the design, implementation, operation, and continual improvement of the Information Security Management System (ISMS), coordinate security compliance initiatives across the organization, and serve as the primary liaison with external auditors and regulatory bodies. The position requires a strong understanding of ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST security frameworks, cloud security, risk management, governance, and security operations.

The successful candidate must be a U.S. citizen, and work onsite at Fortinet's headquarter in Sunnyvale, California.

Job Responsibilities:

- Manage information security team, lead the design, implementation, operation, and continual improvement of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).

- Perform gap analysis based on NIST SP800-53 and other compliance framework, create mitigation/action plans.

- Determine the applicability and apply the information security and privacy requirements to ISMS policies.

- Prepare required documents for supporting various compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP and GovRAMP.

- Develop related KPI metrics for performance measurement, and for ensuring continued compliance and improvement.

- Create compliance project plans. Manage the implementation.

- Conduct risk and privacy impact assessments on business and operation processes. Prepare finding reports. Create and implement risk treatment plans.

- Collaborate with operation teams to ensure that appropriate controls are implemented and operated properly.

- Participate in and lead the daily security operation, oversee the handling of security alerts and incidents.

- Lead vulnerability management activities, monitor remediation progress, and work closely with operations teams to ensure timely patching of identified vulnerabilities.

- Manage internal and external audits. Develop audit plans, respond to various audits and review requests.

Skills and Qualifications:

- 7+ years of experience in information security area, with people and project management experience.

- Subject matter expert of NIST SP800-53, ISO/IEC 27000 and SOC2 related standards, regulations and guidelines.

- Experience of managing FedRAMP or GovRAMP implementation and compliance is highly preferred.

- Knowledge and experience working with various information security frameworks (ISO/IEC 27001, NIST 800-53, NIST SP800-161, GovRAMP, FedRAMP, PCI DSS) and regulatory frameworks (SOX, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC, etc.)

postings.title: Senior Product Quality Control Specialist
postings.description:
Fortinet is seeking a senior Product Quality control specialist to oversee and elevate the hardware and mechanical integrity of our product portfolio, including FortiExtender, FortiSwitch, FortiFone, and FortiCamera. In this role, you will collaborate directly with external JDM/ODM partners to intercept design vulnerabilities, review mass production workflows, and ensure exceptional product reliability across both standard and ruggedized industry.

Key Responsibility

- Design & Quality Review: Evaluate schematic designs and PCB layouts from ODM/JDM partners; proactively identify and resolve potential design flaws to mitigate quality risks..
- Mechanical & Industrial Design Architecture: Review JDM partners’ 3D mechanical structure and industrial housing designs. Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize mechanical reliability, make critical structural decisions, and grant final mechanical design approvals.
- BOM Management: Scrutinize JDM/ODM partners’ electrical, electronic and mechanical Bills of Materials (BOM) – with a strict focus on critical components – to ensure compliance with product lifespans and operational environment requirement.
- Validation & Testing Oversight: Partner with JDM/ODM vendors to establish comprehensive hardware and mechanical test schemes. Define test procedures, establish test parameters, and audit test reports to guarantee strict quality control, particularly for mass production.
- Production & Assembly Optimization: Consult with JDM/ODM engineering/production teams on assembly line planning to maximize manufacturing efficiency during mass production phases.
- Regulatory & Compliance: Coordinate with JDM/ODM engineering/production teams and Fortinet’s internal regulatory division to guide new products through complex regulatory certification processes and secure necessary compliance documentation.
- Lifecycle Documentation: Manage and maintain meticulous hardware and mechanical design documentation across every gate of the New Product Introduction (NPI) process, strictly adhering to Fortinet’s project management frameworks.
- Competitive Intelligence: Maintain an up-to-date, comprehensive knowledge of competitor product designs and emerging technological trends to drive continuous improvement in product quality and reliability.

Qualifications & Core Competencies

- Technical Experience: 10+ year direct hardware or mechanical design experience across the full product lifecycle (concept to mass production). Proven expertise in high-reliability industrial design for 5G/LTE routers, network switches, IP phones and IP cameras is highly desirable.
- Project Management: 3+ year of experience of managing new product development, with a documented focus on product reliability and cross-functional execution. Bachelor degree in Mechatronics, EE or ME, master degree or higher is preferred.
- Domain Expertise: Profound knowledge on reliable hardware and mechanical engineering principles within standard and ruggedized industrial environments, Familiarity with synchronized hardware and mechanical co-design is a distinct asset.
- Vendor Governance: Proven professional capacity to audit external JDM/ODM designs, provide authoritative technical recommendations, and make definitive decisions on architecture and reliability.
- Manufacturing Acumen: Deep Familiarity with factory assembly processes, mass production quality testing, and the definition of production-line test criteria.
- Technical Toolset: Professional proficiency in EDA software, SolidWorks, and engineering simulation/modeling tools.
- Leadership & Communication: Exceptional team player capable of orchestrating JDM/ODM engineering resources and aligning internal Fortinet teams to meet aggressive product launch schedules.
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering (EE) or Mechanical Engineering; a Master’s degree or higher is strongly preferred.
- Language Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication and coordination skills in English. Clear, precise professional proficiency in Mandarin is an asset.

postings.description:
We are hiring a Senior / Staff QA Engineer for Fortinet's AI security product line, FortiAIGate, to own end-to-end testing of the product across both SaaS and on-premises deployments. FortiAIGate is Fortinet's security solution for the AI era, spanning the LLM Gateway, AI Guardrails, and Agent Security, and is deeply integrated with the Fortinet ecosystem (FortiOS, FortiManager, FortiClient, and more).

This role lets you work at the frontier of AI security while helping build out cloud-native SaaS test practices.

Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end testing of FortiAIGate across SaaS and on-premises deployments, covering functionality, integration, performance, and reliability.
- Design and implement core SaaS test capabilities: multi-tenant isolation, tenant onboarding and provisioning, metering / billing-accuracy reconciliation, and license / entitlement validation.
- Validate cloud-native capabilities: elastic scaling, zero-downtime upgrades, and failover under Kubernetes deployments (single-cluster and multi-data-center).
- Test the effectiveness of AI security capabilities: the LLM Gateway and AI Guardrails (Text / Policy / Image / Video & Audio) — detection accuracy, false-positive / false-negative regression — and validate protection effectiveness in collaboration with the red team.
- Build and maintain automated test frameworks and regression suites; drive shift-left testing and continuous validation.
- Collaborate closely with engineering (LLM Gateway / Guardrails / Agent Security / SaaS teams) and PM on test planning and release gating.

Required

- Cloud / SaaS testing (must-have)
- Solid software testing background, with meaningful time focused on testing SaaS / cloud-native products.
- Hands-on multi-tenant SaaS testing experience: tenant isolation, provisioning, metering / billing, license, and other control-plane testing.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes; able to troubleshoot independently with kubectl and comfortable with concepts such as pods, services, scaling, and rolling upgrades.
- Proficiency with a performance / load-testing tool (e.g., k6, Locust, or JMeter); able to design concurrency, scaling, and high-load metering scenarios.
- Strong API-level testing (Postman or scripting) and solid test automation / scripting skills (Python or equivalent).
- Comfortable with observability-based troubleshooting: logs, metrics (p95/p99 latency, error rates), and distributed tracing.
- AI / cybersecurity background (strongly preferred — one of the following)
- Experience testing AI / LLM-related products (e.g., LLM gateways, content safety / guardrails, model-serving); or
- Experience testing cybersecurity / security products (firewalls, gateways, authentication, policy engines).

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with the Fortinet ecosystem (FortiOS / FortiManager / FortiClient) or comparable cybersecurity products.
- Understanding of AI security offense/defense, red-teaming / adversarial testing, and prompt injection.
- Familiarity with MCP / A2A, Agent Security, and NHI identity and other AI-agent areas.

• 10+ years of Salesforce administration experience in complex environments.

• Salesforce ARM/RCA experience is highly desirable. CPQ experience is good to have.

This role lets you work at the frontier of AI security while helping build out cloud-native SaaS test practices.

- Own end-to-end testing of FortiAIGate across SaaS and on-premises deployments, covering functionality, integration, performance, and reliability.

- Test the effectiveness of AI security capabilities: the LLM Gateway and AI Guardrails (Text / Policy / Image / Video & Audio) — detection accuracy, false-positive / false-negative regression — and validate protection effectiveness in collaboration with the red team.

- Collaborate closely with engineering (LLM Gateway / Guardrails / Agent Security / SaaS teams) and PM on test planning and release gating.

Cloud / SaaS testing (must-have)

- Solid software testing background, with meaningful time focused on testing SaaS / cloud-native products.

- Hands-on multi-tenant SaaS testing experience: tenant isolation, provisioning, metering / billing, license, and other control-plane testing.

- Familiarity with Kubernetes; able to troubleshoot independently with kubectl and comfortable with concepts such as pods, services, scaling, and rolling upgrades.

- Proficiency with a performance / load-testing tool (e.g., k6, Locust, or JMeter); able to design concurrency, scaling, and high-load metering scenarios.

- Strong API-level testing (Postman or scripting) and solid test automation / scripting skills (Python or equivalent).

- Comfortable with observability-based troubleshooting: logs, metrics (p95/p99 latency, error rates), and distributed tracing.

AI / cybersecurity background (strongly preferred — one of the following)

- Experience testing AI / LLM-related products (e.g., LLM gateways, content safety / guardrails, model-serving); or

- Experience testing cybersecurity / security products (firewalls, gateways, authentication, policy engines).

Nice to Have

- Familiarity with the Fortinet ecosystem (FortiOS / FortiManager / FortiClient) or comparable cybersecurity products.

postings.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Agent Endpoint DLP

Join Fortinet, a global cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking an experienced Software Engineer to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

You will work in our Cyber R&D team, and use your knowledge of systems (Kernel, OS) level development to develop our Agent architecture. The Agent is our endpoint client software and is responsible for the extraction and management of our customer's data. With this we protect people and data anywhere, with innovative companies worldwide using FortiDLP for human-centric data loss protection.

Key Responsibilities and Technologies

- Implementing new capabilities within the FortiDLP endpoint agent, taking ownership of features and leading the development effort.

- Maintain and improve existing functionality of the FortiDLP agent.

- Contributing to code, tests, and code review.

- Keep a strong focus on code quality, maintainability, and secure coding practices.

- Maintain close communication within the team as well as across other teams to coordinate progress.

At FortiDLP we default to programming using Go but also use a wide variety of different languages and frameworks. It's not expected that you would be familiar with Go (or any of the other languages we use) but you should be enthusiastic and willing to learn new things. We value:

- Strong programming skills backed by at least 3 years of software engineering experience.

- Familiarity with computer science fundamentals.
- Software development in Go, C, C++, Java, Scala, C# or Swift.

- Kernel and device driver development for Windows, Linux, or Mac.

- Systems Analytics; Dynamic tracing and performance analysis tools such as Instruments, VTune, DTrace and eBPF.

- Observability technologies, logging and metrics.

- Security principles including PKI, certificates and cryptography.

Communication and Collaboration

We work on complex, cross-functional features that require close collaboration with engineers across the endpoint, product managers, technical writers, and support teams. Team members contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from writing technical specifications and coordinating implementation to demoing features internally, supporting launches, and ensuring our solutions are well-documented and maintainable. We also work closely with the support and QA teams to prepare for releases, debug early issues in the field, and ensure a smooth rollout experience. High engineering standards are central to our team culture, including thorough code reviews, rigorous testing, and shared responsibility for quality and reliability.

We’re looking for engineers who communicate clearly, work well with a wide range of collaborators, and enjoy building shared understanding across disciplines. The role suits people who are thoughtful partners to product managers and support teams, value feedback as part of the development process, and bring a sense of ownership and care to both their code and their collaboration.

Senior Software Engineer, Backend Services & APIs

Office based in Moorgate, London

Join Fortinet, a global cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking an experienced Software Engineer to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

The FortiDLP platform collects millions of data points per second. We protect people and data anywhere, and innovative companies worldwide use FortiDLP for human-centric data loss protection. Our users need a way to spot trends in this data, search for security breaches, and take effective action.
Handling data at that scale, while developing and maintaining services and integrations is a complex challenge. The FortiDLP team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer passionate about finding pragmatic solutions to delicate problems to help with the server-side applications underpinning FortiDLP, including APIs, databases, and external integrations.

Key Responsibilities and Technologies:

● Implementing new capabilities within the FortiDLP server-side services, taking ownership of features and leading the development effort.
● Maintain and improve existing functionalities of the FortiDLP platform.
● Contributing to code, tests, and code review.
● Keep a strong focus on code quality, maintainability, and secure coding practices.
● Maintain close communication within the team as well as across other teams to coordinate progress.
● Optionally help with operational tasks maintaining the FortiDLP service.

Direct experience in these technologies is a bonus but not a requirement. We are looking for relevant experience in comparable technologies and frameworks, and the ability to learn new technologies.

We value:
● Strong programming skills backed by at least 3-5 years of software engineering experience.
● Familiarity with computer science fundamentals and backend development concepts.
● Experience in Golang.
● Experience with relational and non-relational databases (e.g. Elasticsearch, Postgres).
● Experience with micro-service architecture and Cloud computing environments.
● Experience with high-volume data pipelines.

Communication and Collaboration:
We work on complex, cross-functional features that require close collaboration with engineers across the stack, product managers, technical writers, and support teams. Team members contribute throughout the development lifecycle — from writing technical specifications and coordinating implementation to demoing features internally, supporting launches, and ensuring our solutions are well-documented and maintainable. We also work closely with the support and QA teams to prepare for releases, debug early issues in the field, and ensure a smooth rollout experience. High engineering standards are central to our team culture, including thorough code reviews, rigorous testing, and shared responsibility for quality and reliability.
We’re looking for engineers who communicate clearly, work well with a wide range of collaborators, and enjoy building shared understanding across disciplines. The role suits people who are thoughtful partners to product managers and support teams, value feedback as part of the development process, and bring a sense of ownership and care to both their code and their collaboration.

Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced OT Security Solution Architect to work with OT Regional team and collaborate with OT Global team to support Operational Technology & Critical Infrastructure customers and partners across the region. The role will focus on designing, positioning, and architecting cybersecurity solutions for Operational Technology (OT) environments across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of OT domain knowledge and cybersecurity expertise, enabling them to translate operational requirements into secure, scalable architectures.

Key Responsibilities

- Act as a Solution Architect for OT Cybersecurity, supporting presales, solution design, and customer engagements from technical stand-point and assist in qualifying sales leads.
- Design and develop OT cybersecurity reference architectures aligned with industry best practices, compliances, regulations and standards mapping Fortinet Products.
- Enabling technical resources on sales calls and answer/educate the customer on issues ranging from features, specifications, and functionality to the integration of Fortinet’s products for Operational Technology and Critical Infrastructure Security Solutions.
- Stitch end-to-end security solutions across IT–OT environments, addressing network segmentation, remote access, visibility, threat protection & various OT security use-cases.
- Support creation and response to RFPs / RFIs / technical proposals related to OT security initiatives as per Fortinet’s OT security solution stack.
- Provide technical guidance and support to Systems Engineers and SMEs within OT & CI to build future RA’s & to build and develop the capabilities on OT security.
- Modify RA network security design and implementation guidance internally and externally to meet the customer’s requirements.
- Support team with OT security audits, OT security assessments and risk assessments, compliance assessment identifying gaps and recommending remediation roadmaps.
- Work closely with sales, business development, and delivery teams to support large and strategic deals.
- Lead and participate in customer workshops, architecture discussions, and technical presentations.
- Enable Partner eco-system on Fortinet’s OT Security solution stack by delivering trainings and organizing work-shops.
- Stay updated with OT threat landscape, standards, and regulatory requirements relevant to industrial environments.

Required Skills & Experience

- 7-8 years of experience, in technical/pre-sales support as a sales or systems engineer in cybersecurity.
- 5-7 years of experience, with strong hands-on exposure to OT / industrial environments/Industrial Control Systems/Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition environments.

- Solid understanding of OT cybersecurity concepts, including:

- Network segmentation

- Secure remote access for industrial systems

- Asset visibility & monitoring

- Risk-based OT security architectures

- Common OT Protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC etc.) and PCAP Analysis

- Knowledge of the following technologies: Routing, Switching, VPN, LAN, WAN, Network Security, Intrusion Detection, and Anti-Virus used in the Purdue model

- Good understanding of cybersecurity solutions and platforms, and ability to integrate multiple technologies into a cohesive architecture.

- Experience in creating reference architectures, solution designs, and technical documentation on OT security.

- Hands-on experience in OT security assessments is strongly preferred.

- Good understanding of NERC-CIP, CEA and other regional and global standards and regulations.

- Prior exposure to industries such as power & utilities, renewable energy, oil & gas, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals or critical infrastructure is an advantage.

Certifications (Preferred)

- IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert

- GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional)

- Other relevant OT / cybersecurity certifications will be an added advantage.

Educational Qualifications

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science, or related fields).

Key Attributes

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to engage with both technical and business stakeholders
- Excellent communication and presentation skills
- Customer-facing mindset with consultative approach

postings.title: Senior Technical Product Manager – Endpoint Security
postings.description:
Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere.

We’re looking for an experienced Technical Product Manager to join our Product Management team and help lead the development and execution of our Unified Endpoint Security platform, which integrates Secure Zero Trust Access, Endpoint Security (EPP/EDR), and Data Protection into a single solution. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with engineering teams to define technical requirements, shape the product roadmap, and drive the delivery of an enterprise-grade unified endpoint security SaaS offering.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in endpoint security and networking technologies—including secure access (VPN/ZTNA), threat protection, and endpoint security (EPP/EDR)—along with a solid understanding of engineering development cycles. The ability to collaborate effectively with multiple technical product teams is essential for success in this role.

What you will do:

- Work closely with various product development & design teams to define and execute Unified Endpoint Platform product roadmap.
- Capture priority issues from technical, sales and support teams and follow up with respective engineering teams to ensure timely resolution.
- Partner with cross-functional groups—Engineering, UX, Support, Marketing, and Sales—to drive alignment and execution.
- Analyze market competitors and customer feedback to guide product decision-making.
- Collaborate with design and engineering teams to create product prototypes and user interfaces.

Requirements:

- 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity or Endpoint Protection / EDR space
- 5+ years of experience in project or product management role.
- Hands-on experience with security solutions (Firewalls, IPS, Antivirus, Antispam, Endpoint Protection, ZTNA, DLP, etc.).
- Proven experience overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle.
- Highly effective cross-functional team management.
- Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
- Strong analytical abilities and big-picture problem-solving skills, grounded in a deep commitment to customer needs.
- Flexibility and Versatility – the position requires dealing with a wide range of technologies, interfaces, and multiple teams in a highly dynamic hypergrowth environment.
- Expertise in platform architecture and/or SaaS product integration
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline

About Our Team:

Join our team, known for its collaborative ethos, working seamlessly with global customers, internal engineering teams and product development groups. Our team culture emphasizes continuous learning, innovation, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. We embrace Fortinet’s core values of openness, teamwork and innovation, fostering an environment where team members support each other, share knowledge, and leverage AI to solve complex technical challenges. Our inclusive and dynamic team thrives on collaboration and is driven by the shared goal of maintaining Fortinet’s high standards of excellence in cybersecurity solutions.

Why Join Us:

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being. Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000+ customers around the globe.

The Canada base salary range for this full-time position is expected to be between $163,000 - $199,000 annually. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.

Fortinet strives to provide you and your family with a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. We offer competitive Paid Time Off and flexible leave policies, including paid health days, to help you take care of yourself and your family members.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

postings.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
postings.description:
Position overview and Job Responsibilities:

- Provide technical support to customers on security devices and Cloud deployments.
- Perform collection, analysis, and change recommendations of configuration of customer network information and packet capture.
- Recommend corrective actions based on gathered data and its analysis.
- Run real-time phone or remote access sessions with customers.
- Apply networking knowledge with a focus on L2, L3, L4, and L7.
- Debug and troubleshoot networking issues related to device misconfigurations, network connectivity, and L3 routing.
- Utilize engineering background to recreate customer issues in the lab and work with the engineering team to debug issues and verify workarounds/fixes.

Demonstrate knowledge and/or experience in each of the following:

- Network protocols and technologies: TCP/IP, UDP, SSH, TLS, SSL, HTTP, HTTPS, Proxy, VLAN, Routing, Content based routing, or URL modification
- OSI model
- Operating systems: Windows, Unix or Linux
- Internet security: firewall, IPSs, or Mail Security Gateways.

Desired:

- Having any of industry certificates (FCNSA, CCNA, CCIE)
- Basic experience with security devices (Firewalls, IPSs, Mail Security Gateways etc.)
- Knowledge of dynamic routing protocols and its implementation (OSPF, BGP)
- Knowledge of authentication protocols and methods (LDAP, SSO, 2-factor authentication etc.)
- Proficient spoken and written English
- Positive, communicative and customer oriented attitude

Education:

Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Engineering

US Citizenship is required.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $87,000-$107,000. Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time, as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors, including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at the time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

postings.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer -SIEM
postings.additional_locations: Pune, Maharashtra, India; Frankfurt, Hessen, Germany
postings.description:
Office based in Sophia Antipolis, Valbonne -France / Kelsterbach, Frankfurt -Germany OR Pune, India

Job Description Summary:

Fortinet is seeking experienced technical support engineers for our expanding EMEA team at the Sophia-Antipolis, France, and Frankfurt, Germany and Pune, India- Technical Assistance Centers. The ideal candidates shall develop in depth knowledge of the FortiSIEM product and will possess strong problem-solving skills, exceptional ability to gather and analyze information, and proficiency in developing effective solutions with the product for our customers.

In order to succeed in this position, it is imperative that the candidate possess exceptional oral and written communication skills, being able to articulate their action plan while also actively listening with attentiveness so as to fully comprehend the situation at hand. Additionally, one must be capable of responding effectively when faced with queries or challenges arising from positive or negative circumstances.

** Please note that this is not an IT/system administration position.

Key Responsibilities:

· Investigate customer issues, including replication of problems in-house, and working with engineering teams to provide solutions.

· Providing direct technical support via the phone, web based systems to our customers and partners though-out the EMEA Region.

· Analysis and technical investigation of reported problems.

· Provide technical solutions to address customer issues.

· Problem investigation using debug traces, logs and analysis of packet captures.

· Reproduction of complex customer environments on lab equipment.

· Follow-up with R&D departments to resolve product issues.

· Creation of technical documentation and bulletins to improve internal and external technical articles and whitepapers.

· Develop core competency on Fortinet’s product line and technologies

Skills and Attributes Requirements:

• Strong understanding of data networking protocols, TCP/IP, routing and switching.

• Experience with network management and analysis tools.

• Experience with the FortiSIEM or any other SIEM related product would be an advantage.

• Experience and certification with the FortiAnalyzer and FortiSOAR products would be an asset.

• A very good working knowledge of Linux operating systems.

• Experience with VMware and/or other virtualization technologies.

• Knowledge of cloud environments such as AWS and Azure.

• Good understanding of web application concepts such as Java EE, Apache, HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

• Database knowledge is a requirement, such as PostgreSQL & Clickhouse

• Understanding of security polices and vulnerability assessment management.

• Familiarity with API development tools and XML/JSON data structure knowledge.

• Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills.

• Exceptional communication skills.

• Previous experience on Fortinet products and Fortinet certifications are an advantage. FCP/NSE4 for example

Educational and Experience Requirements:

Five or more years of experience.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Security, Software Engineering or related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.

Advanced knowledge of English (written and spoken)+ local language.

#LI-NC1

About Fortinet:

Fortinet (NASDAQ: FTNT) protects the most valuable assets of some of the largest enterprise, service provider and government organizations across the globe. The company's fast, secure and global cyber security solutions provide broad, high-performance protection against dynamic security threats while simplifying the IT infrastructure. If you're looking for a fast-paced, challenging and rewarding environment, then Fortinet is the place for you. With offices in EMEA, we are an equal opportunity employer offering exciting work, competitive compensation and benefits. Fortinet is looking for the best and the brightest to join our highly motivated team.

postings.title: Senior Technical Support Specialist
postings.additional_locations: Atlanta, GA, United States; Frisco, TX, United States
postings.description:
Fortinet a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence. Our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. As we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity, Fortinet recently announced the opening of our latest global Innovation Hub, where our expansion will include a team of Technical Support Specialists. We are seeking to fill the Support Specialist role, a support and escalation point for Fortinet customers and partners with the goal of enhancing our global Customer Success and Support function, providing exceptional customer service and technical help for our loyal customers and to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business. In addition to being able to provide firsthand expertise in the day to day use of Fortinet technology, this role will also interface with QA and development to solve customer problems and identify solutions, optimizations and improvements through replication and testing.

As a Senior Technical Support Specialist, you will:

- Provide troubleshooting expertise on the core Fortinet products - especially FortiGate
- Collection, analysis and change recommendations of configuration information
- Collection and analysis of customer system information
- Recommend corrective actions based on analysis
- Provide Customer education where needed due to gaps in networking, product knowledge etc.
- Consultation of technical documentation, bulletins and release notes for known problems
- Reproduction of customer environments on lab equipment; work to isolate and solve problems; recommend potential new solutions.
- Follow up on technical cases including proper escalation and management of the case until case closure.
- Manage customer communications and expectations until the closure of each case; conduct and lead customer management meetings regarding escalation

We Are Looking For:

- Candidate with a minimum 3 plus years of experience in a technical support or system administration role in a networking/security company or equivalent education
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering or related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience is desirable.
- Deep working knowledge of operating systems -- Windows, OSX, Unix/Linux
- Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols, L2/L3 switching.
- Experience with security products -firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, virus scanning.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
- Past experience using AI tools to help the effectiveness of day-to-day activities
- Previous call center experience, preferably supporting data networking products and/or security products is desirable.
- A working understanding of knowledge management principles in daily workflow; KCS® framework experience is an added advantage
- Ability to work in the office 3-5 days a week
- Possibility of an on-Call rotation
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

postings.title: Senior Threat Hunting Specialist
postings.description:
We are hiring a Senior Threat Hunting Specialist who combines deep threat-hunting expertise with practical purple-team simulation skills to support an AI-driven detection program. The ideal candidate understands attacker TTPs in depth, can design hypothesis-driven hunts from telemetry, and can script concise attack simulations to generate realistic logs and telemetry in a test environment for validating detections. This role focuses on attacker thinking, preparing and conducting simulations, threat detection SIEM query design and SOC detection validation. Moreover, this role will contribute to features design for ML-driven detection capabilities.

As a senior Threat Hunting Specialist, your responsibilities will include:

- Perform hypothesis-driven threat hunting projects and translate attacker TTPs into measurable telemetry signals (IOAs/IOCs) suitable for ML feature design.

- Collaborate with ML engineers and data scientists to define, propose, and validate candidate features.

- Specify feature engineering transformations, labeling rules, sampling strategies, and evaluation metrics; support feature importance and explainability analysis.

- Create hypothesis-driven detection reports and dashboards from telemetry sources and perform threat hunting investigations using the insights surfaced by those reports.

- Design and execute controlled red-team style simulations (scripted PoCs) in test environments to create labeled datasets for training and validation; ensure simulations are realistic, diverse, and safely scoped.

- Track emerging threats, map them to MITRE ATT&CK, and propose new simulation scenarios and detection features as adversaries evolve.

Requirements (Must - have):

- 5+ years’ experience in threat hunting, SOC/IR, Blue\Red\Purple team experince, or related security roles with demonstrable hunting casework.

- Strong understanding of attacker techniques and the ability to decompose attack chains (MITRE ATT&CK fluency).

- Proven ability to propose hunting hypotheses and identify relevant telemetry fields/signals.

- Experience collaborating with ML or data science teams to define feature requirements, labeling strategies, and validation criteria.

- Proficient with ClickHouse and PostgreSQL, and able to produce clear, high-quality security analysis reports based on telemetry and hunting findings.

- Practical scripting ability for attack simulation and PoC generation (Python required; PowerShell/Bash/other scripting as applicable). Note: production engineering and model training are handled by the team.

- Familiarity with common hunting/detection platforms and telemetry sources (SIEM, EDR/XDR, network and cloud logs, container telemetry).

- Strong analytical reasoning, incident investigation mindset, and excellent written/verbal communication skills.

Bonus/Preferred

- Industry certifications: GIAC GCFA, GCTI, OSCP/OSCE.

- Hands-on red team / adversary emulation experience beyond simple PoCs.

- Familiarity with SOAR products and concepts.

- Familiarity with ML concepts and validation metrics.

- Familiarity with Fortinet product telemetry and tooling — e.g., FortiAnalyzer and FortiSIEM for aggregated and correlation logs, FortiGate traffic/event logs, and FortiEDR endpoint telemetry. Able to map Fortinet event fields to hunting features and to explain which Fortinet logs provide the signals needed for specific TTPs.

postings.title: Senior Threat Intelligence Research Engineer
postings.description:
Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic FortiGuard Senior Threat Intelligence Research Engineer to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

FortiGuard SE team is a special strategic engagement team, specialized in FortiGuard support and threat expertise including threat intelligence/campaign awareness, exploits and penetration testing, artificial intelligence and advanced malware concepts. Since this team engages externally, candidates must have some soft skills and be willing to speak, network and travel while applying expert industry knowledge at both high and low-level articulation.

Senior Threat Intelligence Research Engineer -FortiGuard will work in a demanding, exciting and engaging field to provide subject matter expertise in security, threat and C-Suite perspective. Main responsibilities will be external engagement strategy including but not limited to C-suite engagement, executive briefings (EBC), thought leadership and brand building, keynote/plenary speaking to large audiences for knowledge transfer and empowerment. Support for presales for large revenue opportunity is also required, as well as mentorship and training to sales and marketing workforce.

This role is designed to operate at the strategic intersection of cybersecurity threat intelligence and enterprise sales execution. It will engage directly with sales leadership and account teams to identify and drive whitespace opportunities within major and Global 2000 accounts. A core focus of the role will be on enabling and accelerating SecOps-driven engagements, positioning Fortinet’s advanced threat detection, response, and automation capabilities as critical components of the customer’s security operations strategy.

The ideal candidate will be deeply enthusiastic about thinking outside the box—bringing creativity and innovation to how threat intelligence, threat hunting, and adversary tradecraft are applied in real-world environments. This includes a strong working knowledge of how artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are shaping the future of cyber operations, and how these technologies can be leveraged to uncover hidden threats, accelerate investigation workflows, and outmaneuver sophisticated adversaries.

This position will act as a trusted advisor and Subject Matter Expert (SME) in FortiGuard Labs and Threat Intelligence, interfacing closely with FortiGuard R&D to bring cutting-edge threat insights and research directly into the field to support high-impact opportunities.

FortiGuard Services offer broad security solutions including antivirus, intrusion prevention, Web content filtering and anti-spam capabilities. These services help protect against threats on both application and network layers. FortiGuard Services are updated by FortiGuard Labs, which enables Fortinet to deliver a combination of multi-layered security intelligence and zero-day protection from new and emerging threats.

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Research Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

- You will be required attend multiple meetings and events at the Fortinet Sunnyvale, CA offices. Candidates local to the region will be preferred. Remote candidates should expect up to 75% travel. The travel requirements are expected to be within the United States. However, some travel to Canada and other regions may be needed from time-to-time.
- The FortiGuard SE must have a clear understanding of advanced threat in cyber including understanding advanced cyber-attacks, understanding adversarial AI techniques and ML models, being able to create labs and demos, being able to work with Fortinet products to showcase mitigation techniques.
- The FortiGuard SE must be an excellent speaker who can articulate technical concepts into appropriate terms for a given target audience
- The FortiGuard SE will be a technical resource focused on FortiGuard services & technology (primarily AI, Antivirus, IPS, Webfiltering, Antispam) and threat intelligence
- The FortiGuard SE will also be an expert on threat and SOC solutions including FortiRecon, FortiSOAR, FortiNDR, Deceptor, Sandbox, EDR/XDR and ZTNA. Candidates with experience in complex SOAR and ASM technologies are preferred.
- Scale and train workforce as a subject matter expert, including FCISO team and SE/CSE community
- Liaison and support strategic relationships for AMER region, including key threat intelligence vertical ISACs
- Support training efforts. This may include creating cyber ranges, training classes, labs, and demos.
- Engage in public speaking representing Fortinet as a thought leader in industry
- Work with marketing group to create leads from existing security alliances and relationships
- Create new content for use in presentations, whitepapers, and so forth
- Deliver executive briefings to executives and highly technical teams at Fortinet’s HQ located in Sunnyvale, California. This will be a primary focus of the role.
- Deliver technical presentations, webcasts and SE/sales knowledge transfer
- Demonstrate FortiGuard security concepts in relation to Fortinet product, most importantly APT and threat intelligence
- Collaborates closely with the sales team and is expected to be able to clearly position Fortinet both from a technical and business perspective against the identified competitors
- Subject matter expertise including lab development, reverse engineering/malware analysis and threat hunting with part of the role working on these projects

We are looking for:

- Technical presentation skills translated to a C-level environment are a must; act as a leading industry and subject matter expert
- 10+ years of experience in industry with similar presentation experience
- Understand malware and sandbox concepts (PE32/64 Windows); ARM/mobile is a bonus
- Understand security vulnerability and exploit lifecycle
- Penetration testing framework (ie: Metasploit) experience is a valuable asset
- Networking concepts are an asset
- Candidates should feel comfortable interpedently researching cyber, hacking, and AI topics, creating labs, demos, and training, and creating CTF programs.
- Articulate and comfortable presenting to groups; ability to communicate effectively to technical and business leaders
- Clear understanding of competitive landscape and differentiators in regard to APT defense
- Work closely with the SE/CSE community, to ensure the growth of the associated products and accounts in their region
- Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience. Graduate degree preferred.

postings.title: Senior Threat Intelligence Research Engineer
postings.description:
Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic FortiGuard Senior Threat Intelligence Research Engineer to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business. FortiGuard SE team is a special strategic engagement team, specialized in FortiGuard support and threat expertise including threat intelligence/campaign awareness, exploits and penetration testing, artificial intelligence and advanced malware concepts. Since this team engages externally, candidates must have some soft skills and be willing to speak, network and travel while applying expert industry knowledge at both high- and low-level articulation.

This role is ideal for cybersecurity professionals with a strong background in offensive security, adversarial AI, and hands-on threat intelligence. The position involves designing and delivering advanced technical workshops, demos, and Capture-the-Flag (CTF) challenges that simulate real-world threat scenarios across domains such as Active Directory exploitation, malware emulation, and AI model manipulation. The ideal candidate should have experience building and maintaining cyber labs using technologies like Active Directory, SQL, Docker, and Kubernetes, as well as familiarity with malware reverse engineering, darknet investigations, and threat hunting practices. This role supports presales efforts for large revenue opportunities, bridging subject matter expertise for a focus on technical enablement, thought leadership, and content creation that empowers security practitioners and enhances Fortinet’s brand. Support for executive briefings (EBCs) will also be required, with emphasis will be on building strategic assets and delivering value through high-impact demonstrations.

Candidates should be comfortable presenting to technical and business stakeholders alike, collaborating across teams, and contributing to FortiGuard’s mission of disrupting adversaries through intelligence-driven defense. The ideal candidate will be deeply enthusiastic about thinking outside the box—bringing creativity and innovation to how threat intelligence, threat hunting, and adversary tradecraft are applied in real-world environments.

A core focus of the role will be on enabling and accelerating SecOps-driven engagements, positioning Fortinet’s advanced threat detection, response, and automation capabilities as critical components of the customer’s security operations strategy. This position will act as a trusted advisor and Subject Matter Expert (SME) in FortiGuard Labs and Threat Intelligence, interfacing closely with FortiGuard R&D to bring cutting-edge threat insights and research directly into the field to support high-impact opportunities.

FortiGuard Services offer broad security solutions including antivirus, intrusion prevention, Web content filtering and anti-spam capabilities. These services help protect against threats on both application and network layers. FortiGuard Services are updated by FortiGuard Labs, which enables Fortinet to deliver a combination of multi-layered security intelligence and zero-day protection from new and emerging threats.

As a FortiGuard Senior Threat Intelligence Research Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

- Ideal Candidate should be based in Frankfurt, supporting presales effort in region to drive revenue growth and be expected to travel up to 50% of their time.
- The FortiGuard SE must have a clear understanding of advanced threat in cyber including understanding advanced cyber-attacks, understanding adversarial AI techniques and ML models, being able to create labs and demos, being able to work with Fortinet products to showcase mitigation techniques.
- The FortiGuard SE must be an excellent speaker who can articulate technical concepts into appropriate terms for a given target audience.
- The FortiGuard SE will be a technical resource focused on FortiGuard services & technology (primarily AI, Antivirus, IPS, Webfiltering, Antispam) and threat intelligence
- Liaison and support strategic relationships for AMER region, including key threat intelligence vertical ISACs.
- Act as a technical mentor and resource for sales engineers, partners, and marketing teams, particularly around emerging threats and adversarial use of AI.
- Contribute to thought leadership efforts through blog posts, webinars, research content, and conference presentations.
- Work with marketing group to create leads from existing security alliances and relationships.
- Create new content for use in presentations, whitepapers, and so forth.
- Deliver technical presentations, webcasts and SE/sales knowledge transfer
- Demonstrate FortiGuard security concepts in relation to Fortinet product, most importantly APT and threat intelligence.
- Subject matter expertise including lab development, reverse engineering/malware analysis and threat hunting with part of the role working on these projects.

We are looking for:

- Technical presentation skills translated to a C-level environment are a must; act as a leading industry and subject matter expert.
- 10+ years of experience in industry with similar presentation experience.
- Understand malware and sandbox concepts (PE32/64 Windows); ARM/mobile is a bonus.
- Understand security vulnerability and exploit lifecycle.
- Penetration testing framework (ie: Metasploit) experience is a valuable asset
- Networking concepts is essential.
- Candidates should feel comfortable interpedently researching cyber, hacking, and AI topics, creating labs, demos, and training, and creating CTF programs.
- Articulate and comfortable presenting to groups; ability to communicate effectively to technical and business leaders.
- Clear understanding of competitive landscape and differentiators in regard to APT defense.
- Work closely with the SE/CSE community, to ensure the growth of the associated products and accounts in their region.
- Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience. Graduate degree preferred.

About Our Team:

Join our team, known for its collaborative ethos, working seamlessly with global customers, internal engineering teams and product development groups. Our team culture emphasizes continuous learning, innovation, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. We embrace Fortinet’s core values of openness, teamwork and innovation, fostering an environment where team members support each other, share knowledge, and leverage AI to solve complex technical challenges. Our inclusive and dynamic team thrives on collaboration and is driven by the shared goal of maintaining Fortinet’s high standards of excellence in cybersecurity solutions.
