The Global Service Portfolio department sits within the wider Customer Success and Support organization, which is responsible for enabling partners and end users to successfully deploy, adopt, and support Fortinet technologies. The Service Portfolio team provides strategic and tactical leadership across initiatives focused on service innovation, operational excellence, and performance optimization.
With a diverse and evolving portfolio of services, the role requires strong thought leadership, analytical capability, and problem solving skills to drive improvements and ensure alignment with organizational goals. The Service Portfolio Project Manager contributes expertise across support, customer success, and professional services, shaping both, and delivering against short and long term service roadmaps.
Success in this role depends on building strong cross functional relationships, influencing stakeholders, and ensuring effective execution of multiple concurrent initiatives. Robust risk management, clear communication, and proactive mitigation are essential to maintain momentum and deliver expected outcomes.
The role may include ownership of a specific service or support domain, requiring the development and execution of a roadmap aligned with the broader service portfolio strategy. As a subject matter expert, the position also collaborates with Sales and Marketing to support go to market activities and ensure the organization is equipped to achieve growth objectives.

A structured yet adaptable approach is required, with flexibility to support wider team obligations as needed.

Responsibilities

Service Portfolio & Strategy
•Contribute to the organization’s vision and strategy for services.
•Manage the lifecycle of services within the service portfolio, ensuring each service has a defined value proposition, business case, and lifecycle plan.
•Conduct market and competitive research to inform service strategy and identify opportunities.
•Ensure services are evaluated for strategic fit, financial viability, operational readiness, and customer value.
•Maintain the Service Portfolio and collaborate on the Service Catalogue with Service Owners.

•Monitor value realization and ensure services deliver expected outcomes.

•Coordinate internal resources and third party vendors to ensure flawless execution.
•Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
•Manage changes in project scope, schedule, and cost using appropriate verification techniques.
•Track and report project performance using appropriate tools and methodologies.
•Perform risk management to minimize project risks and escalate issues appropriately.
•Maintain comprehensive project documentation.

Stakeholder & Cross Functional Engagement
•Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, stakeholders, and external partners.
•Understand stakeholder information needs and provide timely, accurate reporting.
•Support Sales and Marketing with subject matter expertise, collateral development, and go to market activities.
•Ensure compliance with internal governance frameworks, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

Competencies
Strategic & Analytical Thinking
•Ability to translate organizational strategy into actionable service roadmaps.
•Strong analytical skills to interpret data, evaluate service performance, and support decision making.
•Demonstrates structured problem solving and the ability to identify root causes and improvement opportunities.

Service Management Expertise
•Understanding of ITIL service lifecycle practices and service portfolio management.
•Ability to assess service value, viability, and alignment with business objectives.
•Skilled in developing business cases, cost models, and value assessments.

Project & Program Leadership
•Proficient in managing complex, multi stream initiatives with clear planning and prioritization.
•Strong capability in scope, schedule, budget, and risk management.
•Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and disciplined execution.
Stakeholder Influence & Communication
•Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
•Strong influencing skills to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus.
•Ability to manage conflict constructively and maintain productive relationships.

Customer Centric Mindset
•Understands customer needs, pain points, and success drivers.
•Integrates customer insights into service design and improvement.
•Advocates for customer value in prioritization and decision making.

Technical & Domain Knowledge
•Solid understanding of networking, cybersecurity, and support service models.
•Ability to evaluate technical feasibility and collaborate effectively with engineering and operations teams.

Personal Effectiveness
•Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
•Self motivated, proactive, and capable of working effectively in remote or global environments.
•Demonstrates resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning.

Degree in a technical or management discipline, or equivalent professional experience in project management or service management.

postings.title: Software Dev QA Engineer
postings.description:
Fortinet is developing high-performance security platforms for data center and carrier/service-provider networks. We are looking for a QA Engineer to join the FortiGate Chassis platform team and help validate high-end firewall systems designed for high throughput, scalability, resiliency, and availability.

The role focuses on distributed state synchronization, session-aware traffic distribution, system resiliency, performance, scalability, and automation. Our ideal candidate has strong networking and Linux fundamentals, good troubleshooting and scripting skills, and enjoys working with complex systems and new technologies.

Job Duties

- Design, execute, and automate functional, system, performance, scalability, and reliability testing for FortiGate Chassis platforms.
- Validate synchronization and consistency of configuration, FIB/FDB, sessions, and other runtime states across chassis components.
- Validate packet forwarding and session-aware load balancing/distribution under high-throughput and large-scale traffic conditions.
- Test system resiliency, state recovery, and service continuity during module failure, restart, failover, upgrade, and other system transitions.
- Troubleshoot complex system and data-plane issues using packet captures, logs, counters, and system diagnostic tools.
- Develop and maintain test automation and tools using Python and Bash.
- Work closely with Development and QA teams to understand new features, identify defects, and improve test coverage.
- Design and maintain test environments and identify required networking and test equipment.

Job Experience Required

- 3+ years of experience in networking, system testing, software QA, or a related engineering role.
- Strong understanding of TCP/IP, Layer 2/3/4 packet forwarding, VLAN, LAG/LACP, ARP/ND, NAT, and HA.
- Good understanding of stateful networking, forwarding tables, MAC/FDB tables, sessions, and traffic distribution.
- Strong hands-on Linux and system troubleshooting skills.
- Good Python and Bash scripting/automation skills.
- Experience with packet analysis and diagnostic tools such as Wireshark and tcpdump.
- Familiarity with virtual machines and container technologies.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with high-performance firewalls, routers, switches, or chassis-based networking platforms.
- Experience with distributed networking systems, state synchronization, HA/failover, or system recovery.
- Experience with traffic generators, performance/load testing, and large-scale network testing.
- Hands-on experience with virtualization and container technologies such as KVM, VMware, Docker, or LXC.
- Networking certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or Fortinet NSE are a plus.

postings.title: Software Development Engineer (Machine Learning)
postings.description:
FortiAIGate is Fortinet's AI security and governance gateway. It sits inline between enterprise users, AI agents, and LLM providers, inspecting prompts and responses in real time to detect prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive data exposure, and policy violations — under a strict latency budget.

We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to own the detection models behind that product: training, evaluation, optimization, and the serving stack that runs them in production.

Responsibilities

- Build and train guardrail models. Develop classifiers that detect prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, unsafe content, and sensitive data exposure across prompts, responses, and tool-call payloads — dataset construction through to release.
- Design and tune the tiered detection cascade. Balance a low-cost first-stage screen against a higher-fidelity semantic stage, tuning thresholds to hit accuracy targets inside a fixed per-request latency budget.
- Work across encoder and decoder model families. Fine-tune encoder-based classifiers and token-level taggers for detection and extraction; adapt small decoder models for semantic judgment. Use distillation to move capability into models small enough to deploy.
- Optimize and serve models inline. Quantize, distill, and compile models (ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, INT8/FP8) for GPU appliances. Deploy and tune them on Triton Inference Server and vLLM — batching, concurrent model execution, KV-cache and memory configuration, multi-stage pipelines — and profile out the bottlenecks.
- Harden models against evasion. Threat research on obfuscation and encoding bypass, dilution attacks, indirect injection, and multi-turn attacks visible only across conversational context. Turn each new bypass into training data and a regression test.
- Own evaluation and governance detectors. Build benchmark and suites measuring detection rate at production-realistic false positive rates; monitor deployed models for drift. Maintain detection models for personal and regulated data and for natural-language policy, including multilingual coverage.

Required Qualifications

- Strong Python and production PyTorch experience; comfort with Go/Rust/C/C++ for performance-critical paths is valuable.
- Demonstrated experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating transformer models — encoder classifiers, decoder language models, or both — with Hugging Face Transformers or equivalent.
- Production experience with a modern inference serving system (Triton, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI), including the batching and memory tuning real throughput requires.
- Practical model optimization: quantization, distillation, pruning, or graph compilation, with a record of holding accuracy while cutting latency or memory.
- Sound evaluation instincts — able to design test sets that reflect deployment reality and reason about precision/recall where false positives block legitimate user traffic.
- Working knowledge of tokenization, text normalization, and Unicode handling, and how these become an attack surface in a security product.
- Familiarity with containerized deployment (Docker, Kubernetes) and standard MLOps practice: experiment tracking, model versioning, reproducible training pipelines.
- Ability to deliver on schedule in an Agile environment and communicate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

- Modeling experience in a security or abuse-detection domain, where adversaries adapt to your defenses.
- Familiarity with the LLM threat landscape — prompt injection, indirect injection, exfiltration through model output — and with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
- Gradient-boosted tree models (LightGBM, XGBoost) and hybrid classical/neural architectures.
- NER, PII detection, or data classification models, particularly multilingual.
- CUDA familiarity, GPU profiling, or deploying models under fixed hardware and memory constraints.
- Synthetic data generation, active learning, or human-in-the-loop labeling where labeled data is scarce.
- Publications, open-source work, or CTF/red-team experience in adversarial ML or LLM security.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

- Minimum of 8 years’ experience in networking (Campus & DC LAN, WIFI, WAN, SDN, routing, switching), and network security (Next-Gen Firewalls, Intrusion Detection, encryption protocols).

- Minimum of 5 years’ experience as IT Security Consultant or Architect with proven success.

- Strong customer focus and in depth understanding of the requirements and challenges university customers are facing – resulting in the ability to address complex technical and business requirements with a self-motivated, positive attitude and entrepreneurial mindset.

- Goal-driven and able to adapt to shifting priorities, demands and t and timelines.

- Proven ability to work independently and lead a team in a collaborative environment.

- Ability to interface with senior levels of internal and external organizations is required.

- Expert level verbal & written communication, presentation, prioritization, and interpersonal skills.

- Minimum foundational knowledge of:

- Datacenter architectures (e.g. ACI, NSX-T)

- Security Architectures (e.g. Zero Trust, SASE)

- Modern Software Architectures (e.g. DevOps, IaC)

- Cloud Architectures with at least one public cloud specialization

- Security Operations (e.g. Orchestration, Automation, SIEM Tools)

- IT Security standards (e.g. BSI 200-x, ISO2700x, COBIT, NIST) and/or relevant regulations (EU-DSGVO, BDSG, NIS-2/KRITIS, CRA, AI Act).

- Excellent German and English language skills.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Graduate degree preferred.

- First-to-Touch Next-Gen Technology: You will be the very first engineer to power on, validate, and stress-test brand-new hardware models and flagship security capabilities long before general release.
- Deep System & Platform Scope: The work bridges the entire stack—from board-level hardware verification, firmware/BIOS security, and low-level subsystem auditing to advanced networking protocols and next-generation connectivity.
- Direct Influence on Product Quality: Working alongside platform developers and hardware architects, your diagnostic insights and edge-case testing directly shape product reliability and architecture across Fortinet's flagship product line.
- Dynamic, High-Impact Engineering: Every project brings new hardware architectures, specialized subsystem modules, and complex network environments, offering continuous technical challenges beyond standard QA routines.

Job Qualifications & Experience

- Senior-Level Experience: 5+ years of hands-on QA/testing experience focused on network security appliances, routing, switching, and firewall platforms.
- Network & Security Expertise: Deep hands-on experience configuring, validating, and troubleshooting enterprise firewalls/NGFWs (FortiGate or comparable platforms), including routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), IPsec/SSL VPN, HA clusters, NAT, DNS, and DHCP.
- Troubleshooting & Traffic Analysis: Strong diagnostic skills using packet capture analysis tools (Wireshark) and CLI-based debugging to isolate network anomalies and system-level defects.

The ideal candidate will provide technical leadership, drive infrastructure projects, and mentor other engineers while ensuring the reliability and security of Fortinet's global network.

Lead network architecture, expansion, and modernization projects for offices, labs, and data centers.

Maintain critical infrastructure through upgrades, hardware refreshes, and lifecycle management.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex network issues and lead root cause analysis for major incidents.

Develop and maintain network standards, documentation, and operational procedures.

Enhance network security by implementing best practices, hardening standards, and new technologies.

Collaborate with vendors and service providers for hardware, software, and connectivity solutions.

- Bachelor or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

- Working knowledge of fundamental networking concepts and technologies, including switches, routers, MAC addresses, ARP, ICMP/Ping, Traceroute, and related troubleshooting tools.

- Understanding of basic Network and Application security concepts, including firewalls, data encryption, data integrity, authentication, and secure communications.

- Proficiency in at least one scripting language (such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and one compiled programming language (such as C/C++, Golang, or Rust).

- Good understanding of fundamental operating system concepts, including processes and threads, memory management, file systems, and sockets.

- Hands-on experience working with both Windows and Linux operating systems.

- Hands-on experience on GIT or SVN

- Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Strong attention to detail and a passion for finding defects and edge cases.

- Experience with virtualization technologies and VM environments.

postings.title: Strategic Channel Account Manager
postings.description:
Strategic Channel Account Manager – Germany

The successful candidate will be responsible for the strategic development and transformation of one key partner, ensuring alignment with Fortinet’s growth priorities and market objectives. As a trusted business advisor, the Strategic Channel Account Manager will create and execute multi-year business and investment plans, including revenue growth initiatives, go-to-market strategies, MDF investments, solution expansion programs, sales enablement activities, and profitability targets.

This role demands deep industry expertise, strong business acumen, and a proven track record of successfully managing and growing large, complex strategic partnerships. The individual must be capable of influencing partner executive leadership, identifying new growth opportunities, and driving measurable business outcomes across multiple Fortinet solution areas.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

- Own and strategically develop one of Fortinet’s largest and most strategic partner relationships in Germany.
- Develop and execute comprehensive annual and multi-year business plans that drive sustainable revenue growth, market expansion, and solution adoption.
- Create and manage joint investment plans, including MDF strategy, resource allocation, enablement initiatives, marketing programs, and growth acceleration activities.
- Build trusted relationships with partner executive leadership, sales management, technical leadership, and key stakeholders.
Identify, develop, and execute strategic growth initiatives that increase market share, customer acquisition, and wallet share across the partner base.
- Lead regular business reviews, executive sponsor engagements, and strategic planning sessions with partner leadership teams.
- Drive partner transformation initiatives to expand Fortinet’s footprint into new solution areas, markets, and customer segments.
Collaborate closely with Fortinet Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to maximize joint business opportunities.
- Develop and execute account penetration strategies and regional growth plans aligned with Fortinet’s strategic objectives.
- Manage channel programs, registrations, renewals, and performance metrics while ensuring alignment with business plan objectives.
- Carry and consistently achieve quarterly and annual revenue targets.

Qualifications

- Minimum 10 years of channel sales, partner management, or business development experience within the cybersecurity, networking, or enterprise technology industry.
- Proven experience managing and developing large, strategic partner organizations with complex business structures and significant revenue responsibility.
- Demonstrated success in creating and executing business plans, investment plans, marketing strategies, and growth programs with measurable business outcomes.
- Strong executive presence with experience engaging and influencing C-Level executives and senior management across partner organizations.
- Deep understanding of channel business models, partner profitability drivers, and ecosystem development.
- Proven ability to identify market opportunities, drive strategic initiatives, and accelerate revenue growth.
- Experience managing substantial revenue targets in a fast-paced, highly competitive environment.
- Excellent analytical, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong knowledge of cybersecurity and networking markets, industry trends, and strategic partner ecosystems.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a highly experienced channel leader with a strong network within the German IT channel ecosystem and a proven ability to build, influence, and transform strategic partnerships. They combine strategic thinking with execution excellence and possess extensive experience in business planning, investment planning, executive engagement, and long-term partner development for large enterprise-focused solution providers.

postings.title: Supply Chain Buyer
postings.description:
Position Summary

Under direct supervision, the Supply Chain Buyer supports purchasing, material planning, and logistics activities to ensure uninterrupted production. The role is primarily responsible for purchase order execution, supplier management, material availability, and ERP accuracy, while also coordinating logistics for purchased materials.

The position works closely with Planning, Manufacturing, Finance, Warehouse, suppliers, freight forwarders, and global supply chain teams. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong ownership, follow-through, and the ability to proactively identify and resolve supply and logistics issues.

Key Responsibilities

Purchasing & Material Management

- Execute and manage purchase orders with domestic and international suppliers based on demand, MRP requirements, and production schedules.
- Monitor supplier commitments, delivery dates, open orders, and on-time delivery performance in the ERP system.
- Maintain accurate purchasing master data, including supplier information, lead times, and pricing.
- Communicate with suppliers on delivery commitments, shortages, expedites, and supply issues.
- Track PPV, validate pricing against approved quotes/contracts, and support cost-control initiatives.
- Partner with Planning, Manufacturing, Finance, and Accounts Payable to resolve material, pricing, invoice, and receiving issues.

Logistics Coordination

- Coordinate transportation of purchased materials with freight forwarders and logistics providers.
- Track inbound and outbound shipments and proactively address delays, delivery risks, and transportation issues.
- Obtain and review freight quotations, coordinate shipment routing/allocation, and verify freight invoices against agreed rates.
- Coordinate quarter-end shipments and expedite critical or time-sensitive deliveries.
- Maintain visibility of in-transit inventory and provide timely status updates to internal stakeholders.
- Coordinate with suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal teams to resolve customs, receiving, and delivery issues.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

- Flexibility to support global supply chain operations outside of standard business hours is an important requirement of this position.

- Participate in supply chain meetings and provide updates on purchase orders, material availability, supplier commitments, and logistics.
- Work with global supply chain teams and suppliers across multiple time zones to support material availability and shipment execution.
- Escalate critical supply, supplier, or logistics risks in a timely manner.
- Support process improvements related to purchasing efficiency, supplier performance, logistics execution, and lead-time reduction.
- Ensure procurement and logistics activities comply with company policies and documentation requirements.

Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in purchasing, procurement, materials, or supply chain operations, preferably in technology, electronics, or manufacturing.
- Experience managing purchase orders, suppliers, material availability, and delivery commitments.
- Experience working with freight forwarders, carriers, or logistics providers strongly preferred.
- Working knowledge of MRP, waterfall analysis, and RYG reporting in an EMS/electronics manufacturing environment.
- Familiarity with electronic components and BOMs preferred.
- Experience with international suppliers and shipments is a plus.
- Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and follow-through skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and proactively resolve issues.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- ERP experience required; Oracle experience preferred.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; Mandarin-speaking ability is a plus.

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, or a related field preferred.
- Associate degree with relevant purchasing/logistics experience may also be considered.
- 2+ years of relevant experience in purchasing, materials, logistics, transportation, or supply chain operations, preferably in a manufacturing environment.

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. Earnings for this position are expected to be $50,000.00 - $130,000.00 Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

Objective:

We are looking for people with the drive to make a difference in the leading cybersecurity company in the world based out of Guyana. Someone that is eager to understand customers and prospects needs and put his/her knowledge, experience and creativity into designing solutions and showcasing solutions leveraging the best and most innovative technology. As a Systems Engineer this person will play a critical role supporting the sales organization in all technical matters regarding pre-sales and technical sales. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise, business acumen and soft skills to interact with highly technical professionals, decision makers, stakeholders, and leaders to drive enterprise cybersecurity sales.

Responsibilities:

· Assist in qualifying sales leads from an Engineering standpoint.

· Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers and sales teams.

· Lead technical sales meetings with customers to understand their Cybersecurity challenges and requirements and align them to Fortinet solutions and services.

· Be the main technical resource for sales meetings to answer and collaborate with? the customer around Fortinet solutions features, specifications, and functionalities.

· Build cybersecurity solutions and Bill of Materials aligned to customers’ needs and requirements.

· Conduct technical presentations of Fortinet products and solutions.

· Lead the technical sales activities like assisting partners in the process of answering RFxs, demonstrations, Proof of Concepts, ensuring Fortinet’s solutions exceed customer expectations.

· Act as the primary technical contact for customers and partners, collaborating closely with Account Managers, demonstrating Fortinet’s valued proposition.

· Be able to clearly understand, articulate and deliver Fortinet’s value proposition, to customers and partners.

· Be a presenter in internal or external meetings, like events, Executive Briefing Centers (EBCs), Marketing activities, or any market positioning activity.

· Manage multiple opportunities effectively while maintaining exceptional customer experiences, with a great report within internal tools.

· Proactively manage internal and external communications including calls, emails, and chats based on the predefined SLAs.

· Stay ahead of cybersecurity trends and Fortinet’s product offerings.

Required Skills and experience:

· 3+ years of experience in Security Operations Teams (Blue Team, Red Team, SOC Manager, Senior SOC Analyst).

· 3+ years in Networking Security (Lan/ WAN and WLAN Admin/ Manager) experience with NGFW/ SDWAN technologies, Large Campus and Datacenter Networking solutions.

· 2+ Years of experience in pre-sales engineering roles is a plus.

· Deep understanding of enterprise network security architectures, industry cybersecurity frameworks, and regulations such as NIST, MITRE ATT&CK, COBIT, PCI-DSS, FERPA, HIPAA and Zero Trust.

· Strong understanding of Enterprise Cybersecurity and Network Architectures. Knowledge of the following concepts: Network Security, Security Operations, Cloud Technologies, Secure Access Service Edge, Network Access Control.

· Strong understanding of the following technologies and protocols: RADIUS, LDAP, PKI, IKE, Certificates, L2TP, VXLAN, IPSEC, 802.1Q, AES, SSH, TLS/SSL, SHA.

· Understanding of Private and Public Cloud environments like VMWare, Hyper-V, Kubernetes, GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI, and Nutanix.

· Experience with modern encryption, authentication and IAM technologies

· Strong understanding in the following solutions: SIEM, SOAR, EDR, EPP, PAM, DLP is a plus

· Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical teams.

· Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

· Professional proficient in English, being able to effectively participate in technical discussions, internal and external meetings, and written communication.

Education and Certifications:

· Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.

· CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, CEH, GSEC, OSCP, TOGAF or other professional level credentials/accreditations are a plus.

· Fortinet Certifications (FCP, FCSS, FCX) are a plus

· Cloud Certifications from a well-known vendor are a plus.

postings.title: Systems Engineer
postings.description:
Presales & Sales Cycle Support

- Support sales cycles through technical presentations, demos and proof-of-value sessions focused on SOC use cases.

- Assist Sales and pre-sales teams in responding to RFPs/RFIs involving SOC, SIEM/SOAR or managed security services requirements.

- Build and deliver competitive positioning material showing Fortinet's SOC advantages versus PANW, Cato, Zscaler and other vendors.

- Support solution sizing and technical proposal creation together with sales counterparts.

SOC Technical Advisory

- Act as the recognized technical trusted advisor for SOC matters, engaging peer-to-peer with Telco SOC analysts and architects.

- Understand and speak the internal language of the Telco SOC: its validation processes, escalation flows, and operational requirements for accepting new solutions into commercial offers.

- Support the Telco through the internal homologation and validation process required before any managed cybersecurity offer can reach their end customers.

SOC Solution Development & Monetization

- Drive adoption of FortiAnalyzer, FortiSOC and SOCaaS within Telco SOC environments.

- Help Telcos design offers that monetize their own SOC as a sellable service to their end customers, rather than treating it purely as an internal cost center.

- Support the Telco's shift from reselling standalone products to delivering managed services, strengthening our competitive position against PANW, Cato, Zscaler and other vendors.

AI-Driven Integration & Automation

- Design and support API-driven integrations between Fortinet solutions and the Telco's self-service portals and internal tooling.

- Apply AI-driven analysis approaches to help Telco SOCs improve incident response time and reduce analyst workload.

- Support Zero Touch Provisioning (ZTP) and automated deployment models for Fortinet solutions within Telco environments.

Cross-Account Best Practice & Enablement

- Connect learnings and best practices across all 7 regional Telco accounts (America Movil, Millicom, Liberty, Cirion, IFX, Entel and GTD) and their multiple country operations.

- Partner closely with the GAMs and SEs already dedicated to each account, complementing their work with deep, hands-on SOC expertise.

- Execute regional SecOps strategy in coordination with sales, pre-sales, product and operations teams.

Enablement, Documentation & Representation

- Create and maintain technical documentation, playbooks and presentations that help Telcos and internal teams understand SOC integration paths.

- Represent Fortinet in technical discussions, workshops and events focused on Telco and Service Provider cybersecurity operations.

Stay current on SOC, SIEM/SOAR and managed security services trends across the industry.

Professional Experience

- 5+ years of experience in a presales, solutions engineering or technical sales role within cybersecurity.

- 5+ years of direct, SOC background: incident validation, escalation, analyst workflows, and solution homologation.

- Previous experience working with Service Providers, Telcos or MSSPs (as employee, partner or vendor) is highly desirable, but not a hard requirement.

Technical Skills & Expertise

- Strong knowledge of SOC-related technologies: SIEM, SOAR, EDR/NDR, threat analytics and incident response platforms.

- Familiarity with FortiAnalyzer, FortiSIEM, FortiSOAR, FortiEDR, FortiNDR or equivalent solutions from other vendors.

- Understanding of API integrations, automation and scripting (Python, Ansible, Terraform or similar) to connect SOC platforms with self-service portals.

- Working knowledge of AI-driven security analytics and how they apply to incident detection and response.

- Solid understanding of network security fundamentals: Firewall/VPN, IPS/IDS, authentication and encryption protocols (IPSec, SSL, AES, SHA).

- Fortinet product certifications are a plus.

Soft Skills & Competencies

- Fluent in English and Spanish (spoken and written) - required.

- Portuguese is a strong plus.

- Comfortable owning the full presales cycle: discovery, technical demo, proof-of-value, proposal support and closing technical objections.

- Ability to build credibility and trust directly with technical SOC analysts, not only with commercial stakeholders.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, detail-oriented.

- Self-motivated, able to work independently across multiple accounts and countries without direct supervision.

- Excellent presentation skills, able to engage audiences from SOC analyst level to C-level.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, multi-country, matrixed environment.

Additional Requirements

- Availability to travel across LATAM as needed to support regional Telco accounts.

Job Skills & qualifications

Sales Acumen & Track Record

- Proven background in pre-sales engineering, technical business development, or solution consulting with direct quota-carrying or deal-acceleration alignment.

- Demonstrated history of orchestrating complex enterprise sales cycles, managing stakeholders from SecOps analysts to the C-suite (CISO/CIO).

- High proficiency in consultative selling frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger, Command of the Message).

Domain & Technical Expertise

- Outstanding practical understanding of the endpoint and data protection competitive landscape.

- Comprehensive understanding of threat economics, ransomware mechanics, incident lifecycle stages (MITRE ATT&CK), and regulatory compliance drivers (ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, local data privacy regulations).

- Hands-on familiarity with endpoint architectures: agent deployment mechanisms, API-driven integrations with SIEM/SOAR/ITSM platforms, ZTNA, and DLP inspection models (data in motion, data at rest, data in use).

Certifications (Preferred)

- Security Strategy & Architecture: CISSP, CISM, CCSK.

- Vendor & Technical Credentials: Fortinet NSE / FCSS (Security Operations or Enterprise Firewall), or recognized competitive certifications.

Responsabilities

- Partner with regional Sales Directors, Account Managers, and Channel Managers to define and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies targeting Endpoint and Data Protection Solutions.

postings.title: Systems Engineer (Automotive) - Tokyo/Nagoya/Osaka
postings.description:
Location: Japan (Nagoya)

Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic Systems Engineer to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

You would act as the Systems Engineer for Automotive.

As a Systems Engineer, you will:

- Play an integral role in providing pre-sales support and technical consultancy to customers.
- Understudy customer requirements, environment and challenges and able to propose/provide security solution design and implementation solutions to clients.
- Effectively carry out presales function in solution offerings (proposal, demo, presentation, etc.).
- Actively participate in preparing tender documents and proposals, RFPs, RFIs and POC demo.
- Provide professional services and training for channels and distributors.

We Are Looking For:

An insightful and influential collaborator to join our team. We encourage you to apply for this position if you have the following qualities:

- At least 5 years of experience in network security or application security
- Experience in handling big enterprise account, lab setup and proof-of-concept (POC)
- Exceptional skillset in networking/security solutions, such as Routing, Switching, VPN, Firewall, SDWAN, Sandboxing, UEBA, application security, etc.
- Experience in cloud deployment, such as AWS, Azure, Alibaba, Google Cloud, etc.
- Knowledge on SDN, orchestration or multi-vendor integrated deployment
- Knowledge on hacking technique, exploit simulation or penetration test
- Excellent communication and presentation skills

Why Join Us:

At Fortinet, we embrace diversity and inclusivity. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and identities. Explore our welcoming work environment designed for a rewarding career journey with an attractive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000+ customers around the globe.

We will only notify shortlisted candidates.

Fortinet will not entertain any unsolicited resumes, please refrain from sending them to any Fortinet employees or Fortinet email aliases. Should any Agency submit any resumes to Fortinet, these resumes if considered, will be assumed to have been given by the Agency free of any related fees/charges.

postings.title: Systems Engineer (Commercial) - SADC
postings.description:
Systems Engineer

Location: Johannesburg, South Africa

We are looking for a Systems Engineer to work closely with a sales representative across designated territory. The Systems Engineer's main mission will be to support the sales organization in all technical matters regarding pre-sales, sales calls, and post-sales.

With us you will

- Lead all technical aspects of a sales cycle with customers, from the initial RFIs, through to RFPs & RFQs when required. This includes the project management and active participation in POCs in partnership with the relevant teams both internally and within the customer and/or commercial partner.
- Have the ability to listen and to understand the technical requirements of the customer, reading between the lines to build a solution which outperforms the competitor offering.
- Be the primary technical point of contact for the customer(s) and partners in close collaboration with your sales partner.
- Continuously strive to improve knowledge around the Fortinet products and solutions, along with maintaining a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and Fortinet’s ability to provide long lasting protection against the ever-evolving threats.
- Have a strong ability to position Fortinet solutions to the customer, whether this be remotely or in person. This requires strong communication skills and the ability to confidently present through whiteboarding, technical white papers, technical plans or customer discussions.
- Manage your time effectively when working on multiple deals simultaneously, ensuring a positive customer experience is maintained.

Apply if you

- Have a high aptitude for security technology, specifically encryption, authentication, with further knowledge of network security, intrusion detection, anti-virus, routing, switching, LAN and WAN being desirable.
- Have experience working across South Africa is a must.
- Are currently or have previously worked in a pre-sales engineer role, managing end to end technical aspects of deals, through to technical closure.
- Can demonstrate your problem solving skills and how this has impacted key wins within your current organisation.
- Understand and can demonstrate your ability to build and maintain customer relationships, including your ability to effectively communicate technically to a range of both external and internal stakeholders.
- Fluency in English is a must

postings.title: Systems Engineer - Manufacturing & Transportation - Central Germany
postings.description:
Presales Systems Engineer – Enterprise Manufacturing & Transportation

Location: Central Germany - Frankfurt preferred, or remote worker considered

At Fortinet, we are shaping the future of cybersecurity and networking. As a global leader in cybersecurity, we help organizations protect their digital environments and securely accelerate their digital transformation.

We are looking for a passionate IT security professional who enjoys working at the intersection of technology, customers, and business impact. If you thrive on translating complex technical challenges into clear, compelling solutions and enjoy close collaboration with customers and partners, this role is for you.

Fluency in both German and English and confidence presenting in both languages are essential.

Why You’ll Love This Role

- Work with one of the industry’s strongest and broadest cybersecurity portfolios

- Be trusted as a technical authority and strategic advisor, not just a demo resource

- Influence customer security architectures and long-term strategy

- Benefit from continuous enablement, certifications, and career development at Fortinet

- Enjoy high autonomy while being supported by a strong regional and global team

Your Role

This position is part of the German Sales Organization at Fortinet. As a trusted technical advisor, you will work closely with prospective and existing customers to understand their business and technical requirements and demonstrate how Fortinet’s Security Fabric addresses their security challenges.

You will design and deliver persuasive technical presentations, product demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) that clearly articulate Fortinet’s value and differentiation.

You will collaborate closely with sales teams, partners, and fellow systems engineers, as well as with solution architects, consulting systems engineers, and other internal stakeholders, building long-term relationships based on trust, expertise, and shared success.

You will play a key role in winning strategic customers, accelerating deal cycles through technical leadership, and helping organizations build secure, scalable architectures with Fortinet solutions.

What You Will Do

Product Demonstrations:

Deliver engaging, informative, and customer-focused demonstrations that showcase Fortinet’s market-leading technology and innovation.

Training & Workshops:

Conduct technical enablement sessions—online and on-site—for Fortinet partners, helping them deepen their technical expertise and successfully position Fortinet solutions.

Proof of Concepts (PoCs):

Support the planning, setup, and execution of PoCs using Fortinet solutions, ensuring technical success and strengthening customer confidence in Fortinet as the best security platform on the market.

Technical Sales Enablement:

Ensure that sales teams are equipped with the latest technical knowledge, best practices, and competitive insights to succeed in customer engagements.

Enjoying What You Do:

Pre-Sales Systems Engineering at Fortinet is a highly respected and rewarding role. You will work with cutting-edge technology, solve meaningful security challenges, and be part of a high-performing, collaborative team.

What We Offer

Flexibility & Hybrid Work:

This role is primarily home-office based in Germany, with access to Fortinet offices in Frankfurt, Munich, and Hamburg. You will typically support customers and partners within your region. Fortinet supports flexible working models and trusts employees to manage their time responsibly, enabling a healthy work–life balance.

Structured Onboarding & Continuous Learning:

Fortinet invests heavily in your success. You will benefit from a comprehensive onboarding program, structured enablement sessions, mentorship, and continuous access to industry-leading technical training and Fortinet certification programs throughout your career.

Your Profile

Technical Curiosity & Security Mindset:

Strong interest in IT security and a desire to continuously grow in a dynamic, fast-evolving industry.

Relevant Experience:

Hands-on experience in networking and/or IT security gained at a vendor, system integrator, service provider, consulting firm, or within an enterprise IT environment. Experience in pre-sales is valuable, but technically strong engineers with customer-facing ambition are also encouraged to apply.

Strong Communication Skills:

Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and convincingly. Approximately 80% of customer interactions will be conducted in German and 20% in English; fluency in both languages is required.

Consultative Approach:

You act as a trusted advisor, combining deep technical expertise with a strong customer focus and the ability to position Fortinet’s differentiation against competing solutions.

Willingness to Travel:

You enjoy engaging directly with customers, partners, and the wider security community—whether at customer sites, partner events, or industry conferences.

Innovation & Growth Mindset:

You thrive in an innovative environment and want to actively contribute to Fortinet’s continued success

Key Skills

- Networking: LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN, SDN

- Security: Next-Generation Firewalls

- Additional experience or interest in areas such as SASE, Zero Trust, cloud security, or data center architectures is a plus, but not a requirement

Why Join Us?

If you enjoy solving complex security challenges, working with cutting-edge technology, and being trusted as a technical leader, Fortinet offers you the platform, scale, and support to thrive.
We look forward to getting to know you.

At Fortinet, we embrace diversity and inclusivity. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and identities. Explore our welcoming work environment designed for a rewarding career journey with an attractive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 830,000+ customers around the globe.

#LI-Remote

Fortinet makes possible a digital world that we can always trust through its mission to protect people, devices, and data everywhere. This is why the world’s largest enterprises, service providers, and government organizations choose Fortinet to securely accelerate their digital journey. The Fortinet Security Fabric platform delivers broad, integrated, and automated protections across the entire digital attack surface, securing critical devices, data, applications, and connections from the data center to the cloud to the home office. Ranking #1 in the most security appliances shipped worldwide, more than 615,000 customers trust Fortinet to protect their businesses. And the Fortinet NSE Training Institute, an initiative of Fortinet’s Training Advancement Agenda (TAA), provides one of the largest and broadest training programs in the industry to make cyber training and new career opportunities available to everyone.

postings.title: Systems Engineer - Ticino
postings.description:
We are looking for a passionate IT security professional who enjoys working at the intersection of technology, customers, and business impact. If you thrive on translating complex technical challenges into clear, compelling solutions and enjoy close collaboration with customers and partners, this role is for you.
Fluency in both Italian and English and confidence presenting in both languages are essential.

Why You’ll Love This Role

- Work with one of the industry’s strongest and broadest cybersecurity portfolios
- Be trusted as a technical authority and strategic advisor, not just a demo resource
- Influence customer security architectures and long-term strategy
- Benefit from continuous enablement, certifications, and career development at Fortinet
- Enjoy high autonomy while being supported by a strong regional and global team

Your Role

This position is part of the Swiss Territory Sales Organization at Fortinet. As a trusted technical advisor, you will work closely with prospective and existing customers to understand their business and technical requirements and demonstrate how Fortinet’s Security Fabric addresses their security challenges.
You will design and deliver persuasive technical presentations, product demonstrations, and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) that clearly articulate Fortinet’s value and differentiation.
You will collaborate closely with sales teams, partners, and fellow systems engineers, as well as with solution architects, consulting systems engineers, and other internal stakeholders, building long-term relationships based on trust, expertise, and shared success.
You will play a key role in winning strategic customers, accelerating deal cycles through technical leadership, and helping organizations build secure, scalable architectures with Fortinet solutions.

What You Will Do

Product Demonstrations:
Deliver engaging, informative, and customer-focused demonstrations that showcase Fortinet’s market-leading technology and innovation.
Training & Workshops:
Conduct technical enablement sessions—online and on-site—for Fortinet partners, helping them deepen their technical expertise and successfully position Fortinet solutions.
Proof of Concepts (PoCs):
Support the planning, setup, and execution of PoCs using Fortinet solutions, ensuring technical success and strengthening customer confidence in Fortinet as the best security platform on the market.
Technical Sales Enablement:
Ensure that sales teams are equipped with the latest technical knowledge, best practices, and competitive insights to succeed in customer engagements.
Enjoying What You Do:
Pre-Sales Systems Engineering at Fortinet is a highly respected and rewarding role. You will work with cutting-edge technology, solve meaningful security challenges, and be part of a high-performing, collaborative team.
What We Offer
Flexibility & Hybrid Work:
This role is home-office based in Ticino, with access to Fortinet offices in Zurich and Lausanne. You will typically support customers and partners within your region. Fortinet supports flexible working models and trusts employees to manage their time responsibly, enabling a healthy work–life balance.
Structured Onboarding & Continuous Learning:
Fortinet invests heavily in your success. You will benefit from a comprehensive onboarding program, structured enablement sessions, mentorship, and continuous access to industry-leading technical training and Fortinet certification programs throughout your career.

Your Profile

Technical Curiosity & Security Mindset:
Strong interest in IT security and a desire to continuously grow in a dynamic, fast-evolving industry.
Relevant Experience:
Hands-on experience in networking and/or IT security gained at a vendor, system integrator, service provider, consulting firm, or within an enterprise IT environment. Experience in pre-sales is valuable, but technically strong engineers with customer-facing ambition are also encouraged to apply.
Strong Communication Skills:
Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and convincingly. Approximately 80% of customer interactions will be conducted in Italian and 20% in English; fluency in both languages is required.
Consultative Approach:
You act as a trusted advisor, combining deep technical expertise with a strong customer focus and the ability to position Fortinet’s differentiation against competing solutions.
Willingness to Travel:
You enjoy engaging directly with customers, partners, and the wider security community—whether at customer sites, partner events, or industry conferences.
Innovation & Growth Mindset:
You thrive in an innovative environment and want to actively contribute to Fortinet’s continued success

Key Skills

- Networking: LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN, SDN
- Security: Next-Generation Firewalls
- Additional experience or interest in areas such as SASE, Zero Trust, cloud security, or data center architectures , AI Security is a plus.

If you enjoy solving complex security challenges, working with cutting-edge technology, and being trusted as a technical leader, Fortinet offers you the platform, scale, and support to thrive.
We look forward to getting to know you.
At Fortinet, we embrace diversity and inclusivity. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and identities. Explore our welcoming work environment designed for a rewarding career journey with an attractive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 830,000+ customers around the globe.

postings.title: Systems Engineer – GSI
postings.description:
Systems Engineer – GSI

Location: Frankfurt

A digital world you can always trust - is essential to achieving just and sustainable societies. We believe it is our responsibility to deliver on that vision by innovating sustainable security technologies, diversifying cybersecurity talent, and promoting responsible business across our value chain.

Fortinet Germany is outperforming the Security Market since several years, contributing consistent and high profitable revenue streams to Fortinet’s global success. One of the key differentiators in the market is the PreSales organization. The coverage and security technology competence level are outstanding and clearly above average vendor presence with the security industry.

Objective:

In this key role a Systems Engineer will work closely with sales representatives in our GSI vertical. The Systems Engineer's main mission will be to support the sales organization in all technical matters regarding pre-sales, sales activities, and selected post-sales activities.

Responsibilities:

- Understanding of the Fortinet portfolio with the ability to demonstrate and articulate technical and business value.

- Strong foundational knowledge in security and networking technology and specifically in our “core technology”, FortiOS-based products.

- Subject Matter Expert and first contact in an assigned technical domain within or across assigned pre-sales district for GSIs. Manage domain use cases, competitive intelligence, and differentiation. Excellent product integration & customization skills including relevant 3rd party integrations.

- Create sales opportunities by identifying solutions to customer problems and assist in qualifying sales leads from a technical perspective. Discover opportunities to upsell and cross-sell Fortinet solutions. Initiate and influence project decisions.

- Manage and lead all aspects of the technical sales engagement from general queries to demos, responses to RfX, driving PoC’s and enablement around features, specifications, and functionality to integration. Provide high-level architecture and implementation design consultation and best practice guidance for strategic opportunities.

- Act as trusted advisor for assigned GSI accounts and maintain the technical relationship with the customer. Discover opportunities to upsell and cross-sell Fortinet solutions. Work closely with the regional escalation manager, technical support team and engineering to ensure customer's technical issues are answered and resolved.

- Collaborate with peers, Consulting System Engineers (CSE’s), Solution Architects, Business Consultants, Professional Services and/or Partners on complex opportunities. Capture and manage customer requirements through the Consulting System Engineering Team to Product Management.

- Support PreSales, Sales & Channel enablement activities and events.

Required Skills:

- Minimum of 3 years’ experience in pre-sales support for GSIs with proven success.

- Deep level knowledge in the design and delivery of GSI related service and solution offerings.

- Expert level knowledge in networking (LAN, WIFI, WAN, SDN, routing, switching, Internet services administration), and network security (Next-Gen Firewalls, Intrusion Detection, encryption protocols).

- Strong customer focus to address complex technical and business requirements with a self-motivated, positive attitude. Goal-driven, adapting to shifting priorities, demands and timelines.

- Knowledge of the following domains is a plus:

- Datacenter architectures (e.g. ACI, NSX-T)

- Security Architectures (e.g. Zero Trust, SASE, SD-WAN)

- Modern Software Architectures (e.g. DevOps, IaC)

- Cloud Architectures with at least one public cloud specialization

- Security Operations (e.g. Orchestration, Automation, SIEM Tools)

- IT Security standards (e.g. BSI 200-x, ISO2700x, COBIT, NIST) and/or relevant regulations (EU-DSGVO, BDSG, NIS-2/KRITIS).

- Scripting (ideally Ansible, Terraform, Python with good knowledge of APIs)

- Excellent German and English language skills.

- Ability to interface with senior levels of internal / external organizations is required.

- Expert level verbal & written communication, presentation, prioritization, and interpersonal skills.

- Deep level experience in installation and configuration of network devices, systems (UNIX/Linux, Windows-based, virtualized and containers), public-clouds

- Willingness to travel 20-50% of time.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Graduate degree preferred

Fortinet is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity in our company, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

#LI-Remote

Fortinet makes possible a digital world that we can always trust through its mission to protect people, devices, and data everywhere. This is why the world’s largest enterprises, service providers, and government organizations choose Fortinet to securely accelerate their digital journey. The Fortinet Security Fabric platform delivers broad, integrated, and automated protections across the entire digital attack surface, securing critical devices, data, applications, and connections from the data center to the cloud to the home office. Ranking #1 in the most security appliances shipped worldwide, more than 615,000 customers trust Fortinet to protect their businesses. And the Fortinet NSE Training Institute, an initiative of Fortinet’s Training Advancement Agenda (TAA), provides one of the largest and broadest training programs in the industry to make cyber training and new career opportunities available to everyone.

postings.title: Talent Operations Partner - Israel
postings.description:
Talent Operations Partner

Location: Israel (Herzliya + Tel Aviv)

Role Overview:

Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic Talent Operations Partner to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

We're looking for a Talent Operations Partner to be the backbone of our HR operations in Israel: the person who keeps processes, systems, and data running accurately behind the scenes while also being a trusted, responsive presence for employees and managers day to day. This is a role for someone who thrives on structure and precision in a fast-moving, high-volume environment, and who takes real ownership of making HR operations scalable, auditable, and reliable across a large, complex, multi-country organization. Just as important as the operational rigor is the human side of the role: you're approachable, people-oriented, and genuinely enjoy helping others, bringing a customer-focused mindset to every interaction so employees and managers alike feel heard, supported, and well taken care of.

As a Talent Operations Partner, you will own the processes, systems, and data infrastructure that keep HR running accurately and efficiently, while also serving as a trusted, approachable point of contact for employees and managers.

You will:

- Own and continuously improve HR processes and workflows across the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, transfers, contracts, benefits, payroll operations including time attendance), ensuring they are documented, standardized, and scalable across the organization.

- HRIS: maintain accurate employee data, configure and troubleshoot workflows, run regular data integrity audits.

- Manage multiple concurrent HR operations priorities and deadlines — payroll cycles, audits, compliance filings, benefits enrollment, reporting — without dropping details, in a fast-moving, high-volume environment.

- Prepare, maintain, and quality-control HR documentation, reports, and employee records, with strong attention to accuracy and auditability.

- Ensure compliance with local labor laws and company policy, translating requirements into clear guidance and system/process updates for stakeholders.

- Serve as the primary, approachable point of contact for employees and managers on HR matters, bringing a customer-focused mindset to every interaction and ensuring a positive, responsive employee experience.

postings.title: Tax Intern
postings.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Tax Intern to join Fortinet, Inc.’s Tax Department. This is an in-office position and requires the intern to work from our Sunnyvale office. Unlike a traditional accounting firm role, this in-house position offers a front-row seat to the financial operations of a fast-paced technology company. In this role, we encourage the utilization of AI and data automation tools to accelerate technical tax research, streamline notice management, and enhance the accuracy of audit-ready workpapers.

Key Responsibilities

- Tax Compliance & Financial Reporting
- Assist in the preparation of the U.S. Federal Income Tax Return (Form 1120) and various state and local (SALT) filings.
- Help calculate and document quarterly estimated tax payments.
- Assist with preparation indirect tax returns, including sales/use tax, VAT/GST, and CAT filings
- Assist with audit projects by gathering supporting documentation, preparing schedules ,and responding to audit information requests

- Tech-Sector Specialized Projects
- R&D Tax Credit: Gather documentation from engineers or product teams to support Research & Development tax credit claims.
- Tax notice/audit: Support the Tax Department in managing and resolving formal inquiries, notices, and audits from federal, state, and international tax authorities.
- Tax Operations & Automation
- Learn to extract the clean financial data from our ERP system (e.g., Oracle) and Vertex for use in tax workpapers.
- Learn to Utilize data visualization and automation tools (e.g., Alteryx or Tableau) to streamline repetitive compliance tasks.
- Collaborate with Accounting, Finance, AP, AR and IT teams on tax-related matters
- Support implementation and testing of tax engine and system updates

Qualifications & Skills

- Educational Background:
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Taxation, or Finance or recently graduated (May/June 2026). (CPA-track preferred).
- Technical Prowess:
- Proficiency in MS Excel (e.g., Pivot Tables and VLOOKUPs, and other formulas).
- Exposure to data analytics tools (Alteryx) is a significant plus.

- Core Competencies:
- Senior pursuing Accounting/Finance or recently graduated (May/June 2026). A basic understanding of GAAP (General Accepted Accounting Principles).
- Ability to translate complex tax concepts into "plain English" for non-tax stakeholders.
- Attention to detail—accuracy is paramount in tax reporting.

What We Offer

- Direct Impact: Work on projects that influence the company’s effective tax rate and bottom line.
- Mentorship: Regular 1-on-1s with experienced Tax Professionals and exposure to senior finance leadership.

postings.title: Technical Account Manager
postings.description:
Office based 4 days a week in Rome or Milan

Would you like to join the leading global provider of network security solutions to help strategic accounts optimizing their customer experience? At Fortinet we are looking for a Technical Account Manager to build a long-term trusted relationship by operating as primary technical advisor for key enterprise customers.

As Technical Account Manager you will develop a deep understanding about the customer business/technical needs that will be used to provide technical support solutions tailored to their needs and challenges. Your proactive guidance will help keeping the customers mission critical
environments healthy by identifying potential issues before they become problems and improving the overall customer experience via best practices and technical recommendations that will optimize their return of investment.

If you are keen in helping customers achieving their strategic objectives while working on cutting edge security products, then come and join our team.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop a deep understanding about the customer business/technical needs to provide technical information, guidance and support

- Become a trusted advisor by proactively guide your customers with technical recommendations and best practices

- Run advanced troubleshooting on the full range of Fortinet products, reproduce customer environments on lab equipment, recommend potential new solutions

- Take initiatives and ownership of customer incidents to drive for timely resolutions

- Manage customer communications and expectations until the closure of each case

- Participate in customer conference calls or face to face customer meetings

- Produce service reports to summarize service activity and performance for key stakeholders

- Report Software/Hardware related issues to R&D department and assure follow-up

Skills and Attributes Requirements:

- Good understanding of data networking protocols, specifically TCP/IP, routing and switching

- Hands-on experience on security products and technologies (e.g. Firewalls, IDS/IPS, DDos, VPN, Web application Firewall)

- Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills

- Face to face and remote customer management experience

- Previous experience in a technical support position with telco or large enterprise space.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills

- Previous experience on Fortinet products is an advantage

Educational and Experience Requirements:

- Minimum of 6 years of experience in a technical support/post-sales role

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field, or an equivalent experience

- Fortinet certification FCP, FCSS, FCX a distinct advantage or similar

- Fluency in Italian + business level English

postings.title: Technical Content Developer (AI)
postings.description:
Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a Technical Content Developer with AI Expertise to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

The successful candidate will be part of a technical content team that captures content for new and existing cybersecurity software products for Fortinet customers and internal audiences. Technical documentation is published to the Fortinet Document Library at https://docs.fortinet.com/.

You must have a passion for technology, especially GenAI. You are detail oriented with stamina for highly technical content and enjoy working with others to contribute to large documentation sets. You have experience using internal AI and LLMs combined with experience using in-development products to research changes and produce technical documentation.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product Managers, Developers, QA, writers, and others to understand new features, use cases, and customer scenarios to:

- Own and publish new feature guides, administration guides, reference materials, and use-case scenarios for new software releases
- Update and automate the release notes process for products
- Receive and address feedback with the goal of filling content gaps and continually improving content
- Use internal AI and LLM to speed the writing process and optimize quality
- Develop tools with AI’s assistance to automate repetitive tasks
- Apply data-driven approach to analyzing knowledge gaps using data analytics and AI assistance
- Train LLMs with product knowledge to answer customer questions on product concepts and configurations
- Contribute to modernizing the authoring and publishing process using scripting and automation

We Are Looking For:

- Experience and curiosity with GenAI and its use cases to automate time-consuming tasks
- Experience working in software development environments
- Ability to convert complex technical information into clean, concise, and coherent end-user documentation
- Experience using scripting languages (Python, php, etc..) to automate tasks
- Experience with HTML and Javascript for web-based publishing
- Experience using AI to enhance and enrich technical writing
- Experience with building tools to automate writing, researching, authoring, and publishing tasks
- BA or BS degree, preferably in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, MIS, or a related field

postings.title: Technical Support Engineer
postings.description:
Fortinet a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence. Our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. As we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity, Fortinet recently announced the opening of our latest global Innovation Hub in Atlanta, Georgia, where our expansion will include a team of Technical Support Specialists. We are seeking to fill the Support Specialist role, a support and escalation point for Fortinet customers and partners with the goal of enhancing our global Customer Success and Support function, providing exceptional customer service and technical help for our loyal customers and to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business. In addition to being able to provide firsthand expertise in the day to day use of Fortinet technology, this role will also interface with QA and development to solve customer problems and identify solutions, optimizations and improvements through replication and testing.

As a Senior Technical Support Specialist, you will:

- Provide troubleshooting expertise on the core Fortinet products - especially FortiGate

- Collection, analysis and change recommendations of configuration information

- Collection and analysis of customer system information

- Recommend corrective actions based on analysis

- Provide Customer education where needed due to gaps in networking, product knowledge etc.

- Consultation of technical documentation, bulletins and release notes for known problems

- Reproduction of customer environments on lab equipment; work to isolate and solve problems; recommend potential new solutions.

- Follow up on technical cases including proper escalation and management of the case until case closure.

- Manage customer communications and expectations until the closure of each case; conduct and lead customer management meetings regarding escalation

We Are Looking For:

- Candidate with a minimum 3 plus years of experience in a technical support or system administration role in a networking/security company or equivalent education

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering or related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience is desirable.

- Deep working knowledge of operating systems -- Windows, OSX, Unix/Linux

- Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols, L2/L3 switching.

- Experience with security products -firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, virus scanning.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

- Past experience using AI tools to help the effectiveness of day-to-day activities

- Previous call center experience, preferably supporting data networking products and/or security products is desirable.

- A working understanding of knowledge management principles in daily workflow; KCS® framework experience is an added advantage

- Ability to work in the office 3-5 days a week

- Possibility of an on-Call rotation

- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

About Our Team:

Join the Fortinet TAC team in Atlanta, known for its collaborative ethos, working seamlessly with global customers, internal engineering teams and product development groups. Our team culture emphasizes continuous learning, innovation, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. We embrace Fortinet’s core values of openness, teamwork and innovation, fostering an environment where team members support each other, share knowledge, and leverage AI to solve complex technical challenges. Our inclusive and dynamic team thrives on collaboration and is driven by the shared goal of maintaining Fortinet’s high standards of excellence in cybersecurity solutions

Why Join Us:

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being.

Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000+ customers around the globe.
