postings.additional_locations: Praha, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
postings.description:
This role is based 4 days/week in our office in: Kelsterbach, Germany / Prague, Czech Republic

Who we are.

Fortinet is a global leader in the cyber security industry recognized for our innovative solutions and commitment to customer satisfaction. Our products are designed to help organizations of all sizes protect their networks and data from cyber threats. We have a global presence, with offices and partners in over 100 countries around the world and employ more than 12,000 people worldwide.

Why we need you.

We are currently seeking an experienced Technical Support Engineer to join our team supporting Fortinet’s flagship product – FortiGate. You will provide support to our customers and partners and provide a consistently excellent standard of customer assistance and service.

Through strong technical skills and product knowledge, the Support team works to resolve cases raised by effective troubleshooting, research, and testing or for more complex issues work directly with back-line and development teams.

What you will be doing.

- Work as part of a team to provide technical assistance to Fortinet-certified partners and customers for Fortinet Firewalls (FortiGate) and other devices.
- Run real-time troubleshooting sessions with partners/customers.
- Test and reproduce partner/customer issues in the Laboratory.
- Recommend corrective actions based on gathered data and analysis.
- Run real-time phone or remote access sessions.
- Report software/hardware related issues to R&D department.
- Acquire knowledge by participating in round tables, training, and self-learning.

To be successful in the role, you will have:

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering or related field, or an equivalent combination of training and experience.
- 3 - 6 years’ experience in an IT or technical support role.
- Experience in the telecommunications/networking/security industry.
- Good knowledge of the OSI model.
- Strong understanding of networking protocols, specifically TCP/IP, routing and switching.
- Proficient spoken and written English.
- Positive, communicative, and customer-oriented attitude.
- Excellent time management, multi-tasking and organizational skills.
- Self-motivated to develop technically.
- Ability to cope and work under pressure.

What is not essential but nice to have:

- Industry certificates (NSE4, CCNA, Security+ etc.).
- Knowledge of dynamic routing protocols (OSPF, BGP).
- Knowledge of authentication protocols (LDAP, SSO, 2-factor authentication, etc.).
- Knowledge of cloud environments like AWS, google cloud, Azzure, etc.
- Experience with security devices (Firewalls, IPSs, Mail Security Gateways, etc.).

What we offer:

- Career growth opportunities: Working for a reputable and fast-growing company like Fortinet can provide you with ample opportunities for professional development and growth. Fortinet is committed to the professional development of its employees. You'll have access to a wealth of knowledge and experience from colleagues, as well as training, certification and mentorship programs that will help you grow in your role and advance your career.
- Competitive compensation and benefits: We offer competitive salaries, employee stock program, annual merit reviews, and benefits such as health insurance, multisport card and more.
- Work-life balance: Fortinet values its employees' work-life balance and provides a flexible working environment. You will receive 30 days paid time off with additional public holidays in the Czech Republic.
- Great location: Prague is one of the most beautiful cities in Europe and a great place to live and work. The Fortinet office is conveniently located in the city center, close to public transportation and other amenities.
- Global exposure: Fortinet has a global presence, and working in its Prague office provides you with exposure to an international working environment. You will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different regions and cultures, which can broaden your perspectives and enrich your professional experience.
- Impactful work: At Fortinet, you'll be working on cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions that help protect organizations from cyber threats. You'll be making a meaningful contribution to the safety and security of businesses worldwide.
- Exciting work culture: Fortinet has a dynamic and fast-paced work culture that encourages innovation, teamwork, and creativity. We are a high performing, driven, results oriented culture. The type of environment where you can get things done, explore your own innovation, creativity and feel proud about the difference you are able to achieve. We encourage ideas and provide patent incentives to do so. Also, through our own Innovator Awards Program, employees have an opportunity to get involved in the development of their own ideas and even share in the commercial success of newly developed products!

#LI-BG1 #LI-Hybrid

Fortinet makes possible a digital world that we can always trust through its mission to protect people, devices, and data everywhere. This is why the world’s largest enterprises, service providers, and government organizations choose Fortinet to securely accelerate their digital journey. The Fortinet Security Fabric platform delivers broad, integrated, and automated protections across the entire digital attack surface, securing critical devices, data, applications, and connections from the data center to the cloud to the home office. Ranking #1 in the most security appliances shipped worldwide, more than 615,000 customers trust Fortinet to protect their businesses. And the Fortinet NSE Training Institute, an initiative of Fortinet’s Training Advancement Agenda (TAA), provides one of the largest and broadest training programs in the industry to make cyber training and new career opportunities available to everyone.

postings.description:

- Troubleshooting Fortinet’s Endpoint Solutions EMS/EDR.
- Act as an escalation point for high profile cases and customers including proper management of the case until case closure.
- Collection, analysis and change recommendations of configuration information.
- Recommend corrective actions based on analysis.
- Provide Customer education where needed due to gaps in networking, product knowledge etc.
- Evolve into a subject matter expert on endpoint security, including other Fortinet security fabric solutions such as FortiClient and FortiAnalyzer.
- Consultation of technical documentation, bulletins and release notes for known problems
- Reproduction of customer environments on lab equipment; work to isolate and solve problems; recommend potential new solutions.
- Remain up to date on security trends, especially surrounding the endpoint market, evolving zero-day attacks and TTP’s.
- Manage customer communications and expectations until the closure of each case; conduct and lead customer management meetings regarding escalation.
- Contribute in publishing knowledge-based articles.
- Development, deliver and maintain team training materials.

We are looking for:

- Experience in a technical support or system administration role in a networking/security company or equivalent education.
- Deep working knowledge of operating systems -- Windows, macOS and Linux.
- Understanding how to collect OS level data within kernel and user space, and how to leverage this data to pinpoint problems.
- Strong understanding of TCP/IP, ARP, DNS, DHCP, L2/L3 switches.
- Knowledge of TLS and public key infrastructure.
- Authentication protocols including SAML and Kerberos.
- Experience with security products -firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, virus scanning.
- Understanding of security models and security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and ISO 27001.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
- Previous call center experience, preferably supporting data networking products and/or security products is desirable.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Bonus Points:

- Experience working with Kali Linux, MetaSploit or other offensive security tools.
- Understanding of memory stack analysis through WinDBG.
- Experience working with advanced operating system debug tools such as Procmon, System Informer LogMan, strace and other advanced Unix and Windows troubleshooting tools.
- Certified with one or more of the following: FCP, CCNA, CCNP, Azure, eJPT, PNPT, CPTS, CISSP, Security+, OSCP.

This position requires to be in the office 4 days/week.

Join Our Dynamic Team as a Technical Support Engineer!

Are you passionate about cutting-edge cybersecurity and thrive on solving complex technical challenges? Do you love empowering users with your expertise and making a tangible impact? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our world-class support team!

Fortinet, founded over 20 years ago, has become a driving force in the evolution of cybersecurity and the convergence of networking and security. Our mission is to secure people, devices, and data everywhere, and today we are looking for a Senior Technical Support Engineer to be a part of enabling the success of our rapidly growing business.

What You Will Do:

Reporting to eTAC Manager based in Prague, Czech Republic, you would act as the main contact point for our customers and partners for technical break/fix or configuration inquiries for Fortinet endpoint security product.

In this position, the Technical Support Engineer will:

- Become a Trusted Advisor: You'll be the go-to expert, providing exceptional technical support and guidance to our valued Fortinet certified partners and customers.

- Real-time Problem Solver: Dive into exciting, real-time troubleshooting sessions, diagnosing and resolving intricate technical issues with precision and speed.

- Configuration Architect: Analyze complex configuration information, identify areas for optimization, and recommend strategic changes to enhance system performance and security.

- Empower Through Education: Share your extensive knowledge, bridging gaps in networking and product understanding to empower our customers and partners.

- Innovation Driver: Collaborate on reproducing customer environments in our labs, isolating problems, and even contributing to the development of exciting new solutions.

- Case Management Maestro: Expertly manage technical cases from start to finish, ensuring clear communication, proactive escalations, and successful resolutions that delight our customers.

- Customer Advocate: Lead customer communication, manage expectations with professionalism, and confidently conduct meetings to discuss escalations and ensure complete satisfaction.

Who We Are Looking for:

We are seeking insightful, inclusive connectors to join our team. You foster collaborative partnerships by the ways in which you seek to understand others, work together, and diagnose complex organizational variables, issues, and opportunities. You have an ongoing sense of drive, informed urgency, and you are attentive to detail. You enjoy implementing holistic solutions that meet and scale with the strategic needs of the organization.

- You bring 6+ years of valuable experience in the dynamic world of networking or cyber security.

- Your in-depth knowledge of TCP/IP is second to none, allowing you to navigate complex network architectures with ease.

- You have hands-on experience with a range of security products, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, and virus scanning, ready to tackle any challenge.

- You possess strong communication skills, both written and verbal, enabling you to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.

- You exude a positive, communicative, and genuinely customer-oriented attitude, making every interaction a positive experience.

- You're an exceptional problem-solver, capable of tackling intricate issues autonomously or collaborating seamlessly within a high-performing team.

- English and German language required.

Desirable:

- A solid understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols, and L2/L3 switches.

- Experience with various VPN technologies (IPSec, SSL, L2TP).

- Good knowledge of authentication protocols and methods (LDAP, SAML, RADIUS, OAuth).

- Familiarity with database maintenance and SQL.

- An awareness of web application security and vulnerabilities (experience with exploits is a plus).

- Any industry certifications such as FCP, CCNA, Microsoft, or VMware are highly valued.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a competitive Total Rewards package to support you in managing your overall health and financial well-being, flexible work arrangements, and a supportive work environment. If you aspire to experience a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey, we invite you to consider joining us and bringing solutions that make meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000+ customers around the globe.

postings.title: Vice President, US Major Enterprise Sales
postings.description:
Overview

We are seeking a proven, executive-level sales leader to serve as Vice President, US Major Enterprise Sales — owning the strategy, growth, and performance of our largest and most strategic accounts across the United States. This is one of the most consequential go-to-market leadership roles in the company: you will set the direction for how we win, expand, and retain the enterprise organizations that anchor our business, and lead a national organization of sales and technical talent to deliver against an ambitious strategic-account revenue mandate.

This is an executive role that stays close to the field. You will own the Major Enterprise strategy and build the organization that executes it — and you will personally show up in the room on our most significant opportunities, lending executive weight, relationships, and judgment where it matters most. You will not run individual pipeline or carry deals yourself; you will build, enable, and inspire the leaders and teams who do, and you will remove the obstacles that stand between them and the number.

The Organization

The VP, US Major Enterprise Sales leads a fully integrated national organization of approximately 500 people. It spans field sales leadership (Regional Vice Presidents, Regional Directors, and Major Account Managers) and the technical pre-sales organization (Regional Systems Engineering VPs, Systems Engineers, and Solution Architects), which reports up through the sales line — meaning this leader owns both the commercial and technical sides of the major-accounts motion. The organization is well-resourced, with a 1:1 Systems Engineer-to-Major Account Manager coverage ratio that reflects the technical depth invested behind every strategic account. "Major" accounts are the largest enterprises in the US market — organizations of roughly 15,000+ employees and $3–5B+ in revenue — where the sales motion is complex, multi-year, executive, and consultative.

Key Responsibilities

- Own the US Major Enterprise strategy. Define the segment strategy, coverage model, and growth priorities for the nation's largest accounts, and align the organization behind them.
- Lead through leaders. Build, coach, and hold accountable a multi-layer organization of sales and technical leaders; set the standard for talent, performance, and culture across the org.
- Provide executive sponsorship on marquee opportunities. Personally engage on the largest and most strategic pursuits — in the room with customer executives, sponsoring the deal, and applying relationships and judgment to help the team win. (Executive sponsor, not the individual deal owner.)
- Drive predictable, sustained growth. Own the strategic-account revenue mandate; instill the forecasting rigor and operational discipline required for predictable performance at national scale.
- Cultivate C-suite relationships. Build and steward executive relationships across major enterprise customers, serving as the senior point of contact for the accounts that matter most.
- Partner cross-functionally. Work in lockstep with Systems Engineering, Product, Marketing, Channel, Legal, and Operations to bring the full company to bear on major-account outcomes.
- Enable and remove friction. Ensure the field has the tools, programs, executive air cover, and cross-functional support to exceed targets — and clear the obstacles that slow them down.
- Represent the segment to senior leadership. Deliver clear, credible readouts on performance, pipeline health, and strategic bets to the executive team.

Required Qualifications

- 15+ years of enterprise technology sales experience, including significant senior sales-leadership tenure leading leaders (i.e., managing managers/directors, not only individual contributors).
- Demonstrated success leading a large, multi-layer sales organization at national or comparable scale — this is an organizational leadership role, not a step up from running a single region.
- Track record of ownership over a business or major-accounts organization generating approximately $750M+ in strategic-account revenue.
- Deep experience selling complex, executive, multi-year solutions into the largest enterprise organizations (~15,000+ employees, $3–5B+ revenue).
- Cybersecurity and/or networking industry experience is required — a deep background in one or both, sufficient to be immediately credible with technical buyers and the field.
- Proven record of consistently exceeding quota and driving significant, sustained revenue growth.
- Fluency across a core enterprise security stack.
- Credibility and comfort operating with C-level customer stakeholders; excellent communication and presentation skills.
- A leadership style that is strategic and executive, yet close enough to the field to be genuinely useful in the biggest deals.
- Strong business acumen, operational discipline, and a customer-centric orientation.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience selling hardware-centric or hardware-inclusive solutions. Our business is heavily weighted toward hardware; executives whose experience is confined to ARR-based software/SaaS models have historically found the transition challenging. Hands-on experience leading hardware-inclusive portfolios is strongly preferred.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; MBA or advanced business degree a plus.
- Experience leading geographically distributed enterprise sales and technical pre-sales organizations.
- Established C-suite network within Fortune 500 / major enterprise accounts.

We don't expect any one candidate to check every box. If you meet most of these and are excited about leading at this scale, we'd like to hear from you.

Location

This is a Bay Area-based, hybrid role. The successful candidate must be able to regularly commute to the Sunnyvale office for customer meetings, Executive Briefing Center engagements, and executive team meetings. Bay Area residence (or relocation) is required.

What Success Looks Like

- Consistent achievement and overachievement of the US major-account revenue mandate.
- A clear, well-executed Major Enterprise strategy that the whole organization can articulate and rally behind.
- Deepened footprint and expansion within the largest strategic accounts.
- A high-performing, engaged, well-developed sales and technical organization with strong leader bench and retention.
- Trusted executive relationships that make us the strategic partner of choice for the nation's largest enterprises.
- Predictable forecasting and operational excellence at national scale.

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $500,00 - $650,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

postings.title: VP, Finance & Transformation
postings.description:
We are seeking an exceptional finance executive to help shape the future of our global Finance organization.

Reporting directly to the CFO, this role will serve as a strategic partner to the CFO and Finance leadership team, with a mandate to transform how Finance operates through AI, automation, advanced analytics, technology, process redesign and new organizational models.

This executive will help build a Finance organization designed for the future—one that increasingly automates transactional work, delivers predictive and actionable business insights, leverages AI-enabled tools and products, and directs more Finance capacity toward improving enterprise decision-making.

The role will initially operate with a lean structure and significant influence across Finance rather than a large dedicated team. The successful candidate must therefore be comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution, personally driving transformation initiatives while building alignment across Finance, IT, Data, AI and the business.

This is not simply a Finance technology or transformation position. The successful candidate will be a highly credible finance executive with the business judgment, leadership potential and breadth to grow into increasingly significant responsibilities across the CFO agenda over time.

Key Responsibilities

Define the Future Finance Operating Model

- Partner with the CFO to define and execute a multi-year roadmap for the Finance organization of the future.

- Assess Finance’s current capabilities, processes, organizational structure and technology and identify the highest-value opportunities for transformation.

- Help evolve Finance from traditional functional and task-based ways of working toward a more agile, capability-oriented operating model.

- Determine where work should be performed by people, AI, automation or combinations of each.

- Simplify organizational processes and decision-making where unnecessary complexity or layers slow execution.

- Establish clear measures of success for Finance transformation, including productivity, decision speed, forecast accuracy, insight quality and business impact.

Build an AI-Native Finance Function

- Identify and scale high-value applications of AI and automation across Finance.

- Redesign workflows rather than simply automating existing manual processes.

- Develop an approach for incorporating AI agents, automation and advanced analytics into Finance operations and decision support.

- Partner with technology and data teams to strengthen Finance’s data, systems, tools and AI infrastructure.

- Establish appropriate governance, controls and human accountability for AI-enabled Finance processes.

- Build organizational capability and confidence to continuously adopt new technologies as they emerge.

Transform How Finance Delivers Business Insights

- Help shift Finance from primarily reporting historical performance toward providing forward-looking, predictive and actionable insights.

- Advance the use of enterprise modeling, scenario analysis, simulation and advanced analytics to improve business decisions.

- Develop scalable tools and analytical products that enable business leaders to better understand performance drivers, tradeoffs and potential outcomes.

- Work with FP&A and business Finance leaders to improve the speed and quality of enterprise decision support.

- Identify opportunities to make financial insights increasingly self-service and technology enabled.

Modernize Finance Transactions & Operations

- Identify opportunities to automate and simplify high-volume, repetitive and transactional Finance activities.

- Help redesign Finance workflows around automation and AI-enabled execution.

- Reduce manual reconciliations, reporting, data manipulation and other low-value activities.

- Partner with Finance functional leaders to improve scalability while maintaining strong financial controls and operational discipline.

- Establish mechanisms for continuously maintaining and improving automated Finance processes.

Build Finance Engineering Capability

- Define the capabilities Finance will need across technology, data, AI, automation and process engineering.

- Partner with IT, Data and AI organizations to build and maintain Finance technology capabilities.

- Evaluate where Finance should develop dedicated expertise in areas such as AI agents, workflow engineering, data engineering, modeling and finance technology.

- Promote a tools-first approach in which Finance increasingly delivers services through scalable technology rather than manual processes.

- Help establish ownership models that ensure Finance tools and capabilities continue to evolve after initial implementation.

Lead Enterprise Strategy & Transformation

- Serve as a strategic thought partner to the CFO on enterprise performance, transformation and major business decisions.

- Translate company strategy into Finance capabilities, priorities and transformation initiatives.

- Lead or support high-priority cross-functional initiatives requiring strong financial, strategic and transformation leadership.

- Establish disciplined governance, prioritization and accountability for major Finance transformation initiatives.

- Help Finance play a broader role in improving the quality and speed of enterprise decision-making.

Shape the Finance Workforce of the Future

- Assess how Finance roles and capabilities will need to evolve as automation and AI change the nature of Finance work.

- Increase the emphasis on finance professionals with deep financial, analytical, technology and problem-solving capabilities.

- Help create a flatter, more agile organization that can rapidly assemble expertise around complex business problems.

- Develop new career experiences and capabilities that prepare Finance talent for increasingly technology-enabled work.

- Partner with Finance leadership and HR to build the talent strategy required to support the future Finance organization.

Qualifications

- 15+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within large, complex global organizations.

- Significant experience in FP&A, controllership, business finance, finance transformation or similarly broad finance leadership roles.

- Strong financial judgment and credibility with CFOs, CEOs and senior operating executives.

- Solid understanding of the balance of business needs and compliance requirements.

- Demonstrated success leading significant transformation across Finance or other complex enterprise functions.

- Deep understanding of how AI, automation, data and emerging technologies can reshape Finance work and operating models.

- Ability to translate technology opportunities into measurable financial and business outcomes.

- Demonstrated ability to lead through influence without relying on a large direct organization.

- Strong understanding of public-company financial requirements, controls and operating disciplines.

- Ability to move fluidly between enterprise strategy, organizational design and hands-on execution.

- Exceptional analytical, communication and change leadership capabilities.

- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, CPA or other relevant advanced qualification preferred.

The Profile We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

- A future CFO-caliber executive with the judgment and leadership potential to eventually operate across the entire CFO agenda.

- AI-native and technology fluent, with a practical understanding of how emerging technology can fundamentally reshape Finance.

- A builder, comfortable creating capabilities and driving results without initially having a large team.

- A transformation leader, willing to challenge longstanding assumptions about how Finance should operate.

- A strong strategic thinker, able to connect financial insights with business strategy and enterprise decision-making.

- A hands-on executive, willing to personally examine processes, data and technology rather than delegating transformation.

- An influential and collaborative change leader, capable of creating alignment across senior leaders and functions without direct authority.

- Commercially minded, with a strong understanding of how Finance enables growth, productivity, investment decisions and competitive advantage.

- Data-driven and intellectually curious, using evidence to challenge assumptions and continuously exploring better ways of working.

- Enterprise-oriented, focused on improving outcomes for the company rather than protecting traditional functional boundaries.

postings.description:
The Wireless Development Quality Assurance Engineer works within the R&D team to ensure the productivity, reliability, and accuracy of the Fortinet's WLAN product. In general, testing is to cover various features combinations integrated with various Fortinet products, in a way most customer would be deploying their real-time production networks; with real-clients and traffic. Also to test Interoperability between Fortinet-devices and 3rd party devices or clients. The QA Engineer must be able to collaborate with the team and work efficiently and effectively, in a fast-paced work environment, to identify the highest risks that must be addressed for determining release readiness.

Job Responsibilities:

- Design, develop, and execute detailed test plans (functional, regression, performance).
- Build complex testbeds integrating multiple Fortinet and third-party devices.
- Perform interoperability testing (Fortinet + 3rd-party devices/clients).
- Analyze customer-reported issues, review logs, replicate defects in lab, validate fixes.
- Identify, isolate, document, and track bugs through resolution.
- Produce accurate QA reports on time.
- Build and maintain test infrastructure for feature validation and defect reproduction.
- Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with developers on debugging.

Job Requirements:

- 3–6+ years of wireless QA experience.
- Strong understanding of QA methodologies (test plans, bug tracking, failure documentation).
- Networking and Wi-Fi protocol knowledge:
- 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be

- Experience with:
- Functional, stress/load, and performance testing
- Linux/UNIX/Windows OS
- Debugging and log analysis

- Wireless tools:
- Wireshark
- Omnipeek
- Ixia Veriwave
- Chariot
- iperf

- Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
- Excellent written and verbal English communication.
- Python automation experience.
- Experience working in Agile development environments.
